5.176.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tathānyāpi ca tatrāsti gaurī vai pañcapiṃḍikā ..
lakṣmyā saṃsthāpitā caiva mānuṣatvaṃvyavasthayā .. 1 ..
5.176.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तथान्यापि च तत्रास्ति गौरी वै पञ्चपिंडिका ..
लक्ष्म्या संस्थापिता चैव मानुषत्वंव्यवस्थया .. 1 ..
5.176.m: Sūta said: / Likewise, there is another Gaurī there, consisting of five lumps, / established by Lakṣmī when she assumed human form. 1

5.176.s:
tasyā darśanamātreṇa nārī saubhāgyamāmuyāt ..
jyeṣṭhe māsi site pakṣe vṛṣasthe ca divākare .. 2 ..
5.176.d:
तस्या दर्शनमात्रेण नारी सौभाग्यमामुयात् ..
ज्येष्ठे मासि सिते पक्षे वृषस्थे च दिवाकरे .. 2 ..
5.176.m: By merely beholding her, a woman will obtain good fortune in marriage. / In the month of Jyeṣṭha, during the bright fortnight, when the sun is in Taurus, 2

5.176.s:
tasyā upari nārī yā jalayantraṃ dadhāti vai ..
srāvyamāṇaṃ divānaktaṃ saubhāgyaṃ paramaṃ labhet .. 3 ..
5.176.d:
तस्या उपरि नारी या जलयन्त्रं दधाति वै ..
स्राव्यमाणं दिवानक्तं सौभाग्यं परमं लभेत् .. 3 ..
5.176.m: the woman who places over her a water-dripping device, / trickling day and night, shall attain supreme good fortune. 3

5.176.s:
yatphalaṃ labhate nārī samastairvihitairvrataiḥ ..
gaurīsamudbhavaiścaiva dānairdattaistadiṣṭajaiḥ ..
tatphalaṃ labhate sarvaṃ jalayantrasya kāraṇāt .. 4 ..
5.176.d:
यत्फलं लभते नारी समस्तैर्विहितैर्व्रतैः ..
गौरीसमुद्भवैश्चैव दानैर्दत्तैस्तदिष्टजैः ..
तत्फलं लभते सर्वं जलयन्त्रस्य कारणात् .. 4 ..
5.176.m: Whatever fruit a woman obtains by all prescribed vows / dedicated to Gaurī, and by gifts given out of desire for that fruit, / she obtains all that fruit through the water-dripping device. 4

5.176.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena strībhiḥ saubhāgyakāraṇāt ..
jalayantraṃ vidhātavyaṃ jyeṣṭhe gauryāḥ prayatnataḥ .. 5 ..
5.176.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन स्त्रीभिः सौभाग्यकारणात् ..
जलयन्त्रं विधातव्यं ज्येष्ठे गौर्याः प्रयत्नतः .. 5 ..
5.176.m: Therefore, for the sake of good fortune, with every effort / women must diligently arrange a water-dripping device over Gaurī in Jyeṣṭha. 5

5.176.s:
kiṃ vratairniyamairvāpi strīṇāṃ brāhmaṇasattamāḥ ..
japairhomaiḥ kṛtairanyairbahukleśakaraiśca taiḥ .. 6 ..
5.176.d:
किं व्रतैर्नियमैर्वापि स्त्रीणां ब्राह्मणसत्तमाः ..
जपैर्होमैः कृतैरन्यैर्बहुक्लेशकरैश्च तैः .. 6 ..
5.176.m: What use are vows or observances to women, O best of brahmins, / or other recitations and fire-offerings that cause great toil? 6

5.176.s:
strīṇāṃ brāhmaṇaśārdūlā jaleyantre dhṛte sati ..
gauryā upari sadbhaktyā vṛṣasthe tīkṣṇadīdhitau .. 7 ..
5.176.d:
स्त्रीणां ब्राह्मणशार्दूला जलेयन्त्रे धृते सति ..
गौर्या उपरि सद्भक्त्या वृषस्थे तीक्ष्णदीधितौ .. 7 ..
5.176.m: When a water-dripping device is placed by women, O tigers among brahmins, / over Gaurī with true devotion while the sun is in Taurus, 7

5.176.s:
naivaṃ saṃjāyate vaṃdhyā kākavandhyā na jāyate ..
na daurbhāgyasamopetā saptajanmāṃtarāṇi sā .. 8 ..
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
gaurī caturbhujā proktā dṛśyate parameśvarī ..
pañcapiṃḍā kathaṃ jātā hyetaṃ naḥ saṃśayaṃ vada .. 9 .1
5.176.d:
नैवं संजायते वंध्या काकवन्ध्या न जायते ..
न दौर्भाग्यसमोपेता सप्तजन्मांतराणि सा .. 8 ..
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
गौरी चतुर्भुजा प्रोक्ता दृश्यते परमेश्वरी ..
पञ्चपिंडा कथं जाता ह्येतं नः संशयं वद .. 9 .1
5.176.m:
she does not become barren, she does not become one who bears only a single child, / and she is not afflicted by misfortune for seven successive births. 8
The seers said: / Gaurī is described as having four arms, seen as the Supreme Goddess; / how did she become five lumps? Speak to us and resolve this doubt. 9

5.176.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
yadā ca pralayo bhāvi tadā tmānaṃ karotyasau ..
paścapiṃḍīmayaṃ viprāḥ kurute rūpamuttamam .. 6.177.10 ..
5.176.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
यदा च प्रलयो भावि तदा त्मानं करोत्यसौ ..
पश्चपिंडीमयं विप्राः कुरुते रूपमुत्तमम् .. 6.177.10 ..
5.176.m: Sūta said: / When the dissolution is to take place, then, O brahmins, she makes herself / consist of five lumps, assuming an excellent form. 6.177.10

5.176.s:
eṣā sā paramā śaktiḥ sarvaṃ vyāpya sureśvarī ..
tayā sarvamidaṃ vyāptaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram .. 11 ..
5.176.d:
एषा सा परमा शक्तिः सर्वं व्याप्य सुरेश्वरी ..
तया सर्वमिदं व्याप्तं त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् .. 11 ..
5.176.m: She is that supreme Śakti, pervading everything, the sovereign of the gods; / by her all this threefold world, moving and unmoving, is pervaded. 11

5.176.s:
pṛthivyāpaśca tejaśca vāyurākāśameva ca ..
sṛṣṭyarthaṃ rakṣayedeṣā tataḥ syātpaṃcapiṃḍikā .. 12 ..
5.176.d:
पृथिव्यापश्च तेजश्च वायुराकाशमेव च ..
सृष्ट्यर्थं रक्षयेदेषा ततः स्यात्पंचपिंडिका .. 12 ..
5.176.m: Earth, water, fire, wind, and space— / she preserves them for the purpose of creation; hence she exists as five lumps. 12

5.176.s:
yadasyāṃ pūjitāyāṃ tu pratyakṣāyāṃ prajāyate ..
sahasratriguṇaṃ tacca yatra syātpañcapiṇḍikā .. 13 ..
5.176.d:
यदस्यां पूजितायां तु प्रत्यक्षायां प्रजायते ..
सहस्रत्रिगुणं तच्च यत्र स्यात्पञ्चपिण्डिका .. 13 ..
5.176.m: Whatever [fruit] arises when she is worshipped in visible form, / that becomes three thousand times greater where she consists of five lumps, 13

5.176.s:
jyeṣṭhe māsi viśeṣeṇa jalayaṃtrārcanena ca ..
atra vaḥ kīrtayiṣyāmi tviti hāsaṃ purātanam .. 14 ..
5.176.d:
ज्येष्ठे मासि विशेषेण जलयंत्रार्चनेन च ..
अत्र वः कीर्तयिष्यामि त्विति हासं पुरातनम् .. 14 ..
5.176.m: especially in the month of Jyeṣṭha, through worship with a water-dripping device. / In this regard, I shall tell you an ancient story, 14

5.176.s:
yadvṛttaṃ kāśirājasya bhāryāyā dvijasattamāḥ ..
yacca proktaṃ purā lakṣmyā viṣṇave paripṛṣṭayā .. 15 ..
5.176.d:
यद्वृत्तं काशिराजस्य भार्याया द्विजसत्तमाः ..
यच्च प्रोक्तं पुरा लक्ष्म्या विष्णवे परिपृष्टया .. 15 ..
5.176.m: of what happened to the wife of the king of Kāśi, O best of the twice-born, / and what was told formerly by Lakṣmī when questioned by Viṣṇu. 15

5.176.s:
.. lakṣmī ruvāca .. ..
kāśirājaḥ purā hyāsījjayasena iti śrutaḥ ..
tasya bhāryāsahasraṃ tu hyāsīdrūpasamanvitam .. 16 ..
5.176.d:
.. लक्ष्मी रुवाच .. ..
काशिराजः पुरा ह्यासीज्जयसेन इति श्रुतः ..
तस्य भार्यासहस्रं तु ह्यासीद्रूपसमन्वितम् .. 16 ..
5.176.m: Lakṣmī said: / Formerly, there was a king of Kāśi known as Jayasena; / he had a thousand wives endowed with beauty. 16

5.176.s:
atha cānyā priyā tena labdhā bhāryā suśobhanā ..
manuṣyatvavyavasthāyā mama cāṃśakalā hi yā ..
sutā madrādhirājasya viṣvaksenasya dhīmataḥ .. 17 ..
5.176.d:
अथ चान्या प्रिया तेन लब्धा भार्या सुशोभना ..
मनुष्यत्वव्यवस्थाया मम चांशकला हि या ..
सुता मद्राधिराजस्य विष्वक्सेनस्य धीमतः .. 17 ..
5.176.m: Then another beloved, very beautiful wife was obtained by him, / who was a portion and digit of me in a human state, / the daughter of Viṣvaksena, the wise sovereign of Madra. 17

5.176.s:
sā gatvā prātarutthāya śubhe gaṃgātaṭe tadā ..
pañcapiṃḍātmikāṃ gaurīṃ kṛtvā karddamasaṃbhavām .. 18 ..
5.176.d:
सा गत्वा प्रातरुत्थाय शुभे गंगातटे तदा ..
पञ्चपिंडात्मिकां गौरीं कृत्वा कर्द्दमसंभवाम् .. 18 ..
5.176.m: Rising in the morning and going to the auspicious bank of the Gaṅgā, / she fashioned Gaurī out of clay, consisting of five lumps. 18

5.176.s:
tataḥ saṃpūjayāmāsa mantraiḥ paṃcabhireva ca ..
tato gandhaiḥ parairmālyairdhūpai rvastraiḥ suśobhanaiḥ .. 19 ..
5.176.d:
ततः संपूजयामास मन्त्रैः पंचभिरेव च ..
ततो गन्धैः परैर्माल्यैर्धूपै र्वस्त्रैः सुशोभनैः .. 19 ..
5.176.m: Then she worshipped [her] with five mantras, / and then with excellent fragrances, garlands, incenses, and very beautiful garments, 19

5.176.s:
naivedyaiḥ paramānnaiśca gītairnṛtyaiḥ pravāditaiḥ ..
tato visṛjya tāṃ devīṃ taduddeśena vai tataḥ .. 6.177.20 ..
5.176.d:
नैवेद्यैः परमान्नैश्च गीतैर्नृत्यैः प्रवादितैः ..
ततो विसृज्य तां देवीं तदुद्देशेन वै ततः .. 6.177.20 ..
5.176.m: with food offerings and sweet rice, with songs, dances, and musical instruments. / Then, bidding farewell to that goddess, in her honour 6.177.20

5.176.s:
dattvā dānāni bhūrīṇi gauriṇīnāṃ dvijanmanām ..
tataśca gṛhamabhyeti bhūrivāditraniḥsvanaiḥ .. 21 ..
5.176.d:
दत्त्वा दानानि भूरीणि गौरिणीनां द्विजन्मनाम् ..
ततश्च गृहमभ्येति भूरिवादित्रनिःस्वनैः .. 21 ..
5.176.m: she gave abundant gifts to twice-born women dedicated to Gaurī, / and then returned home amid the sounds of many musical instruments. 21

5.176.s:
yathāyathā ca tāṃ pūjāṃ tasyā gauryā karoti sā ..
tathātathā tu saubhāgyaṃ tasyāścāpyadhikaṃ bhavet .. 22 ..
5.176.d:
यथायथा च तां पूजां तस्या गौर्या करोति सा ..
तथातथा तु सौभाग्यं तस्याश्चाप्यधिकं भवेत् .. 22 ..
5.176.m: The more she performed that worship of Gaurī, / the more her good fortune increased, 22

5.176.s: sarvāsāṃ ca sapatnīnāṃ saubhāgyaṃ vādhikaṃ bhavet .. 23 ..
5.176.d: सर्वासां च सपत्नीनां सौभाग्यं वाधिकं भवेत् .. 23 ..
5.176.m: and her good fortune became greater than that of all her co-wives. 23

5.176.s:
atha tasyāḥ sapatnyo yāḥ sarvā duḥkhasamanvitāḥ..
dṛṣṭvā saubhāgyavṛddhiṃ tāṃ tasyā eva dinedine .. 24 ..
5.176.d:
अथ तस्याः सपत्न्यो याः सर्वा दुःखसमन्विताः..
दृष्ट्वा सौभाग्यवृद्धिं तां तस्या एव दिनेदिने .. 24 ..
5.176.m: Now, all her co-wives were filled with distress / seeing that increase in her good fortune day by day. 24

5.176.s:
ekāḥ procuḥ karma caitadyadeṣā kurute sadā ..
mṛnmayāṃśca samādāya pūjayetpaṃcapiṃḍakān .. 25 ..
5.176.d:
एकाः प्रोचुः कर्म चैतद्यदेषा कुरुते सदा ..
मृन्मयांश्च समादाय पूजयेत्पंचपिंडकान् .. 25 ..
5.176.m: Some said: “This rite that she constantly performs, / taking earthen clay and worshipping the five lumps— 25

5.176.s:
anyāstāṃ maṃtrasaṃsiddhāṃ pravadaṃti maharṣayaḥ ..
anyā vadanti puṇyāni hyasyāḥ pūrvakṛtāni ca .. 26 ..
5.176.d:
अन्यास्तां मंत्रसंसिद्धां प्रवदंति महर्षयः ..
अन्या वदन्ति पुण्यानि ह्यस्याः पूर्वकृतानि च .. 26 ..
5.176.m: [is it that?]” Others, O great seers, said she was perfected by mantras; / others said it was her merits acquired in a previous life. 26

5.176.s:
evaṃ tāsāṃ suduḥkhānāṃ mahānkālo jagāma ha ..
kasyacittvatha kālasya sarvāḥ saṃmaṃtrya tā mithaḥ .. 27 ..
5.176.d:
एवं तासां सुदुःखानां महान्कालो जगाम ह ..
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य सर्वाः संमंत्र्य ता मिथः .. 27 ..
5.176.m: Thus a long time passed for those deeply distressed women. / Then, after some time, having consulted with one another, 27

5.176.s:
tasyāḥ saṃnidhimājagmustasminneva jalāśaye ..
yatra sā pūjayedgaurīṃ kṛtvā tāṃ pañca piṃḍikām .. 28 ..
5.176.d:
तस्याः संनिधिमाजग्मुस्तस्मिन्नेव जलाशये ..
यत्र सा पूजयेद्गौरीं कृत्वा तां पञ्च पिंडिकाम् .. 28 ..
5.176.m: they came near to her at that very pool of water / where she was worshipping Gaurī, having fashioned her into five lumps. 28

5.176.s:
tataḥ sarvāḥ samālokya tyaktvā gaurīprapūjanam ..
saṃmukhī prayayau tūrṇaṃ kṛtāṃjalipuṭā sthitā .. 29 ..
5.176.d:
ततः सर्वाः समालोक्य त्यक्त्वा गौरीप्रपूजनम् ..
संमुखी प्रययौ तूर्णं कृतांजलिपुटा स्थिता .. 29 ..
5.176.m: Then, seeing them all, leaving the worship of Gaurī, / she quickly went to face them and stood with folded palms: 29

5.176.s:
svāgataṃ vo mahā bhāgā bhūyaḥ susvāgataṃ ca vaḥ ..
kṛtyaṃ nivedyatāṃ śīghraṃ yenāśu prakaromyaham .. 6.177.30 ..
5.176.d:
स्वागतं वो महा भागा भूयः सुस्वागतं च वः ..
कृत्यं निवेद्यतां शीघ्रं येनाशु प्रकरोम्यहम् .. 6.177.30 ..
5.176.m: “Welcome to you, fortunate ladies, and again a hearty welcome to you! / Tell me quickly your business, so that I may immediately perform it.” 6.177.30

5.176.s:
.. sapatnya ūcuḥ .. ..
vayaṃ sarvāḥ samāyātāḥ kautuke tavāṃtikam ..
daurbhāgyavahninirdagdhāstava saubhāgyajenaca .. 31 ..
5.176.d:
.. सपत्न्य ऊचुः .. ..
वयं सर्वाः समायाताः कौतुके तवांतिकम् ..
दौर्भाग्यवह्निनिर्दग्धास्तव सौभाग्यजेनच .. 31 ..
5.176.m: The co-wives said: / “All of us have come near you out of curiosity, / consumed by the fire of ill-fortune born of your good fortune. 31

5.176.s:
tasmādvada mahābhāge mṛnmayāṃ paṃcapiṃḍikām ..
nityamarcayasi tvaṃ kiṃ saubhā gyasya vivardhanam .. 32 ..
5.176.d:
तस्माद्वद महाभागे मृन्मयां पंचपिंडिकाम् ..
नित्यमर्चयसि त्वं किं सौभा ग्यस्य विवर्धनम् .. 32 ..
5.176.m: Therefore tell us, O fortunate one, why do you daily worship / [Gaurī] made of clay in five lumps, which increases good fortune? 32

5.176.s:
kiṃ te kāraṇametaddhi kiṃ vā mantrasamudbhavaḥ ..
prabhāvo'yaṃ mahābhāgeguhyaṃ cenno vadasva naḥ .. 33 ..
5.176.d:
किं ते कारणमेतद्धि किं वा मन्त्रसमुद्भवः ..
प्रभावोऽयं महाभागेगुह्यं चेन्नो वदस्व नः .. 33 ..
5.176.m: What is the reason for this, or does this power arise from mantras? / Tell us, O fortunate lady, if it is not a secret to be kept from us.” 33

5.176.s:
.. padmāvatyuvāca .. .. ..
rahasyaṃ paramaṃ guhyaṃ yatpṛṣṭāsmi śubhānanāḥ ..
avaktavyaṃ vadiṣyāmi bhavatīnāṃ tathāpi ca .. 34 ..
5.176.d:
.. पद्मावत्युवाच .. .. ..
रहस्यं परमं गुह्यं यत्पृष्टास्मि शुभाननाः ..
अवक्तव्यं वदिष्यामि भवतीनां तथापि च .. 34 ..
5.176.m: Padmāvatī said: / “It is a supreme secret, a hidden mystery about which I am asked, O fair-faced ladies; / yet, though it should not be spoken, I will tell it to you. 34

5.176.s:
gaurīpūjanakāle tu yasmāccaiva samāgatāḥ..
sarvā mama bhaginyaḥ stha īrṣyādharmo na me'sti ca .. 35 ..
5.176.d:
गौरीपूजनकाले तु यस्माच्चैव समागताः..
सर्वा मम भगिन्यः स्थ ईर्ष्याधर्मो न मेऽस्ति च .. 35 ..
5.176.m: Since you have arrived at the time of Gaurī's worship, / you are all my sisters, and I harbor no jealousy.

5.176.s:
ahamāsaṃ purā kanyā pure kusumasaṃjñite ..
vīrasenasya śūdrasya vaṇikputrasya dhīmataḥ ..
tena dattā'smi dharmeṇa vivāhārthaṃ mahātmanā .. 36 ..
5.176.d:
अहमासं पुरा कन्या पुरे कुसुमसंज्ञिते ..
वीरसेनस्य शूद्रस्य वणिक्पुत्रस्य धीमतः ..
तेन दत्ताऽस्मि धर्मेण विवाहार्थं महात्मना .. 36 ..
5.176.m: Formerly, I was a maiden in the city named Kusuma, / [daughter] of the wise merchant's son Vīrasena, a śūdra. / In accordance with dharma, that noble-minded man gave me in marriage.

5.176.s:
tato vivāhasamaye mama dattāni vṛddhaye ..
paṃcākṣarāṇi śreṣṭhāni yoṣitā dīkṣayā saha ..
gaurī pūjākṛte caiva proktā cāhaṃ tataḥ param .. 37 ..
5.176.d:
ततो विवाहसमये मम दत्तानि वृद्धये ..
पंचाक्षराणि श्रेष्ठानि योषिता दीक्षया सह ..
गौरी पूजाकृते चैव प्रोक्ता चाहं ततः परम् .. 37 ..
5.176.m: Then, at the time of marriage, for my prosperity / five excellent syllables were given [to me] by an elderly woman along with initiation, / and thereafter I was instructed regarding the worship of Gaurī:

5.176.s:
yāvatputri tvamātmānametaiḥ pūjayase'kṣaraiḥ ..
jalapānaṃ na kartavyaṃ tāvaccaiva kathañcana .. 38 ..
5.176.d:
यावत्पुत्रि त्वमात्मानमेतैः पूजयसेऽक्षरैः ..
जलपानं न कर्तव्यं तावच्चैव कथञ्चन .. 38 ..
5.176.m: “O daughter, as long as you do not worship yourself with these syllables, / you must never drink water under any circumstances.

5.176.s:
yena saṃprāpsyase'bhīṣṭaṃ tatprabhāvādyadīpsitam ..
tatheti ca mayā proktaṃ tasyāścaiva varānane .. 39 ..
5.176.d:
येन संप्राप्स्यसेऽभीष्टं तत्प्रभावाद्यदीप्सितम् ..
तथेति च मया प्रोक्तं तस्याश्चैव वरानने .. 39 ..
5.176.m: By virtue of that, you will attain whatever you desire.” / O fair-faced one, I said “So be it” to her.

5.176.s:
tato vivāhe nirvṛtte gatā'haṃ patinā saha ..
śvaśura stiṣṭhate yatra śvaśrūścaiva sudāruṇā .. 6,177.40 ..
gaurīpūjākṛte māṃ ca nivārayati sarvadā ..
tato'haṃ bhayasantrastā gaurībhaktiparāyaṇā ..
jalārthaṃ yatra gacchāmi tasmiṃścaiva jalāśraye .. 41 ..
5.176.d:
ततो विवाहे निर्वृत्ते गताऽहं पतिना सह ..
श्वशुर स्तिष्ठते यत्र श्वश्रूश्चैव सुदारुणा .. 6,177.40 ..
गौरीपूजाकृते मां च निवारयति सर्वदा ..
ततोऽहं भयसन्त्रस्ता गौरीभक्तिपरायणा ..
जलार्थं यत्र गच्छामि तस्मिंश्चैव जलाश्रये .. 41 ..
5.176.m: Then, when the marriage was completed, I went with my husband / where my father-in-law resided, as well as my exceedingly harsh mother-in-law. / She continually forbade me from performing the worship of Gaurī. / Terrified with fear, yet devoted to Gaurī with devotion, / whenever I went to the reservoir of water for the purpose of fetchng water,

5.176.s:
tataḥ karddamamādāya mantraiḥ paṃcabhirevaca ..
taireva pūjayāmyeva gaurīṃ bhaktiparāyaṇā .. 42 ..
5.176.d:
ततः कर्द्दममादाय मन्त्रैः पंचभिरेवच ..
तैरेव पूजयाम्येव गौरीं भक्तिपरायणा .. 42 ..
5.176.m: then, taking clay and using those five mantras, / devoted to devotion, I worshipped Gaurī with those very [mantras].

5.176.s:
prakṣipāmi tata stoye tato gacchāmi mandiram ..
kasyacittvatha kālasya bhartā me prasthitaḥ śubhaḥ ..
deśāṃtaraṃ vaṇigvṛttyā so'pi mārgaṃ tamāśritaḥ .. 43 ..
5.176.d:
प्रक्षिपामि तत स्तोये ततो गच्छामि मन्दिरम् ..
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य भर्ता मे प्रस्थितः शुभः ..
देशांतरं वणिग्वृत्त्या सोऽपि मार्गं तमाश्रितः .. 43 ..
5.176.m: Then I would throw [the clay image] into the water and go home. / Then, after some time, my good husband set out / for another country on merchant business, taking to that road.

5.176.s:
sa gacchanmarumārgeṇa māṃ samādāya snehataḥ ..
saṃprāpto nirjalaṃ deśaṃ suraudraṃ marumaṃḍalam .. 44 ..
5.176.d:
स गच्छन्मरुमार्गेण मां समादाय स्नेहतः ..
संप्राप्तो निर्जलं देशं सुरौद्रं मरुमंडलम् .. 44 ..
5.176.m: Traveling by the desert road and taking me along out of affection, / he reached a waterless region, the exceedingly terrifying desert tract.

5.176.s:
tathā raudratare kāle vṛṣasthe divasādhipe.
tataḥ sārthaḥ samastaśca viśrāṃtaḥ sthalamadhyagaḥ .. 45 ..
5.176.d:
तथा रौद्रतरे काले वृषस्थे दिवसाधिपे.
ततः सार्थः समस्तश्च विश्रांतः स्थलमध्यगः .. 45 ..
5.176.m: At that most frightful time, with the lord of the day stationed in Taurus, / the entire caravan rested in the midst of that barren ground.

5.176.s:
kūpamekaṃ samāśritya gambhīraṃ jaladopamam ..
etasminneva kāle tu mayā dṛṣṭaḥ samīpagaḥ ..
toyākāro maru ddeśastaścitte vicintitam .. 46 ..
5.176.d:
कूपमेकं समाश्रित्य गम्भीरं जलदोपमम् ..
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु मया दृष्टः समीपगः ..
तोयाकारो मरु द्देशस्तश्चित्ते विचिन्तितम् .. 46 ..
5.176.m: Relying on a single well, deep as a cloud— / at that very time, a nearby [place] having the appearance of water / was seen by me in the desert region, and it was thought in my mind:

5.176.s:
yattacca dṛśyate toyaṃ samīpasthaṃ tathā bahu ..
atra snātvā śucirbhūtvā gaurīmabhyarcya bhaktitaḥ ..
pibāmi salilaṃ paścātsusvādu sarasībhavam .. 47 ..
5.176.d:
यत्तच्च दृश्यते तोयं समीपस्थं तथा बहु ..
अत्र स्नात्वा शुचिर्भूत्वा गौरीमभ्यर्च्य भक्तितः ..
पिबामि सलिलं पश्चात्सुस्वादु सरसीभवम् .. 47 ..
5.176.m: “As for that abundant water which is seen standing nearby, / having bathed there, become pure, and worshipped Gaurī with devotion, / I will afterward drink the sweet water born of the pool.”

5.176.s:
tataḥ saṃprasthitā yāvatpragacchāmi padātpadam ..
yāvaddūrataraṃ yāmi tāvatsā mṛgatṛṣṇikā .. 48 ..
5.176.d:
ततः संप्रस्थिता यावत्प्रगच्छामि पदात्पदम् ..
यावद्दूरतरं यामि तावत्सा मृगतृष्णिका .. 48 ..
5.176.m: Then, setting out, as I advanced step by step, / the further I went, the more it was a mirage.

5.176.s:
etasminna ntare prāpto nabhomadhyaṃ divākaraḥ ..
vṛṣastho yena dahyāmi hyupariṣṭācchubhānanā .. 49 ..
5.176.d:
एतस्मिन्न न्तरे प्राप्तो नभोमध्यं दिवाकरः ..
वृषस्थो येन दह्यामि ह्युपरिष्टाच्छुभानना .. 49 ..
5.176.m: Meanwhile, the sun reached the middle of the sky; / stationed in Taurus, it scorched me from above, O fair-faced women,

5.176.s:
adhobhāge sutaptābhirvālukābhiḥ samaṃtataḥ ..
tṛṣṇārtā'haṃ tatastasminmarudeśe samākulā .. 6.177.50 ..
5.176.d:
अधोभागे सुतप्ताभिर्वालुकाभिः समंततः ..
तृष्णार्ताऽहं ततस्तस्मिन्मरुदेशे समाकुला .. 6.177.50 ..
5.176.m: while below [I was scorched] on all sides by the scorching sands. / Tormented by thirst, I then became distressed in that desert land.

5.176.s:
tataśca patitā bhūmau visphoṭakasamāvṛtā ..
tato mayā smṛtā citte kathā bhāratasaṃbhavā .. 51 ..
5.176.d:
ततश्च पतिता भूमौ विस्फोटकसमावृता ..
ततो मया स्मृता चित्ते कथा भारतसंभवा .. 51 ..
5.176.m: Then I fell to the ground, covered with blisters. / Thereupon, a story originating in the Mahābhārata was remembered in my mind:

5.176.s:
nṛgeṇa tu yathā yajño vālukābhirvinirmitaḥ ..
kūpāntaḥ kṣipyamāṇena tṛṇaloṣṭāṃbuvarjitam .. 52 ..
5.176.d:
नृगेण तु यथा यज्ञो वालुकाभिर्विनिर्मितः ..
कूपान्तः क्षिप्यमाणेन तृणलोष्टांबुवर्जितम् .. 52 ..
5.176.m: how a sacrifice was performed by Nṛga using sands / thrown into the well, devoid of grass, clods, and water.

5.176.s:
bhaktigrāhyāstato devāstuṣṭāstasya mahātmanaḥ..
tadahaṃ vālukābhiśca pūjayāmi harapriyām.. 53 ..
5.176.d:
भक्तिग्राह्यास्ततो देवास्तुष्टास्तस्य महात्मनः..
तदहं वालुकाभिश्च पूजयामि हरप्रियाम्.. 53 ..
5.176.m: The gods, pleased by devotion, were satisfied with that noble soul. / Therefore, I will worship the beloved of Hara with sands.

5.176.s:
tena tuṣṭā tu sā devī mama rājyaṃ prayacchati ..
adya dehāntare prāpte manobhīṣṭamanaṃtakam .. 54
5.176.d:
तेन तुष्टा तु सा देवी मम राज्यं प्रयच्छति ..
अद्य देहान्तरे प्राप्ते मनोभीष्टमनंतकम् .. 54
5.176.m: Pleased by this, that goddess will grant me sovereignty / now, when another body is attained, and an unending desire of the heart.

5.176.s:
tatastu paṃcabhirmantraistaireva smṛtimāgataiḥ ..
paṃcabhirmuṣṭibhirdevī vālukotthaiḥ prapūjitā .. 55 ..
5.176.d:
ततस्तु पंचभिर्मन्त्रैस्तैरेव स्मृतिमागतैः ..
पंचभिर्मुष्टिभिर्देवी वालुकोत्थैः प्रपूजिता .. 55 ..
5.176.m: Then, with those five mantras brought back to memory, / the goddess was worshipped with five handfuls made of sand.

5.176.s:
tataḥ pañcatvamāpannā tatkāle'haṃ varāṃganāḥ ..
daśārṇādhipaterjātā sadane lokaviśrute .. 56 ..
5.176.d:
ततः पञ्चत्वमापन्ना तत्कालेऽहं वरांगनाः ..
दशार्णाधिपतेर्जाता सदने लोकविश्रुते .. 56 ..
5.176.m: Then I met my death at that time, O noble women, / and was born in the world-renowned abode of the ruler of Daśārṇa.

5.176.s:
jātismaraṇasaṃyuktā tasyā devyāḥ prasādataḥ ..
bhavatīnāṃ kaniṣṭhāsmi jyeṣṭhā saubhāgyataḥ sthitā ..57 ..
5.176.d:
जातिस्मरणसंयुक्ता तस्या देव्याः प्रसादतः ..
भवतीनां कनिष्ठास्मि ज्येष्ठा सौभाग्यतः स्थिता ..57 ..
5.176.m: Endowed with remembrance of past lives through the grace of that goddess, / though the youngest among you, I stand as the foremost in good fortune.

5.176.s:
eta smātkāraṇādgaurīṃ muktvaitānpañcapiṇḍakān..
karddamena vidhāyātha pūjayāmi dinedine .. 58 ..
5.176.d:
एत स्मात्कारणाद्गौरीं मुक्त्वैतान्पञ्चपिण्डकान्..
कर्द्दमेन विधायाथ पूजयामि दिनेदिने .. 58 ..
5.176.m: For this reason, having fashioned these five lumps out of clay, / I worship Gaurī day after day, setting [other things] aside.

5.176.s:
etadguhyaṃ mayā khyātaṃ bhavatīnāmasaṃśayam ..
satyenānena me gaurī manobhīṣṭaṃ prayacchatu .. 59 ..
.. lakṣmīruvāca .. ..
tataḥ sarvāḥ sapatnyastāḥ kṛtāṃjalipuṭāḥ sthitāḥ ..
māmūcurvinayādvācā praṇipatya muhurmuhuḥ ..6.177.6...
5.176.d:
एतद्गुह्यं मया ख्यातं भवतीनामसंशयम् ..
सत्येनानेन मे गौरी मनोभीष्टं प्रयच्छतु .. 59 ..
.. लक्ष्मीरुवाच .. ..
ततः सर्वाः सपत्न्यस्ताः कृतांजलिपुटाः स्थिताः ..
मामूचुर्विनयाद्वाचा प्रणिपत्य मुहुर्मुहुः ..6.177.6...
5.176.m:
This secret has been declared by me to you without doubt. / By this truth, may Gaurī grant the desire of my heart.
Lakṣmī said: / Then all those co-wives stood with folded hands / and spoke to me with modest speech, bowing down again and again:

5.176.s:
prasādaṃ kuru cāsmākaṃ dīyatāṃ mantrapaṃcakam..
tadeva yena te devī tuṣṭā sā parameśvarī .. 61 ..
5.176.d:
प्रसादं कुरु चास्माकं दीयतां मन्त्रपंचकम्..
तदेव येन ते देवी तुष्टा सा परमेश्वरी .. 61 ..
5.176.m: “Bestow favor upon us and let the set of five mantras be given [to us], / that very one by which that goddess, the Supreme Mistress, was pleased with you.”

5.176.s:
mayā proktāśca tā sarvāḥ prārthayadhvaṃ yathecchayā ..
ahaṃ sarvaṃ pradāsyāmi tatsatyaṃ vacanaṃ mama .. 62 ..
5.176.d:
मया प्रोक्ताश्च ता सर्वाः प्रार्थयध्वं यथेच्छया ..
अहं सर्वं प्रदास्यामि तत्सत्यं वचनं मम .. 62 ..
5.176.m: And all of them were told by me: “Ask according to your wish; / I shall grant everything; this is my true word.”

5.176.s:
tato deva mayā proktaṃ tāsāṃ tanmaṃtrapaṃcakam ..
śiṣyatvaṃ gamitānāṃ ca vāṅmanaḥkāyakarmabhiḥ .. 63 ..
5.176.d:
ततो देव मया प्रोक्तं तासां तन्मंत्रपंचकम् ..
शिष्यत्वं गमितानां च वाङ्मनःकायकर्मभिः .. 63 ..
5.176.m: Then, O Lord, that set of five mantras was spoken by me to them / after they were accepted as disciples through deeds of speech, mind, and body.

5.176.s:
.. viṣṇuruvāca .. ..
mamāpi vada deveśi kīdṛktanmantrapañcakam ..
yattvayā'nuṣṭhitaṃ pūrvaṃ tayā tāsāṃ nivedi tam.. 64 ..
5.176.d:
.. विष्णुरुवाच .. ..
ममापि वद देवेशि कीदृक्तन्मन्त्रपञ्चकम् ..
यत्त्वयाऽनुष्ठितं पूर्वं तया तासां निवेदि तम्.. 64 ..
5.176.m: Viṣṇu said: / Tell me also, O Queen of the gods, what kind of set of five mantras was that / which was formerly practiced by you and revealed to them by her?

5.176.s:
.. lakṣmīruvāca .. ..
namaḥ pṛthivyai kṣāṃtīśi nama āpomaye śubhe ..
tejasvini namastubhyaṃ namaste vāyurūpiṇi .. 65 ..
5.176.d:
.. लक्ष्मीरुवाच .. ..
नमः पृथिव्यै क्षांतीशि नम आपोमये शुभे ..
तेजस्विनि नमस्तुभ्यं नमस्ते वायुरूपिणि .. 65 ..
5.176.m: Lakṣmī said: / “Salutations to the Earth, the Ruler of patience! Salutations to the Auspicious One composed of water! / Salutations to you, O Radiant One! Salutations to you whose form is wind!

5.176.s: ākāśarūpasaṃpanne paṃcarūpe namonamaḥ .. 66 ..
5.176.d: आकाशरूपसंपन्ने पंचरूपे नमोनमः .. 66 ..
5.176.m: O you who are endowed with the form of space, you who have five forms, salutations, salutations!”

5.176.s:
ebhirmantrairmayā pūrvaṃ pūjitā parameśvarī ..
tena rājyaṃ mayā prāptaṃ sarvastrīṇāṃ sudurlabham .. 67 ..
5.176.d:
एभिर्मन्त्रैर्मया पूर्वं पूजिता परमेश्वरी ..
तेन राज्यं मया प्राप्तं सर्वस्त्रीणां सुदुर्लभम् .. 67 ..
5.176.m: With these mantras the Supreme Mistress was worshipped by me in the past; / through that, I attained sovereignty, which is very difficult for all women to obtain.

5.176.s:
tataśca sthāpitā devī kṛtvā ratnamayī śubhā ..
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre mayā tatra sureśvara .. 68 ..
5.176.d:
ततश्च स्थापिता देवी कृत्वा रत्नमयी शुभा ..
हाटकेश्वरजे क्षेत्रे मया तत्र सुरेश्वर .. 68 ..
5.176.m: And then, having made an auspicious [image] out of jewels, / the goddess was established by me there in the sacred field of Hāṭakeśvara, O lord of gods.

5.176.s:
tāṃ yā pūjayate nārī sadyo'pi pativallabhā ..
jāyate nātra sandehaḥ sarvapāpavivarjitā .. 69 ..
5.176.d:
तां या पूजयते नारी सद्योऽपि पतिवल्लभा ..
जायते नात्र सन्देहः सर्वपापविवर्जिता .. 69 ..
5.176.m: Whatever woman worships her immediately becomes beloved to her husband, / freed from all sins; of this there is no doubt.

5.176.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye pañcapiṃḍikotpatti māhātmya varṇanaṃ nāma saptasaptatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 177 ..
5.176.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये पञ्चपिंडिकोत्पत्ति माहात्म्य वर्णनं नाम सप्तसप्तत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 177 ..
5.176.m: Thus ends the one hundred and seventy-seventh chapter, entitled “Description of the Māhātmya of the Origin of the Five Lumps” in the Māhātmya of the Sacred Field of Hāṭakeśvara in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] of the eighty-one-thousand-verse collection in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa.

5.177.s:
.. lakṣmīruvāca .. ..
evaṃ rājyaṃ mayā prāptaṃ gaurīpūjā kṛte vibho ..
saubhāgyaṃ paramaṃ caiva durlabhaṃ sarvayoṣitām.. 1 ..
5.177.d:
.. लक्ष्मीरुवाच .. ..
एवं राज्यं मया प्राप्तं गौरीपूजा कृते विभो ..
सौभाग्यं परमं चैव दुर्लभं सर्वयोषिताम्.. 1 ..
5.177.m: Lakṣmī said: / Thus, O all-pervading lord, sovereignty was obtained by me by worshipping Gaurī, / as well as supreme good fortune, difficult for all women to obtain.

5.177.s:
na cāpatyaṃ mayā labdhaṃ tathāpi parameśvara ..
tādṛśe'pi ca saubhāgye tāruṇye tādṛśe sthite .. 2 ..
5.177.d:
न चापत्यं मया लब्धं तथापि परमेश्वर ..
तादृशेऽपि च सौभाग्ये तारुण्ये तादृशे स्थिते .. 2 ..
5.177.m: Yet, O Supreme Lord, no child was obtained by me, / even when such good fortune and such youth were present.

5.177.s:
dahyāmi tena duḥkhena divānaktaṃ sukhaṃ na me ..
kasyacittvatha kālasya durvāsā munisattamaḥ .. 3 ..
5.177.d:
दह्यामि तेन दुःखेन दिवानक्तं सुखं न मे ..
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य दुर्वासा मुनिसत्तमः .. 3 ..
5.177.m: I was burned by that sorrow; day and night I had no happiness. / Then, after some time, Durvāsas, the best of sages,

5.177.s:
ānartādhipaterharmyaṃ saṃprāpto gauravāya saḥ...
cāturmāsyakṛte caiva mṛttikāgrahaṇāya ca ... 4..
5.177.d:
आनर्ताधिपतेर्हर्म्यं संप्राप्तो गौरवाय सः...
चातुर्मास्यकृते चैव मृत्तिकाग्रहणाय च ... 4..
5.177.m: came to the palace of the ruler of Ānarta to receive honor, / and to take clay for the observance of the four months of the rainy season.

5.177.s:
tataḥ saṃpūjito rājñā ānartena yathākramam..
dattvārghyaṃ madhuparkaṃ ca tataḥ proktaṃ praṇamya ca..5..
5.177.d:
ततः संपूजितो राज्ञा आनर्तेन यथाक्रमम्..
दत्त्वार्घ्यं मधुपर्कं च ततः प्रोक्तं प्रणम्य च..5..
5.177.m: Then, duly worshipped by the king of Ānarta, / having offered the water of welcome and the honey-mixture, [the king] bowed down and spoke:

5.177.s:
svāgataṃ te muniśreṣṭha bhūyaḥ susvāgataṃ ca te..
nānyo dhanyatamo loke bhūyo'sti sadṛśo mayā..6..
5.177.d:
स्वागतं ते मुनिश्रेष्ठ भूयः सुस्वागतं च ते..
नान्यो धन्यतमो लोके भूयोऽस्ति सदृशो मया..6..
5.177.m: ‘Welcome to you, best of sages, and welcome again to you! / In this world there is none more fortunate than me, nor any like me.

5.177.s:
yau te pādau rajodhvastau keśairme nirmalīkṛtau..
tadbrūhi kiṃkaromyadya gṛhāyātasya te mune .. 7 ..
5.177.d:
यौ ते पादौ रजोध्वस्तौ केशैर्मे निर्मलीकृतौ..
तद्ब्रूहि किंकरोम्यद्य गृहायातस्य ते मुने .. 7 ..
5.177.m: Those two feet of yours, covered with dust, have been cleansed by my hair. / Therefore tell me, sage: what shall I do for you who have come to my house today?

5.177.s: api rājyaṃ prayacchāmi kā vārtānyeṣu vastuṣu .. 8 ..
5.177.d: अपि राज्यं प्रयच्छामि का वार्तान्येषु वस्तुषु .. 8 ..
5.177.m: I would even give my kingdom; what to speak of other things?’

5.177.s:
.. durvāsā uvāca .. ..
cāturmāsīvidhānaṃ te kariṣye nṛpa maṃdire ..
mṛttikāgrahaṇaṃ tāvacchuśrūṣā kriyatāṃ mama ..
sa tatheti pratijñāya māmūce pārthivottamaḥ .. 9 ..
5.177.d:
.. दुर्वासा उवाच .. ..
चातुर्मासीविधानं ते करिष्ये नृप मंदिरे ..
मृत्तिकाग्रहणं तावच्छुश्रूषा क्रियतां मम ..
स तथेति प्रतिज्ञाय मामूचे पार्थिवोत्तमः .. 9 ..
5.177.m: Durvāsas said: / ‘I shall perform the Cāturmāsya observance in your palace, O king, / [and] the gathering of clay; so let service be rendered to me.’ / Having agreed with ‘So be it,’ the best of kings said to me:

5.177.s:
śuśrūṣā cāsya kartavyā sarva daiva varānane ..
cāturmāsīvrataṃ yāvaddevatārcanapūrvakam .. 6.178.10 ..
5.177.d:
शुश्रूषा चास्य कर्तव्या सर्व दैव वरानने ..
चातुर्मासीव्रतं यावद्देवतार्चनपूर्वकम् .. 6.178.10 ..
5.177.m: ‘Service must be rendered to him constantly, O fair-faced woman, / until the Cāturmāsya vow, preceded by the worship of the deities, [is completed].’

5.177.s:
bāḍhamityevamuktvātha mayā sarvamanuṣṭhitam ..
śuśrūṣārhaṃ ca yatkarma duhiteva pituryathā ... .. 11 ..
5.177.d:
बाढमित्येवमुक्त्वाथ मया सर्वमनुष्ठितम् ..
शुश्रूषार्हं च यत्कर्म दुहितेव पितुर्यथा ... .. 11 ..
5.177.m: Having said ‘Very well,’ everything was carried out by me, / every duty worthy of service, like a daughter [serving] her father.

5.177.s:
cāturmāsyāṃ vyatītāyāṃ yadā saṃprasthito muniḥ ..
tadā provāca māṃ tuṣṭaḥ putri kiṃ karavāṇi te .. 12 ..
5.177.d:
चातुर्मास्यां व्यतीतायां यदा संप्रस्थितो मुनिः ..
तदा प्रोवाच मां तुष्टः पुत्रि किं करवाणि ते .. 12 ..
5.177.m: When the four-month period had passed and the sage was about to depart, / he, well pleased, spoke to me: ‘Daughter, what can I do for you?’

5.177.s:
tataḥ sa bhagavānproktaḥ praṇipatya mayā muhuḥ ..
apatyaṃ nāsti me brahmaṃstena dahyāmyaharniśam .. 13 ..
5.177.d:
ततः स भगवान्प्रोक्तः प्रणिपत्य मया मुहुः ..
अपत्यं नास्ति मे ब्रह्मंस्तेन दह्याम्यहर्निशम् .. 13 ..
5.177.m: Then that blessed one was addressed by me, repeatedly bowing down: / ‘I have no offspring, O holy one; because of that I burn day and night.

5.177.s:
īdṛśe sati rājño'pi yauvane ca mahattare ..
tattvaṃ vada muniśreṣṭha yena syānmama saṃtatiḥ .. 14 ..
5.177.d:
ईदृशे सति राज्ञोऽपि यौवने च महत्तरे ..
तत्त्वं वद मुनिश्रेष्ठ येन स्यान्मम संततिः .. 14 ..
5.177.m: Even though such a king exists and my youth is in its prime, / tell me the truth, best of sages, by which offspring may be mine,

5.177.s:
vratena niyamenātha dānena ca hutena ca ..
tataḥ sa suciraṃ dhyātvā māmuvāca smayanniva .. 15 ..
5.177.d:
व्रतेन नियमेनाथ दानेन च हुतेन च ..
ततः स सुचिरं ध्यात्वा मामुवाच स्मयन्निव .. 15 ..
5.177.m: by a vow, a religious observance, by gifts, or by fire-offerings.’ / Then, having meditated for a very long time, he said to me, smiling as it were:

5.177.s:
anyadehāṃtare putri tvayā gaurī prapūjitā ..
taptābhirvālukābhiḥ sā mṛtyukāla upasthite .. 16 ..
5.177.d:
अन्यदेहांतरे पुत्रि त्वया गौरी प्रपूजिता ..
तप्ताभिर्वालुकाभिः सा मृत्युकाल उपस्थिते .. 16 ..
5.177.m: ‘In another birth, daughter, Gaurī was worshipped by you / with heated sands when the time of death had arrived.

5.177.s:
tadbhaktyā labdharājyāpi dāhena pariyujyase ..
gaurī yattāpasaṃyuktā bālukābhiḥ kṛtā tvayā .. 17 ..
5.177.d:
तद्भक्त्या लब्धराज्यापि दाहेन परियुज्यसे ..
गौरी यत्तापसंयुक्ता बालुकाभिः कृता त्वया .. 17 ..
5.177.m: Through devotion to her, though you have obtained a kingdom, you are afflicted by burning heat, / because Gaurī was made by you with heated sands.

5.177.s:
na devo vidyate kāṣṭhe pāṣāṇe mṛttikāsu ca ..
bhāveṣu vidyate devo mantrasaṃyogasaṃyutaḥ .. 18 ..
5.177.d:
न देवो विद्यते काष्ठे पाषाणे मृत्तिकासु च ..
भावेषु विद्यते देवो मन्त्रसंयोगसंयुतः .. 18 ..
5.177.m: A deity does not reside in wood, nor in stone, nor in clays; / a deity resides in devotion, united with the application of mantras.

5.177.s:
bhāvabhaktisamā yuktā maṃtrasaṃyojanena ca ..
devī mantrasamāyātā tvayā vālukayā'rcitā .. 19 ..
5.177.d:
भावभक्तिसमा युक्ता मंत्रसंयोजनेन च ..
देवी मन्त्रसमायाता त्वया वालुकयाऽर्चिता .. 19 ..
5.177.m: Conjoined with the devotion of feelings and by the employment of mantras, / the Goddess, summoned by mantras, was worshipped by you with sand.

5.177.s:
tvatkāye tena saṃtāpaḥ sarvadā'yaṃ vyavasthitaḥ..
tasmādratnamayīṃ gaurīṃ kṛtvā tvaṃ paṃcapiṃḍikām ..
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre saṃsthāpaya śubhānane ..6.178.20..
5.177.d:
त्वत्काये तेन संतापः सर्वदाऽयं व्यवस्थितः..
तस्माद्रत्नमयीं गौरीं कृत्वा त्वं पंचपिंडिकाम् ..
हाटकेश्वरजे क्षेत्रे संस्थापय शुभानने ..6.178.20..
5.177.m: Therefore this burning sensation is ever present in your body. / For that reason, having fashioned Gaurī of gems in five lumps, / install her in the sacred field of Hāṭakeśvara, O woman of lovely face!

5.177.s:
vṛṣasthe bhāskare paścāttasyā upari srāvi yat ..
jalayantraṃ divārātraṃ dhārayasva prayatnataḥ .. 21 ..
5.177.d:
वृषस्थे भास्करे पश्चात्तस्या उपरि स्रावि यत् ..
जलयन्त्रं दिवारात्रं धारयस्व प्रयत्नतः .. 21 ..
5.177.m: Then, when the sun is in Taurus, carefully place above her / a water-dripping device, flowing day and night.

5.177.s:
tato yathāyathā tasyāḥ śītabhāvo bhaviṣyati ..
tathātathā ca te dāhaḥ śāṃtiṃ yāsyatyaharniśam .. 22 ..
5.177.d:
ततो यथायथा तस्याः शीतभावो भविष्यति ..
तथातथा च ते दाहः शांतिं यास्यत्यहर्निशम् .. 22 ..
5.177.m: Then, just as coolness comes to her, / so too your burning heat will be pacified day and night.

5.177.s:
dāhāṃte bhavitā garbhastataḥ putramavāpsyasi ..
rājyabhārakṣamaṃ śūraṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam .. 23 ..
5.177.d:
दाहांते भविता गर्भस्ततः पुत्रमवाप्स्यसि ..
राज्यभारक्षमं शूरं त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतम् .. 23 ..
5.177.m: At the end of the burning heat, conception will occur; then you will obtain a son / capable of bearing the burden of the kingdom, valorous, celebrated in the three worlds.

5.177.s:
anyāpi kāminī yātra evaṃ tāṃ pūjayiṣyati ..
jyeṣṭhe māse tathā sāpi yathā tvaṃ prabhaviṣyati .. 24 ..
5.177.d:
अन्यापि कामिनी यात्र एवं तां पूजयिष्यति ..
ज्येष्ठे मासे तथा सापि यथा त्वं प्रभविष्यति .. 24 ..
5.177.m: Any other lovely woman here who will worship her thus / in the month of Jyeṣṭha, she too will prosper just like you.’

5.177.s:
.. lakṣmīruvāca .. ..
tato mayā punaḥ prokto bhagavānsa munīśvaraḥ ..
mānuṣatve na me rāgo viraktirmahatī sthitā .. 25 ..
5.177.d:
.. लक्ष्मीरुवाच .. ..
ततो मया पुनः प्रोक्तो भगवान्स मुनीश्वरः ..
मानुषत्वे न मे रागो विरक्तिर्महती स्थिता .. 25 ..
5.177.m: Lakṣmī said: / ‘Then that blessed lord of sages was addressed again by me: / “I have no attachment to human existence; great detachment has arisen [in me],

5.177.s:
nadīvegopamaṃ dṛṣṭvā jīvitaṃsarvadehinām ..
tanme vada mahābhāga yatkiṃcid vratamuttamam .. 26 ..
5.177.d:
नदीवेगोपमं दृष्ट्वा जीवितंसर्वदेहिनाम् ..
तन्मे वद महाभाग यत्किंचिद् व्रतमुत्तमम् .. 26 ..
5.177.m: seeing the life of all embodied beings to be like the rushing torrent of a river. / Therefore tell me, fortunate one, some supreme vow

5.177.s:
mānuṣatvaṃ na yena syātsamyakcīrṇena saddvija ..
tataḥ sa suciraṃ dhyātvā māmāha parameśvara .. 27 ..
5.177.d:
मानुषत्वं न येन स्यात्सम्यक्चीर्णेन सद्द्विज ..
ततः स सुचिरं ध्यात्वा मामाह परमेश्वर .. 27 ..
5.177.m: by which, being properly observed, human birth will not recur, O good twice-born.” / Then, having meditated for a very long time, he said to me, O supreme lord:

5.177.s:
asti putri vrataṃ puṇyaṃ gaurī tuṣṭikaraṃ param ..
yena cīrṇena vai samyagyoṣiddevatvamāpnuyāt .. 28 ..
5.177.d:
अस्ति पुत्रि व्रतं पुण्यं गौरी तुष्टिकरं परम् ..
येन चीर्णेन वै सम्यग्योषिद्देवत्वमाप्नुयात् .. 28 ..
5.177.m: “There is, daughter, a sacred vow that brings great delight to Gaurī, / by which, when properly observed, a woman attains divinity.

5.177.s:
gomayākhyā mahādevī kṛtā vai gomayena sā ..
tato golokamāpannāḥ sarvāstā varavarṇini .. 29 ..
5.177.d:
गोमयाख्या महादेवी कृता वै गोमयेन सा ..
ततो गोलोकमापन्नाः सर्वास्ता वरवर्णिनि .. 29 ..
5.177.m: That Great Goddess called Gomayā was fashioned indeed of cow dung; / hence all those [women] attained Goloka, O woman of excellent complexion!

5.177.s:
tāṃ tvaṃ kuruṣva kalyāṇi yena devatvamāpsyasi ..
tato mayā punaḥ proktaḥ sa muniḥ surasattama .. 6.178.30 ..
5.177.d:
तां त्वं कुरुष्व कल्याणि येन देवत्वमाप्स्यसि ..
ततो मया पुनः प्रोक्तः स मुनिः सुरसत्तम .. 6.178.30 ..
5.177.m: Perform that [vow], auspicious one, by which you will attain divinity.” / Then that sage was asked again by me, best of gods:

5.177.s:
kasminkāle prakartavyā vidhinā kena sanmune ..
sarvaṃ vistarato brūhi yena tāṃ prakaromyaham .. 31 ..
5.177.d:
कस्मिन्काले प्रकर्तव्या विधिना केन सन्मुने ..
सर्वं विस्तरतो ब्रूहि येन तां प्रकरोम्यहम् .. 31 ..
5.177.m: “At what time must it be performed, and by what rite, O good sage? / Tell me everything in detail, so that I may perform it.”

5.177.s:
.. durvāsā uvāca .. ..
nabhasye cāsite pakṣe tṛtīyādivase sthite..
prātarutthāya paścācca bhakṣayeddaṃtadhāvanam..32..
5.177.d:
.. दुर्वासा उवाच .. ..
नभस्ये चासिते पक्षे तृतीयादिवसे स्थिते..
प्रातरुत्थाय पश्चाच्च भक्षयेद्दंतधावनम्..32..
5.177.m: Durvāsas said: / “In the month of Bhādrapada, during the dark fortnight, on the third day, / having risen in the morning, one should then chew the tooth-cleansing stick.

5.177.s:
tataśca niyamaṃ kṛtvā upavāsasamudbhavam..
gaurīnāmasamuccārya śraddhāpūtena cetasā .. 33 ..
5.177.d:
ततश्च नियमं कृत्वा उपवाससमुद्भवम्..
गौरीनामसमुच्चार्य श्रद्धापूतेन चेतसा .. 33 ..
5.177.m: Then, having taken the resolve of fasting, / uttering the name of Gaurī with a mind purified by faith,

5.177.s:
tato niśāgame prāpte kṛtvā gaurīcatuṣṭayam ..
mṛnmayaṃ yādṛśaṃ caiva tadihaikamanāḥ śṛṇu .. 34 ..
5.177.d:
ततो निशागमे प्राप्ते कृत्वा गौरीचतुष्टयम् ..
मृन्मयं यादृशं चैव तदिहैकमनाः शृणु .. 34 ..
5.177.m: and then, when night arrives, having fashioned four Gaurīs / made of clay—listen with one-pointed mind to how they should be:

5.177.s:
ekā gaurī prakartavyā paṃcapiṃḍā yathoditā ..
prahareprahare prāpte tāsu pūjāṃ samācaret ..
yairmaṃtraistānnibodha tvamekaikasyāḥ pṛthakpṛthak .. 35 ..
5.177.d:
एका गौरी प्रकर्तव्या पंचपिंडा यथोदिता ..
प्रहरेप्रहरे प्राप्ते तासु पूजां समाचरेत् ..
यैर्मंत्रैस्तान्निबोध त्वमेकैकस्याः पृथक्पृथक् .. 35 ..
5.177.m: One Gaurī should be made of five lumps, as described. / As each watch of the day arrives, one should perform worship to them; / learn from me the mantras for each of them separately:

5.177.s:
himācalagṛhe jātā devi tvaṃ śaṃkarapriye ..
menāgarbhasamudbhūtā pūjāṃ gṛhṇa namostu te .. 36 ..
5.177.d:
हिमाचलगृहे जाता देवि त्वं शंकरप्रिये ..
मेनागर्भसमुद्भूता पूजां गृह्ण नमोस्तु ते .. 36 ..
5.177.m: ‘O Goddess born in the house of the Himālaya, beloved of Śaṃkara, / born from the womb of Menā, accept this worship, homage to you!’

5.177.s:
dhūpaṃ dadyāttataścaiva karpūraṃ śraddhayā saha ..
raktasūtreṇa dīpaṃ ca ghṛtena parikalpayet .. 37 ..
5.177.d:
धूपं दद्यात्ततश्चैव कर्पूरं श्रद्धया सह ..
रक्तसूत्रेण दीपं च घृतेन परिकल्पयेत् .. 37 ..
5.177.m: Then one should offer incense, and camphor along with faith, / and prepare a lamp with red thread and with ghee.

5.177.s:
jātipuṣpaiḥ samabhyarcya naivedye modakānnyaset ..
raktavastreṇa saṃchādya arghyaṃ dattvā tataḥ param .. 38 ..
5.177.d:
जातिपुष्पैः समभ्यर्च्य नैवेद्ये मोदकान्न्यसेत् ..
रक्तवस्त्रेण संछाद्य अर्घ्यं दत्त्वा ततः परम् .. 38 ..
5.177.m: Having worshipped with jasmine flowers, one should place sweetmeats as food-offering; / having covered it with red cloth, and having offered the water of welcome thereafter,

5.177.s:
yasya vṛkṣasya puṣpaṃ ca tasya syāddantadhāvanam ..
mātuliṃgena tasyāstu mantreṇānena bhaktitaḥ .. 39 ..
5.177.d:
यस्य वृक्षस्य पुष्पं च तस्य स्याद्दन्तधावनम् ..
मातुलिंगेन तस्यास्तु मन्त्रेणानेन भक्तितः .. 39 ..

"O deities Umā and Maheśvara, bestowers of the pleasure of all desires, / having shown the greatest compassion, accept this arghya of mine!"
When the fourth watch has arrived, having worshipped that Gaurī of the five balls / with bhṛṅgarāja with devotion, using this mantra:
"O ruler of gods, who consist of the five forms that are declared as the five elements beginning with earth, / accept [my] worship! Obeisance be to you!"
For the food offering, one should devoutly present cakes fried in ghee to the Goddess, / incense with knot-powder, and an arghya of madana fruit; / that very [fruit] is to be consumed, and this is remembered as the mantra for the arghya:
"May the goddess who consists of the five elements and abides in fivefold form, / that ruler of the gods, accept this arghya offered by me!"
Thus that entire night should be spent before them with the sounds of songs, musical instruments, and the like; / one should not sleep at all.
Then in the clear dawn, when the orb of the sun has risen, / having bathed, one should devoutly worship a brahmin along with his wife,

with garments and ornaments according to one's means, O princess; / and food consisting of sweet rice should be offered to Gaurī, O fair-smiling lady!
Then, having brought a female elephant or a mare, O slender-waisted lady, / and having placed that group of four Gaurīs upon it,
with the sound of songs and instruments, accompanied by the chanting of the Vedas, / one should cast them into a river, a pond, or a step-well,
with true devotion using this mantra; I speak this to you, O beautiful woman:
"You were invoked by me, O Goddess; you were worshipped by me, O auspicious one! / For bestowing good fortune upon me, depart as you please."
Lakṣmī said: / "Thus, O Lord, that tṛtīyā was observed by me as described, / when the month of Nabhasya arrived, with supreme devotion, O all-pervading one!
And likewise when the second arrived, and especially the third: / as I looked at dawn, the group of four Gaurīs, / which had been worshipped by me, had turned into jewels.

5.177.m:
When I set out towards the riverbank intending to perform the immersion, / that ruler of gods appeared and spoke to me:
'Do not, O daughter, [throw] my four forms into the water here! / Reflect upon my words, and having heard them, act accordingly.
Install [them] in the sacred field of Hāṭakeśvara; do not throw [them away]! / Thereby it will become imperishable, and benefit all women.
Ask for any boon; worshipped here, I grant it.' / When the daughter of the mountain, the ruler of gods, was worshipped, she was addressed by me:
'If, pleased, you grant me a boon, O Goddess, O ruler of gods, / then may I never be born in a human womb!
May Viṣṇu be my husband, ever the bestower of eternal desires! / I desire no other thing, not even sovereignty beautified by heaven.
And whatever other woman performs this vow with concentrated mind, / just as satisfaction arises through all vows, O Goddess, so may it arise

for her through this single one, O Pārvatī!' / Having said to me, 'So be it,' Gaurī then disappeared.
And that Goddess, that group of four Gaurīs, / was installed by me there in the auspicious sacred field of Hāṭakeśvara, O Lord.
By that power, you, O Supreme Lord, were attained by me as husband, / eternal, imperishable, and always attentive to my face.
All this which I was asked has been told to you, O Lord of gods! / By this truth, O Lord of gods, I touch your feet."
Sūta said: / Having heard those words of hers, the wielder of the conch, discus, and mace, / smiled and, overjoyed, spoke to that Mahālakṣmī, / repeatedly embracing her as she rested upon his chest:
"Well done, well done, O fortunate lady! True is this that was spoken by you. / Though knowing it, you were questioned by me, O fair-complexioned lady!"
Sūta said: / All this that I was asked has been told to you, O best of the twice-born: / how Gaurī became four-armed and [worshipped as] five balls.

5.177.s:
yaścaitatpaṭhate bhaktyā prātarutthāya mānavaḥ ..
na sa lakṣmyā vimucyeta na ca daurbhāgyamāpnuyāt .. 79 ..
tasmātsarvaprayatnena paṭhanīyamidaṃ śubham ..
ākhyānaṃ gaurikaṃ viprā yanmayā parikīrtitam .. 6.178.80 ..
iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye paṃcapiṃḍikāgauryutpattimāhātmya varṇanaṃnāmāṣṭasaptatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 178 .. ..9..
5.177.d:
यश्चैतत्पठते भक्त्या प्रातरुत्थाय मानवः ..
न स लक्ष्म्या विमुच्येत न च दौर्भाग्यमाप्नुयात् .. 79 ..
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन पठनीयमिदं शुभम् ..
आख्यानं गौरिकं विप्रा यन्मया परिकीर्तितम् .. 6.178.80 ..
इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये पंचपिंडिकागौर्युत्पत्तिमाहात्म्य वर्णनंनामाष्टसप्तत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 178 .. ..9..
5.177.m:
And whatever person reads this with devotion, having risen in the morning, / will not be abandoned by Lakṣmī, nor will they encounter misfortune.
Therefore, with every effort, this auspicious narrative / concerning Gaurī, which has been recounted by me, should be read, O brahmins.
Thus ends the one hundred and seventy-eighth chapter, entitled "The Description of the Māhātmya of the Origin of Pañcapiṇḍikā Gaurī," in the Māhātmya of the Sacred Field of Hāṭakeśvara in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] of the eighty-one-thousand-verse collection of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa.

5.178.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tathānyadapi tatrāsti puṣkaratritayaṃ śubham ..
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre sarvapātakanāśanam .. 1 ..
5.178.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तथान्यदपि तत्रास्ति पुष्करत्रितयं शुभम् ..
हाटकेश्वरजे क्षेत्रे सर्वपातकनाशनम् .. 1 ..
5.178.m: Sūta said: / Likewise, there is another auspicious triad of Puṣkaras there, / in the sacred field of Hāṭakeśvara, destroying all sins,

5.178.s:
yasmindṛṣṭe'thavā spṛṣṭe kīrtite vā dvijottamāḥ ..
pātakaṃ nāśamāyāti bhāskareṇa tamo yathā .. 2 ..
punaṃti sarvatīrthāni snānāddānādasaṃśayam ..
puṣkarālokanādeva sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate .. 3 ..
5.178.d:
यस्मिन्दृष्टेऽथवा स्पृष्टे कीर्तिते वा द्विजोत्तमाः ..
पातकं नाशमायाति भास्करेण तमो यथा .. 2 ..
पुनंति सर्वतीर्थानि स्नानाद्दानादसंशयम् ..
पुष्करालोकनादेव सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते .. 3 ..
5.178.m: at the sight, touch, or glorification of which, O best of the twice-born, / sin is destroyed just as darkness is by the sun. / All sacred fords purify through bathing and giving, without doubt; / yet by merely beholding Puṣkara, one is freed from all sins.

5.178.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
śrūyate puṣkaraṃnāma tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam ..
brahmaṇā nirmitaṃ tatra yacca yojanamātrakam .. 4 ..
5.178.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
श्रूयते पुष्करंनाम तीर्थं त्रैलोक्यविश्रुतम् ..
ब्रह्मणा निर्मितं तत्र यच्च योजनमात्रकम् .. 4 ..
5.178.m: The seers said: / A sacred ford named Puṣkara is renowned in the three worlds, / which was created there by Brahmā and measures only a yojana.

5.178.s:
uttare candrabhāgāyā nadyā yāvatsarasvatī ..
dakṣiṇe karatoyāyāḥ sīmeyaṃ puṣkaratraye .. 5 ..
5.178.d:
उत्तरे चन्द्रभागाया नद्या यावत्सरस्वती ..
दक्षिणे करतोयायाः सीमेयं पुष्करत्रये .. 5 ..
5.178.m: North of the Candrabhāgā river as far as the Sarasvatī, / and south of the Karatoyā—this is the boundary of the triad of Puṣkaras.

5.178.s:
asmākaṃ tu purā sūta tvayoktaṃ viyati sthitam ..
etannaḥ kautukaṃ sūta tatkathaṃ hāṭakeśvare ..
tatra kṣetre samāyātaṃ tasmāttvaṃ vaktumarhasi .. 6 ..
5.178.d:
अस्माकं तु पुरा सूत त्वयोक्तं वियति स्थितम् ..
एतन्नः कौतुकं सूत तत्कथं हाटकेश्वरे ..
तत्र क्षेत्रे समायातं तस्मात्त्वं वक्तुमर्हसि .. 6 ..
5.178.m: Yet previously, O Sūta, it was told by you to us as being situated in the sky. / This is our curiosity, O Sūta: how did it come there / to the sacred field of Hāṭakeśvara? Therefore, you should explain [it].

5.178.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
satyametanmahābhāgā yadbhavadbhirudāhṛtam ..
tasminkṣetre dvijaśreṣṭhāstacchṛṇudhvaṃ samāhitāḥ .. 7 ..
5.178.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
सत्यमेतन्महाभागा यद्भवद्भिरुदाहृतम् ..
तस्मिन्क्षेत्रे द्विजश्रेष्ठास्तच्छृणुध्वं समाहिताः .. 7 ..
5.178.m: Sūta said: / This which has been spoken by you, O fortunate ones, is true. / Listen attentively, O best of brahmins, to what concerns that sacred field. 7

5.178.s: sarvato vistarādvacmi namaskṛtya svayaṃ bhuvam .. 8 ..
5.178.d: सर्वतो विस्तराद्वच्मि नमस्कृत्य स्वयं भुवम् .. 8 ..
5.178.m: Having bowed to the self-manifest one, I shall declare it completely in full detail. 8

5.178.s:
brahmaloke nivasato brahmaṇo'vyaktajanmanaḥ ..
devarṣirnāradaḥ prāpto bhrāṃtvā lokatrayaṃ muniḥ .. 9 ..
5.178.d:
ब्रह्मलोके निवसतो ब्रह्मणोऽव्यक्तजन्मनः ..
देवर्षिर्नारदः प्राप्तो भ्रांत्वा लोकत्रयं मुनिः .. 9 ..
5.178.m: As Brahmā, who has the unmanifest birth, was residing in the world of Brahmā, / the divine seer Nārada, the sage, having wandered through the three worlds, arrived. 9

5.178.s: sa natvā śirasā pādāvupaviṣṭasta dagrataḥ .. 6.179.10 ..
5.178.d: स नत्वा शिरसा पादावुपविष्टस्त दग्रतः .. 6.179.10 ..
5.178.m: Having bowed to his feet with his head, he sat down before him. 10

5.178.s:
.. brahmovāca .. ..
kasmādvatsa cirāddṛṣṭaḥ kutaḥ prāpto'dhunā bhavān..
kva bhrāṃtastvaṃ samācakṣva brūhi vatsātra kāraṇam .. 11 .. ..
5.178.d:
.. ब्रह्मोवाच .. ..
कस्माद्वत्स चिराद्दृष्टः कुतः प्राप्तोऽधुना भवान्..
क्व भ्रांतस्त्वं समाचक्ष्व ब्रूहि वत्सात्र कारणम् .. 11 .. ..
5.178.m: Brahmā said: / Why, my child, have you been seen [only] after a long time? Where have you come from now? / Where have you wandered? Tell me, my child; tell me the reason here. 11

5.178.s:
.. nārada uvāca .. ..
martyalokādvibho prāptaḥ sāṃprataṃ ca tvarānvitaḥ ..
tava pādaprapūjārthaṃ satyenātmānamālabhe .. 12 ..
5.178.d:
.. नारद उवाच .. ..
मर्त्यलोकाद्विभो प्राप्तः सांप्रतं च त्वरान्वितः ..
तव पादप्रपूजार्थं सत्येनात्मानमालभे .. 12 ..
5.178.m: Nārada said: / I have just now arrived from the mortal world in haste, O lord, / in order to worship your feet; I swear to you in truth. 12

5.178.s:
.. brahmovāca .. ..
kiṃvadantīṃ mamācakṣva martyalokasamudbhavām ..
kīdṛśāḥ pārthivāstatra kīdṛśā dvijasattamāḥ ..
kīdṛśā vyavahārāśca vartante tatra sāṃpratam .. 13 .. ..
5.178.d:
.. ब्रह्मोवाच .. ..
किंवदन्तीं ममाचक्ष्व मर्त्यलोकसमुद्भवाम् ..
कीदृशाः पार्थिवास्तत्र कीदृशा द्विजसत्तमाः ..
कीदृशा व्यवहाराश्च वर्तन्ते तत्र सांप्रतम् .. 13 .. ..
5.178.m: Brahmā said: / Tell me the report that arises from the mortal world. / What are the kings like there? What are the best of brahmins like? / And what sorts of conduct prevail there now? 13

5.178.s:
.. nārada uvāca .. ..
martyaloke kalirjātaḥ sāṃprataṃ surasattama .. 14 ..
5.178.d:
.. नारद उवाच .. ..
मर्त्यलोके कलिर्जातः सांप्रतं सुरसत्तम .. 14 ..
5.178.m: Nārada said: / Kali has now arisen in the mortal world, O best of gods. 14

5.178.s:
rājānaḥ satpathaṃ tyaktvā tathā lobhaparāyaṇāḥ ..
pīḍayaṃti ca lokāṃśca arthahetoḥ sunirghṛṇāḥ .. 15 ..
5.178.d:
राजानः सत्पथं त्यक्त्वा तथा लोभपरायणाः ..
पीडयंति च लोकांश्च अर्थहेतोः सुनिर्घृणाः .. 15 ..
5.178.m: The kings have abandoned the right path, devoted to greed, / and, utterly merciless, torment the people for the sake of wealth. 15

5.178.s:
śauryabhāvaparityaktāḥ paradāravimardakāḥ ..
pūjayanti na te viprānna devānna gurūnapi .. 16 ..
5.178.d:
शौर्यभावपरित्यक्ताः परदारविमर्दकाः ..
पूजयन्ति न ते विप्रान्न देवान्न गुरूनपि .. 16 ..
5.178.m: They are devoid of heroism, violaters of others' wives; / they worship neither brahmins, nor gods, nor even spiritual teachers. 16

5.178.s:
vedavikraya kartāro brāhmaṇāḥ śaucavarjitāḥ ..
pāpapratigrahāsaktāḥ sandhyāhīnāḥ sunirghṛṇāḥ .. 17 ..
5.178.d:
वेदविक्रय कर्तारो ब्राह्मणाः शौचवर्जिताः ..
पापप्रतिग्रहासक्ताः सन्ध्याहीनाः सुनिर्घृणाः .. 17 ..
5.178.m: Brahmins are sellers of the Veda, devoid of purity, / attached to accepting sinful gifts, devoid of the twilight prayers, utterly merciless. 17

5.178.s:
kṛṣikarmaratā nityaṃ vaiśyavatpaśupālakāḥ ..
vaiśyāḥ sarve samucchedaṃ prayātā dharaṇītale .. 18 ..
5.178.d:
कृषिकर्मरता नित्यं वैश्यवत्पशुपालकाः ..
वैश्याः सर्वे समुच्छेदं प्रयाता धरणीतले .. 18 ..
5.178.m: They are constantly engaged in agriculture, tending cattle like vaiśyas. / All the vaiśyas have met with ruin upon the surface of the earth. 18

5.178.s:
śūdrā nityaṃ dharmakāmāḥ śūdrāścaiva tapasvinaḥ ..
lokayātrākriyāḥ sarve prahasaṃti vyapatrapāḥ .. 19 ..
5.178.d:
शूद्रा नित्यं धर्मकामाः शूद्राश्चैव तपस्विनः ..
लोकयात्राक्रियाः सर्वे प्रहसंति व्यपत्रपाः .. 19 ..
5.178.m: Śūdras constantly desire righteousness; śūdras perform austerities; / shameless, they all deride the practices that sustain the world. 19

5.178.s:
yasya cāsti gṛhe vittaṃ taruṇyaśca tathā striyaḥ ..
tenatena samaṃ sakhyaṃ prakurvanti narā bhuvi .. 6.179.20 ..
5.178.d:
यस्य चास्ति गृहे वित्तं तरुण्यश्च तथा स्त्रियः ..
तेनतेन समं सख्यं प्रकुर्वन्ति नरा भुवि .. 6.179.20 ..
5.178.m: Men on earth form friendships only with whoever / has wealth in his house and likewise youthful women. 20

5.178.s:
vidhavānāṃ vratasthānāṃ sarveṣāṃ liṃgināṃ tathā ..
hṛdi sthito mahānkāmo vratacaryābahiḥsthitāḥ ..21..
5.178.d:
विधवानां व्रतस्थानां सर्वेषां लिंगिनां तथा ..
हृदि स्थितो महान्कामो व्रतचर्याबहिःस्थिताः ..21..
5.178.m: In the hearts of widows, of those observing vows, and of all ascetics, / great desire resides; they stand outside the observance of their vows. 21

5.178.s:
tīrthāni viplavaṃ yāṃtipāpalokaśritāni ca..
kalebhīṃtāni sarvāṇi pradravanti diśo daśa ..22..
5.178.d:
तीर्थानि विप्लवं यांतिपापलोकश्रितानि च..
कलेभींतानि सर्वाणि प्रद्रवन्ति दिशो दश ..22..
5.178.m: The sacred fords are falling into ruin, frequented by sinful people; / terrified of Kali, they are all fleeing in the ten directions. 22

5.178.s: ahaṃ tatra sthito yasmātkalikāle pitāmaha .. 23 ..
5.178.d: अहं तत्र स्थितो यस्मात्कलिकाले पितामह .. 23 ..
5.178.m: Because I stayed there in the Kali age, O Grandfather, 23

5.178.s:
kalikāle viśeṣeṇa svairiṇyo lalitaspṛhāḥ ..
bhartrā vivadamānāśca striyaḥ kārmaṇatatparāḥ..
vṛthā vratāni kurvaṃti tyaktvā tāḥ svapateḥ kathām .. 24 ..
5.178.d:
कलिकाले विशेषेण स्वैरिण्यो ललितस्पृहाः ..
भर्त्रा विवदमानाश्च स्त्रियः कार्मणतत्पराः..
वृथा व्रतानि कुर्वंति त्यक्त्वा ताः स्वपतेः कथाम् .. 24 ..
5.178.m: [I saw that] in the Kali age, women especially are wanton, longing for pleasures, / quarrelling with their husbands, devoted to sorcery; / they observe vows in vain, having cast aside obedience to their own husbands. 24

5.178.s:
kalirbaliṣṭhaḥ sutarāṃ varadānena te kṛtaḥ ..
yadā martye bhavedyuddhaṃ kaṃḍūtirjāyate hṛdi .. 29 ..
svarge vā mastake caiva pātāle cātha pādayoḥ ..
sāṃprataṃ martyaloke ca mayā dṛṣṭamanekaśaḥ .. 26 ..
śvaśrūṇāṃ ca vadhūnāṃ ca tathā janakaputrayoḥ ..
bāṃdhavānāṃ viśeṣeṇa tathā ca svāmibhṛtyayoḥ .. 27 ..
caurāṇāṃ pārthivānāṃ ca dampatyośca viśeṣataḥ ..
svalpodakāstathā meghāḥ svalpasasyā ca medinī .. 28 ..
svalpakṣīrāstathā gāvaḥ kṣīre sarpirna vidyate ..
evaṃ yuddhāni teṣāṃ ca vīkṣamāṇo divāniśam .. 29 ..
5.178.d:
कलिर्बलिष्ठः सुतरां वरदानेन ते कृतः ..
यदा मर्त्ये भवेद्युद्धं कंडूतिर्जायते हृदि .. 29 ..
स्वर्गे वा मस्तके चैव पाताले चाथ पादयोः ..
सांप्रतं मर्त्यलोके च मया दृष्टमनेकशः .. 26 ..
श्वश्रूणां च वधूनां च तथा जनकपुत्रयोः ..
बांधवानां विशेषेण तथा च स्वामिभृत्ययोः .. 27 ..
चौराणां पार्थिवानां च दम्पत्योश्च विशेषतः ..
स्वल्पोदकास्तथा मेघाः स्वल्पसस्या च मेदिनी .. 28 ..
स्वल्पक्षीरास्तथा गावः क्षीरे सर्पिर्न विद्यते ..
एवं युद्धानि तेषां च वीक्षमाणो दिवानिशम् .. 29 ..
5.178.m:
Kali was made exceedingly strong by the granting of your boon. / Whenever a fight occurs among mortals, an itch arises in my heart. 25
Whether in heaven, at the head, or in Pātāla, at the feet, / or now in the mortal world, [such conflict] has been seen by me many times: 26
between mothers-in-law and daughters-in-law, and likewise between fathers and sons, / especially between kinsmen, and likewise between masters and servants, 27
between thieves and kings, and especially between husbands and wives. / Moreover, the clouds yield little water, and the earth produces little grain; 28
likewise the cows give little milk, and in the milk there is no ghee. / Thus, watching their conflicts day and night, 29

5.178.s:
ahaṃ martye paribhrāṃtaścirāttena samāgataḥ ..
bhūyo yāsyāmi tatraiva kaṇḍūtirmahatīsthitā .. 6.179.30 ..
5.178.d:
अहं मर्त्ये परिभ्रांतश्चिरात्तेन समागतः ..
भूयो यास्यामि तत्रैव कण्डूतिर्महतीस्थिता .. 6.179.30 ..
5.178.m: I wandered through the mortal world, and for that reason have returned after a long time. / I shall go back there once again; a great itch has arisen. 30

5.178.s:
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya nāradasya pitāmahaḥ ..
puṣkarasya kṛte jātaścintāvyāku lateṃdriyaḥ .. 31 ..
5.178.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य नारदस्य पितामहः ..
पुष्करस्य कृते जातश्चिन्ताव्याकु लतेंद्रियः .. 31 ..
5.178.m: Having heard those words of Nārada, the Grandfather / became perturbed in his senses with anxiety on account of Puṣkara. 31

5.178.s:
martye ca māmakaṃ tīrthaṃ puṣkaraṃnāma viśrutam ..
nāśaṃ yāsyati tannūnaṃ kalikālapariplutam .. 32 ..
5.178.d:
मर्त्ये च मामकं तीर्थं पुष्करंनाम विश्रुतम् ..
नाशं यास्यति तन्नूनं कलिकालपरिप्लुतम् .. 32 ..
5.178.m: My sacred ford renowned by the name Puṣkara on the mortal plane / will surely meet with destruction, overrun by the Kali age. 32

5.178.s:
tasmādanyatra neṣyāmi kaliryatra na vidyate ..
yena tatra vimuṃcāmi nijaṃ tīrthaṃ ca puṣkaram .. 33 ..
5.178.d:
तस्मादन्यत्र नेष्यामि कलिर्यत्र न विद्यते ..
येन तत्र विमुंचामि निजं तीर्थं च पुष्करम् .. 33 ..
5.178.m: Therefore, I shall take it elsewhere where Kali is not found, / so that I may release my own sacred ford Puṣkara there. 33

5.178.s:
kalikāle ca saṃprāpte sarvaprāṇibhayaṃkare ..
tatra prayāṃtu tīrthāni sarvā ṇyeva viśeṣataḥ .. 34 ..
5.178.d:
कलिकाले च संप्राप्ते सर्वप्राणिभयंकरे ..
तत्र प्रयांतु तीर्थानि सर्वा ण्येव विशेषतः .. 34 ..
5.178.m: When the Kali age has arrived, terrifying to all living beings, / let all the sacred fords especially go there; 34

5.178.s: gate kalau prayāsyaṃti nijasthānamasaṃśayam .. 35 ..
5.178.d: गते कलौ प्रयास्यंति निजस्थानमसंशयम् .. 35 ..
5.178.m: and when Kali has passed, they will go back to their own place, without a doubt. 35

5.178.s:
evaṃ niścitya manasā hastasthaṃ kamalaṃ tataḥ ..
provāca sādaraṃ tacca svayaṃ dhyātvā pitāmahaḥ .. 36 ..
5.178.d:
एवं निश्चित्य मनसा हस्तस्थं कमलं ततः ..
प्रोवाच सादरं तच्च स्वयं ध्यात्वा पितामहः .. 36 ..
5.178.m: Having thus resolved in his mind, the Grandfather then, / having meditated himself, spoke respectfully to the lotus residing in his hand: 36

5.178.s:
pata tvaṃ padma bhūpṛṣṭhe kaliryatra na vidyate ..
yenānayāmi tatraiva puṣkaraṃ tīrthamātmanaḥ .. 37 ..
5.178.d:
पत त्वं पद्म भूपृष्ठे कलिर्यत्र न विद्यते ..
येनानयामि तत्रैव पुष्करं तीर्थमात्मनः .. 37 ..
5.178.m: Fall, O lotus, onto the surface of the earth where Kali is not found, / so that I may bring my own sacred ford Puṣkara to that very spot. 37

5.178.s:
tatastatpreṣitaṃ tena padmaṃ bhrāṃtvā mahītale ..
samaste patitaṃ kṣetre hāṭakeśvarasaṃbhave ..38..
5.178.d:
ततस्तत्प्रेषितं तेन पद्मं भ्रांत्वा महीतले ..
समस्ते पतितं क्षेत्रे हाटकेश्वरसंभवे ..38..
5.178.m: Then that lotus, dispatched by him, having wandered over the entire surface of the earth, / fell into the sacred field associated with Hāṭakeśvara, 38

5.178.s:
dṛṣṭvā vedavido viprānsvādhyāyaniratāñchucīn ..
teṣāṃ yajñakriyābhiśca yajñopāṃtaiḥ samaṃtataḥ .. 39 ..
5.178.d:
दृष्ट्वा वेदविदो विप्रान्स्वाध्यायनिरताञ्छुचीन् ..
तेषां यज्ञक्रियाभिश्च यज्ञोपांतैः समंततः .. 39 ..
5.178.m: having seen brahmins knowledgable in the Veda, devoted to their sacred recitation, pure, / and [seeing that sacred field] completely filled on all sides with their sacrificial rites and sacrificial surroundings, 39

5.178.s:
yūpādyaiḥ sarvato vyāpte sadiśe gaganāṃgaṇe ..
ṛgyajuḥsāmaghoṣeṇa tathā cātharvajena ca .. 6.179.40 ..
5.178.d:
यूपाद्यैः सर्वतो व्याप्ते सदिशे गगनांगणे ..
ऋग्यजुःसामघोषेण तथा चाथर्वजेन च .. 6.179.40 ..
5.178.m: with the courtyard of the sky pervaded in all directions by sacrificial posts and the like, / and by the resonance of the Ṛg, Yajus, and Sāma, and likewise by that born of the Atharvan. 40

5.178.s:
digmaṇḍale tathā vyāpte nānyaḥ saṃśrūyate dhvaniḥ ..
tathā ca tārkikāṇāṃ ca vivādeṣu mahatsu ca .. 41 ..
5.178.d:
दिग्मण्डले तथा व्याप्ते नान्यः संश्रूयते ध्वनिः ..
तथा च तार्किकाणां च विवादेषु महत्सु च .. 41 ..
5.178.m: With the circle of the directions thus pervaded, no other sound was heard; / and likewise in the great debates of the logicians, 41

5.178.s:
vedāṃtānāṃ samastānāṃ vyākhyāne bahudhā kṛte ..
dṛśyante munayo yatra saṃsthitā niyameṣu ca .. 42 ..
5.178.d:
वेदांतानां समस्तानां व्याख्याने बहुधा कृते ..
दृश्यन्ते मुनयो यत्र संस्थिता नियमेषु च .. 42 ..
5.178.m: and where explanations of all the Upaniṣads were being made in many ways, / sages were seen established in their observances: 42

5.178.s:
ekāhārā nirāhārā ekāṃtarakṛtāśanāḥ ..
trirātropoṣitāścānye kṛcchracāṃdrāyaṇe ratāḥ .. 43 ..
5.178.d:
एकाहारा निराहारा एकांतरकृताशनाः ..
त्रिरात्रोपोषिताश्चान्ये कृच्छ्रचांद्रायणे रताः .. 43 ..
5.178.m: eating once a day, taking no food, eating on alternate days, / others fasting for three nights, devoted to the kṛcchra and cāndrāyana penances; 43

5.178.s:
mahāpārākiṇaścānye tathā māsopavāsinaḥ ..
aśmakuṭṭāśinaścānye dantolūkhalikāstathā .. 44 ..
5.178.d:
महापाराकिणश्चान्ये तथा मासोपवासिनः ..
अश्मकुट्टाशिनश्चान्ये दन्तोलूखलिकास्तथा .. 44 ..
5.178.m: others performing the great parāka penance, and likewise those who fast for a month; / others eating [only] what is crushed by stones, and likewise those who use their teeth as a mortar; 44

5.178.s:
śīrṇaparṇāśinaścaike phalāhārā maharṣayaḥ ..
taddṛṣṭvā tādṛśaṃ kṣetraṃ saṃyuktaṃ vividhairguṇaiḥ .. 45 ..
5.178.d:
शीर्णपर्णाशिनश्चैके फलाहारा महर्षयः ..
तद्दृष्ट्वा तादृशं क्षेत्रं संयुक्तं विविधैर्गुणैः .. 45 ..
5.178.m: some eating fallen leaves, and great seers feeding on fruit. / Having seen such a sacred field endowed with various virtues, 45

5.178.s:
tatastatpatitaṃ tatra puṇyaṃ jñātvā mahītale ..
yatra sthāne'patatpūrvaṃ tasmāduccalitaṃ punaḥ .. 46 .
5.178.d:
ततस्तत्पतितं तत्र पुण्यं ज्ञात्वा महीतले ..
यत्र स्थानेऽपतत्पूर्वं तस्मादुच्चलितं पुनः .. 46 .
5.178.m: it fell there upon the surface of the earth, knowing it to be holy. / From the place where it first fell, it bounced up again, 46

5.178.s:
anyasmiṃśca tataḥ sthāne dvitīye dvijasattamāḥ ..
tasmādapi tṛtīye tu tṛtīyaṃ paṃkajaṃ hitam .. 47 ..
5.178.d:
अन्यस्मिंश्च ततः स्थाने द्वितीये द्विजसत्तमाः ..
तस्मादपि तृतीये तु तृतीयं पंकजं हितम् .. 47 ..
5.178.m: and [fell] into another, second place, O best of brahmins; / and from that place, the third beneficial lotus [fell] into a third. 47

5.178.s:
tato gartātrayaṃ jātaṃ teṣu sthāneṣu ca triṣu ..
gartāsu ca jala jātaṃ svacchaṃ sphaṭikasaṃnibham .. 48 ..
5.178.d:
ततो गर्तात्रयं जातं तेषु स्थानेषु च त्रिषु ..
गर्तासु च जल जातं स्वच्छं स्फटिकसंनिभम् .. 48 ..
5.178.m: Then a triad of chasms arose in those three places, / and in the chasms arose water, clear and resembling crystal. 48

5.178.s:
etasminnaṃtare prāptaḥ svayameva pitāmahaḥ ..
tatra sthāne dvijaśreṣṭhā yajñakarmaprasiddhaye .. ... 49 ..
5.178.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे प्राप्तः स्वयमेव पितामहः ..
तत्र स्थाने द्विजश्रेष्ठा यज्ञकर्मप्रसिद्धये .. ... 49 ..
5.178.m: At this juncture, the Grandfather himself arrived / at that place, O best of brahmins, for the accomplishment of a sacrificial rite, 49

5.178.s:
dṛṣṭvā samaṃtataḥ kṣetraṃ hāṭakeśvarasaṃjñitam ..
nānāvipraiḥ samākīrṇaṃ vedavedāṃgapāragaiḥ ..
tapasvibhistathānekairvratacaryāparāyaṇaiḥ .. 6.179.50 ..
5.178.d:
दृष्ट्वा समंततः क्षेत्रं हाटकेश्वरसंज्ञितम् ..
नानाविप्रैः समाकीर्णं वेदवेदांगपारगैः ..
तपस्विभिस्तथानेकैर्व्रतचर्यापरायणैः .. 6.179.50 ..
5.178.m: having seen on all sides the sacred field named Hāṭakeśvara, / crowded with diverse brahmins who had mastered the Vedas and Vedāṅgas, / and likewise with many ascetics devoted to the practice of vows. 50

5.178.s:
aho kṣetramaho kṣetraṃ puṇyaṃ ramyaṃ dvijapriyam ..
tasmāyajñaṃ kariṣyāmi kṣetre'smiṃśca dvijāśraye .. 51 ..
5.178.d:
अहो क्षेत्रमहो क्षेत्रं पुण्यं रम्यं द्विजप्रियम् ..
तस्मायज्ञं करिष्यामि क्षेत्रेऽस्मिंश्च द्विजाश्रये .. 51 ..
5.178.m: "Oh, what a sacred field! Oh, what a sacred field! Merit-giving, charming, beloved of brahmins! / Therefore I shall perform a sacrifice in this sacred field, the refuge of brahmins. / 51

5.178.s:
ānayiṣyāmi taccāpi puṣkaratritayaṃ śubham ..
gartāsvetāsu puṇyāsu jyeṣṭhaṃ madhyaṃ kanīyakam .. 52 ..
5.178.d:
आनयिष्यामि तच्चापि पुष्करत्रितयं शुभम् ..
गर्तास्वेतासु पुण्यासु ज्येष्ठं मध्यं कनीयकम् .. 52 ..
5.178.m: And I will also bring that auspicious triad of Puṣkaras, / the elder, the middle, and the youngest, into these holy hollows, / 52

5.178.s:
kalikāle ca saṃprāpte yena lopaṃ na gacchati ..
svayaṃ niścitya manasā copaviśya dharātale .. 53 ..
5.178.d:
कलिकाले च संप्राप्ते येन लोपं न गच्छति ..
स्वयं निश्चित्य मनसा चोपविश्य धरातले .. 53 ..
5.178.m: so that, when the Kali age arrives, it will not perish." / Having resolved this in his mind, and sitting down upon the surface of the earth, / 53

5.178.s:
dhyātvā ca suciraṃ kālamānayāmāsa tatra ca ..
puṣkaratritayaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ jyeṣṭhamadhyakanīyakam .. 54 ..
5.178.d:
ध्यात्वा च सुचिरं कालमानयामास तत्र च ..
पुष्करत्रितयं श्रेष्ठं ज्येष्ठमध्यकनीयकम् .. 54 ..
5.178.m: and having meditated for a very long time, he brought there / the supreme triad of Puṣkaras: the elder, the middle, and the youngest. / 54

5.178.s:
tato'bravītsa hṛṣṭātmā hyetaddhi puṣkara trayam ..
mayā samyaksamānītaṃ kalikālabhayena ca .. 55 ..
5.178.d:
ततोऽब्रवीत्स हृष्टात्मा ह्येतद्धि पुष्कर त्रयम् ..
मया सम्यक्समानीतं कलिकालभयेन च .. 55 ..
5.178.m: Then, rejoicing in his heart, he said: "Indeed, this triad of Puṣkaras / has been duly brought by me out of fear of the Kali age. / 55

5.178.s:
ye'tra snānaṃ kariṣyaṃti śraddhayā parayā yutāḥ ..
te yāsyaṃti parāṃ siddhimakṣayāṃ matprasādataḥ .. 56 ..
5.178.d:
येऽत्र स्नानं करिष्यंति श्रद्धया परया युताः ..
ते यास्यंति परां सिद्धिमक्षयां मत्प्रसादतः .. 56 ..
5.178.m: Those who bathe here endowed with supreme faith / shall attain supreme, imperishable perfection through my grace. / 56

5.178.s:
ye ca śrāddhaṃ kariṣyaṃti kārtikyāṃ susamāhitāḥ ..
kariṣyaṃti gayāśīrṣe teṣāṃ puṇyaṃ mahattamam .. 57 ..
5.178.d:
ये च श्राद्धं करिष्यंति कार्तिक्यां सुसमाहिताः ..
करिष्यंति गयाशीर्षे तेषां पुण्यं महत्तमम् .. 57 ..
5.178.m: And those with concentrated minds who perform a śrāddha on the full moon day of Kārttika / shall obtain the greatest merit, as if they performed it at Gayāśīrṣa. / 57

5.178.s:
tatrādyātpuṣkarātpuṇyaṃ labhiṣyaṃti śatādhikam ..
mayā yajñaḥ kṛtastatra kārtikyāṃ pūrvapuṣkare .. 58 ..
5.178.d:
तत्राद्यात्पुष्करात्पुण्यं लभिष्यंति शताधिकम् ..
मया यज्ञः कृतस्तत्र कार्तिक्यां पूर्वपुष्करे .. 58 ..
5.178.m: They will obtain a hundred times more merit than from the first Puṣkara. / I performed a sacrifice there at the first Puṣkara on the full moon day of Kārttika; / 58

5.178.s: vaiśākhyāṃ ca kariṣyāmi atrāhaṃ ca dvitīyake .. .. 59 ..
5.178.d: वैशाख्यां च करिष्यामि अत्राहं च द्वितीयके .. .. 59 ..
5.178.m: and here at the second one I shall perform it on the full moon day of Vaiśākha." / 59

5.178.s:
evamuktvā tato brahmā hyādideśa sadāgatim ..
mamādeśāddrutaṃ vāyo samānaya puraṃdaram .. 6.179.60 ..
5.178.d:
एवमुक्त्वा ततो ब्रह्मा ह्यादिदेश सदागतिम् ..
ममादेशाद्द्रुतं वायो समानय पुरंदरम् .. 6.179.60 ..
5.178.m: Having spoken thus, Brahmā then commanded the wind: / "O Vāyu, by my command, bring Puraṃdara at once, / 60

5.178.s:
ādityairvasubhiḥ sārdhaṃ rudraiścaiva marudgaṇaiḥ ..
gaṃdharvairlokapālaiśca siddhairvidyādharaistathā .. 61 ..
5.178.d:
आदित्यैर्वसुभिः सार्धं रुद्रैश्चैव मरुद्गणैः ..
गंधर्वैर्लोकपालैश्च सिद्धैर्विद्याधरैस्तथा .. 61 ..
5.178.m: along with the Ādityas, the Vasus, the Rudras, and the host of Maruts, / with the Gandharvas, the World Protectors, the Siddhas, and likewise the Vidyādharas, / 61

5.178.s:
yena me syātsahāyatvaṃ samaste yajñakarmaṇi ..
tacchrutvā sakalaṃ vāyurgatvā śakraniveśanam ..
kathayāmāsa tatsarvaṃ yaduktaṃ parameṣṭhinā .. 62 ..
5.178.d:
येन मे स्यात्सहायत्वं समस्ते यज्ञकर्मणि ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा सकलं वायुर्गत्वा शक्रनिवेशनम् ..
कथयामास तत्सर्वं यदुक्तं परमेष्ठिना .. 62 ..
5.178.m: so that I may have assistance in the entire sacrificial rite." / Hearing all of that, Vāyu went to the dwelling of Śakra / and recounted everything that had been said by Parameṣṭhin. / 62

5.178.s:
satvaraṃ prayayau tatra sarvairdevagaṇaiḥ saha ..
praṇipatya tatastaṃ sa brahmāṇaṃ vākyamabravīt .. 63 ..
5.178.d:
सत्वरं प्रययौ तत्र सर्वैर्देवगणैः सह ..
प्रणिपत्य ततस्तं स ब्रह्माणं वाक्यमब्रवीत् .. 63 ..
5.178.m: He set out quickly to that place, together with all the hosts of gods. / Then, bowing down to Brahmā, he spoke these words: / 63

5.178.s:
ādeśo dīyatāṃ deva hyahamākāritastvayā ..
yadarthaṃ tatkariṣyāmi tasmācchīghraṃ nivedaya .. 64 ..
5.178.d:
आदेशो दीयतां देव ह्यहमाकारितस्त्वया ..
यदर्थं तत्करिष्यामि तस्माच्छीघ्रं निवेदय .. 64 ..
5.178.m: "Give your command, O Lord! Indeed, I have been summoned by you. / Whatever the purpose is, I shall do it; therefore, state it quickly." / 64

5.178.s:
brahmovāca .. ..
mayā śakrātra cānītaṃ supuṇyaṃ puṣkaratrayam ..
kalikālabhayāccaiva kariṣye tadahaṃ sthiram.. 65 ..
5.178.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच .. ..
मया शक्रात्र चानीतं सुपुण्यं पुष्करत्रयम् ..
कलिकालभयाच्चैव करिष्ये तदहं स्थिरम्.. 65 ..
5.178.m: Brahmā said: / "O Śakra, the most holy triad of Puṣkaras has been brought here by me; / and out of fear of the Kali age, I shall establish it firmly. / 65

5.178.s:
agniṣṭomatrayaṃ kṛtvā vaiśākhyāṃ ca yathārcitam ..
saṃbhāramāharasvāśu tadarthaṃ sarvameva hi .. 66 ..
5.178.d:
अग्निष्टोमत्रयं कृत्वा वैशाख्यां च यथार्चितम् ..
संभारमाहरस्वाशु तदर्थं सर्वमेव हि .. 66 ..
5.178.m: Having performed three Agniṣṭoma sacrifices on the full moon day of Vaiśākha according to the proper rites, / collect quickly all the materials needed for that purpose, / 66

5.178.s:
brāhmaṇāṃśca tadarhāṃśca vedavedāṃgapāragān ..
tacchrutvā vinayācchakrastathetyuktvā tvarānvitaḥ ..'
saṃbhārānānayāmāsa tadarhāṃśca dvijottamān .. 67 ..
5.178.d:
ब्राह्मणांश्च तदर्हांश्च वेदवेदांगपारगान् ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा विनयाच्छक्रस्तथेत्युक्त्वा त्वरान्वितः ..'
संभारानानयामास तदर्हांश्च द्विजोत्तमान् .. 67 ..
5.178.m: and also the brahmins worthy of it, who have mastered the Vedas and Vedāṅgas." / Hearing this, Śakra respectfully said, "So be it," and in all haste / brought the materials and the best brahmins worthy of it. / 67

5.178.s:
tataścakāra vidhivadyajñaṃ sa prapitāmahaḥ ..
yathoktavidhinā sarvaṃ tathā saṃpūrṇadakṣiṇam .. 68 ..
5.178.d:
ततश्चकार विधिवद्यज्ञं स प्रपितामहः ..
यथोक्तविधिना सर्वं तथा संपूर्णदक्षिणम् .. 68 ..
5.178.m: Then the great ancestor performed the sacrifice in accordance with the injunctions, / everything following the prescribed rule, along with complete sacrificial fees. / 68

5.178.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye puṣkaratrayotpattipūrvakaṃ yajñasamāraṃbhārthamupakaraṇānayanabrāhmaṇāmantraṇādi prakārakathanaṃnāmaikonāśītyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ..179..
5.178.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये पुष्करत्रयोत्पत्तिपूर्वकं यज्ञसमारंभार्थमुपकरणानयनब्राह्मणामन्त्रणादि प्रकारकथनंनामैकोनाशीत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः..179..
5.178.m: Thus ends the one hundred and seventy-ninth chapter, titled "The Account of the Bringing of Materials and Inviting of Brahmins for Beginning the Sacrifice Preceded by the Origin of the Triad of Puṣkaras," in the Māhātmya of the Hāṭakeśvara Kṣetra, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] of the eighty-one-thousand-verse collection in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa. / 179

5.179.s:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ..
atyadbhutamidaṃ sūta yattvayā samudāhṛtam..
brahmaṇā yatkṛto yajñastatra kṣetre mahātmanā .. 1 ..
5.179.d:
ऋषय ऊचुः..
अत्यद्भुतमिदं सूत यत्त्वया समुदाहृतम्..
ब्रह्मणा यत्कृतो यज्ञस्तत्र क्षेत्रे महात्मना .. 1 ..
5.179.m: The ṛṣis said: / "This is exceedingly wonderful, O Sūta, which has been recounted by you: / that a sacrifice was performed in that sacred field by the high-souled Brahmā. / 1

5.179.s:
agniṣṭomādayo yajñā ye vartante dharātale ..
yaṣṭavyasteṣu yajñeṣu sa eva hi sureśvaraḥ .. 2 ..
5.179.d:
अग्निष्टोमादयो यज्ञा ये वर्तन्ते धरातले ..
यष्टव्यस्तेषु यज्ञेषु स एव हि सुरेश्वरः .. 2 ..
5.179.m: Whatever sacrifices there are on the surface of the earth, such as the Agniṣṭoma, / in those sacrifices it is indeed he himself, the Lord of the Gods, who is to be worshipped. / 2

5.179.s:
tenaiva yajatā tatra ko hīṣṭaḥ prabravīhi naḥ ..
ṛtvijaḥ ke sthitāstatra yaistatkarma makhodbhavam ..
tatpratyakṣe kṛtaṃ sarvametannaḥ kautukaṃ param .. 3 ..
5.179.d:
तेनैव यजता तत्र को हीष्टः प्रब्रवीहि नः ..
ऋत्विजः के स्थितास्तत्र यैस्तत्कर्म मखोद्भवम् ..
तत्प्रत्यक्षे कृतं सर्वमेतन्नः कौतुकं परम् .. 3 ..
5.179.m: Tell us: when he himself was sacrificing there, who indeed was worshipped? / What officiating priests were present there by whom that ritual born of the sacrifice / was all performed visibly? This is our supreme curiosity! / 3

5.179.s:
kā caiva dakṣiṇā dattā tena teṣāṃ dvijanmanām ..
ko'dhvaryurvihitastatra yena tadyajanaṃ kṛtam ..4..
5.179.d:
का चैव दक्षिणा दत्ता तेन तेषां द्विजन्मनाम् ..
कोऽध्वर्युर्विहितस्तत्र येन तद्यजनं कृतम् ..4..
5.179.m: And what sacrificial fee was given by him to those twice-born? / Who was appointed as the adhvaryu priest there by whom that sacrificial performance was made? / 4

5.179.s:
ko hotā kaśca vā'gnīdhraḥ ko brahmā tatra saṃsthitaḥ ..
udgātā kaḥ sthitastatra hyācāryo yajñakarmaṇi .. 5 ..
5.179.d:
को होता कश्च वाऽग्नीध्रः को ब्रह्मा तत्र संस्थितः ..
उद्गाता कः स्थितस्तत्र ह्याचार्यो यज्ञकर्मणि .. 5 ..
5.179.m: Who was the hotṛ priest, and who was the āgnīdhra? Who presided as the brahmā priest there? / Who was present as the udgātṛ priest? Who was the preceptor in the sacrificial rite?" / 5

5.179.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
ahaṃ vaḥ kīrtayiṣyāmi sarvaṃ yajñasya saṃbhavam ..
vṛttāṃtaṃ yacca tatrastha māścaryaṃ dvijapuṃgavāḥ .. 6 ..
5.179.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
अहं वः कीर्तयिष्यामि सर्वं यज्ञस्य संभवम् ..
वृत्तांतं यच्च तत्रस्थ माश्चर्यं द्विजपुंगवाः .. 6 ..
5.179.m: Sūta said: / "I shall recount to you all the origin of the sacrifice, / and what wonderful event occurred there, O eminent twice-born! / 6

5.179.s:
ye sadasyāḥ sthitāstatra ṛtvijaśca dvijottamāḥ ..
dakṣiṇā yāḥ pradattāśca tebhyastena mahātmanā .. 7 ..
5.179.d:
ये सदस्याः स्थितास्तत्र ऋत्विजश्च द्विजोत्तमाः ..
दक्षिणा याः प्रदत्ताश्च तेभ्यस्तेन महात्मना .. 7 ..
5.179.m: Which members of the sacrificial assembly were present there, the officiating priests, the best of the twice-born, / and which sacrificial fees were distributed to them by that high-souled one / 7

5.179.s:
yajatā devadevena brahmaṇā'mitatejasā ..
yajñakāmaṃ caturvaktraṃ jñātvā devaḥ śatakratuḥ .. 8 ..
5.179.d:
यजता देवदेवेन ब्रह्मणाऽमिततेजसा ..
यज्ञकामं चतुर्वक्त्रं ज्ञात्वा देवः शतक्रतुः .. 8 ..
5.179.m: while the god of gods, Brahmā of boundless splendour, was sacrificing. / Knowing that the four-faced one desired a sacrifice, Lord Śatakratu / 8

5.179.s:
sarvaiḥ suragaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ sāhāyyārthamupāgataḥ ..
tathā ca bhagavāñchaṃbhuḥ sarvadevagaṇaiḥ saha .. 9 ..
5.179.d:
सर्वैः सुरगणैः सार्धं साहाय्यार्थमुपागतः ..
तथा च भगवाञ्छंभुः सर्वदेवगणैः सह .. 9 ..
5.179.m: came along with all the hosts of gods in order to offer assistance; / and likewise the blessed Śambhu, together with all the hosts of gods. / 9

5.179.s:
tāndṛṣṭvā'bhyāgatānbrahmā martyadharmasamāśritān ..
provāca vinayopetaḥ kṛtāṃjalipuṭaḥ sthitaḥ .. 6.180.10 ..
5.179.d:
तान्दृष्ट्वाऽभ्यागतान्ब्रह्मा मर्त्यधर्मसमाश्रितान् ..
प्रोवाच विनयोपेतः कृतांजलिपुटः स्थितः .. 6.180.10 ..
5.179.m: Seeing them arrived, assuming mortal forms, / Brahmā, full of humility and with folded palms, said: / 10

5.179.s:
svāgataṃ vaḥ suraśreṣṭhāḥ prasādaḥ kriyatāṃ mama ..
niviśyatāṃ yathānyāyaṃ sthāneṣu rucireṣu ca .. 11 ..
5.179.d:
स्वागतं वः सुरश्रेष्ठाः प्रसादः क्रियतां मम ..
निविश्यतां यथान्यायं स्थानेषु रुचिरेषु च .. 11 ..
5.179.m: "Welcome to you, O best of gods! Grant me your favour! / Be seated according to proper decorum in these delightful places. / 11

5.179.s:
dhanyo'smyanugṛhīto'smi yadyūyaṃ svayamāgatāḥ ..
maṃtrāhūtā yathā kṛcchrātsarvasatreṣu gacchatha .. 12 ..
5.179.d:
धन्योऽस्म्यनुगृहीतोऽस्मि यद्यूयं स्वयमागताः ..
मंत्राहूता यथा कृच्छ्रात्सर्वसत्रेषु गच्छथ .. 12 ..
5.179.m: I am fortunate, I am favoured, since you have come of your own accord; / whereas when summoned by mantras, you go to all long sacrificial sessions only with difficulty." / 12

5.179.s:
.. devā ūcuḥ .. ..
yena yaccātra kartavyaṃ tacchīghraṃ vada padmaja ..
yajñe tava mahābhāga tasya tattvaṃ samādiśa .. .. 13 ..
5.179.d:
.. देवा ऊचुः .. ..
येन यच्चात्र कर्तव्यं तच्छीघ्रं वद पद्मज ..
यज्ञे तव महाभाग तस्य तत्त्वं समादिश .. .. 13 ..
5.179.m: The gods said: / "Tell us quickly, O lotus-born one, what is to be done here by whom; / in your sacrifice, O illustrious one, assign that duty in detail." / 13

5.179.s:
.. brahmovāca .. ..
viśvakarmandrutaṃ gaccha yajñamaṇḍapasiddhaye ..
patnīśālāṃ tataścaiva yajñavedīstathaiva ca .. 14 ..
5.179.d:
.. ब्रह्मोवाच .. ..
विश्वकर्मन्द्रुतं गच्छ यज्ञमण्डपसिद्धये ..
पत्नीशालां ततश्चैव यज्ञवेदीस्तथैव च .. 14 ..
5.179.m: Brahmā said: / "O Viśvakarman, go quickly for the preparation of the sacrificial pavilion, / and then the chamber for the wife, and likewise the sacrificial altars. / 14

5.179.s:
kuṇḍāni caiva sarvāṇi yathāsthāneṣu kāraya ..
yajñapātrāṇi sarvāṇi grahāśca camasāstathā .. 15 ..
5.179.d:
कुण्डानि चैव सर्वाणि यथास्थानेषु कारय ..
यज्ञपात्राणि सर्वाणि ग्रहाश्च चमसास्तथा .. 15 ..
5.179.m: And have all the fire-pits constructed in their proper places, / along with all the sacrificial vessels, the graha cups, and the camasa ladles. / 15

5.179.s:
yūpāśca yatpramāṇena kartavyāḥ sacaṣālakāḥ ..
pacanārthaṃ tathā gartāḥ kartavyā yatpramāṇataḥ .. 16 ..
5.179.d:
यूपाश्च यत्प्रमाणेन कर्तव्याः सचषालकाः ..
पचनार्थं तथा गर्ताः कर्तव्या यत्प्रमाणतः .. 16 ..
5.179.m: The sacrificial posts are to be made according to proper measurement, together with their top-rings, / and the pits for cooking must be made according to measure. / 16

5.179.s:
iṣṭikānāṃ sahasrāṇi daśa cāṣṭaśatāni ca ..
kartavyāni tvayā śīghraṃ cayanānīti satvaram .. 17 ..
5.179.d:
इष्टिकानां सहस्राणि दश चाष्टशतानि च ..
कर्तव्यानि त्वया शीघ्रं चयनानीति सत्वरम् .. 17 ..
5.179.m: Ten thousand and eight hundred bricks / must be made by you quickly for the altar-piling without delay; / 17

5.179.s:
tathā hiraṇmayaścāpi puruṣaḥ kārya eva hi ..
tathetyuktā tatastvaṣṭā śīghrācchīghrataraṃ yayau .. 18 ..
5.179.d:
तथा हिरण्मयश्चापि पुरुषः कार्य एव हि ..
तथेत्युक्ता ततस्त्वष्टा शीघ्राच्छीघ्रतरं ययौ .. 18 ..
5.179.m: likewise, a golden man must definitely be made." / Saying "So be it," Tvaṣṭṛ then went away as swiftly as could be. / 18

5.179.s:
tatastu padmajaḥ prāha devācāryaṃ bṛha spatim ..
bṛhaspate tvamānīhi yajñārhānṛtvijo'khilān .. 19 ..
5.179.d:
ततस्तु पद्मजः प्राह देवाचार्यं बृह स्पतिम् ..
बृहस्पते त्वमानीहि यज्ञार्हानृत्विजोऽखिलान् .. 19 ..
5.179.m: Then the lotus-born one said to Bṛhaspati, the preceptor of the gods: / "O Bṛhaspati, you bring all the officiating priests worthy of a sacrifice, / 19

5.179.s:
yāvatṣoḍaśasaṃkhyāśca nānyasyaitaddhi yujyate ..
