tvayā śakra sadā kāryā śuśrūṣā ca dvijanmanām .. 6.180.20 ..
5.179.d:
यावत्षोडशसंख्याश्च नान्यस्यैतद्धि युज्यते ..
त्वया शक्र सदा कार्या शुश्रूषा च द्विजन्मनाम् .. 6.180.20 ..
5.179.m: to the number of sixteen; this is not fitting for anyone else. / O Śakra, you must constantly render service to the twice-born: / 20

5.179.s:
hastapādāvamarddaśca śrāṃtānāṃ pṛṣṭhamarddanam ..
dhanādhyakṣa tvayā deyā dakṣiṇā kālasaṃbhavā .. 21 ..
5.179.d:
हस्तपादावमर्द्दश्च श्रांतानां पृष्ठमर्द्दनम् ..
धनाध्यक्ष त्वया देया दक्षिणा कालसंभवा .. 21 ..
5.179.m: massaging their hands and feet, and rubbing the backs of those who are weary. / O Dhanādhyakṣa, the sacrificial gift suitable for the occasion must be given by you. / 21

5.179.s:
suvastrāṇi hiraṇyaṃ ca tathānyadvāpi vāṃchitam ..
tvayā viṣṇo sadā kāryaṃ kṛtyākṛtyaparīkṣaṇam .. 22 ..
5.179.d:
सुवस्त्राणि हिरण्यं च तथान्यद्वापि वांछितम् ..
त्वया विष्णो सदा कार्यं कृत्याकृत्यपरीक्षणम् .. 22 ..
5.179.m:
Fine garments and gold, and whatever else is desired.
O Viṣṇu, you must always inspect what is to be done and what is not to be done,

5.179.s:
yuktaṃ kṛtamatho naiva sāvadhānena sarvadā ..
lokapālāśca ye sarve rakṣaṃtu sakalā diśaḥ ..
bhūtapretapiśācānāṃ praveśaṃ rākṣasodbhavam .. 23 ..
5.179.d:
युक्तं कृतमथो नैव सावधानेन सर्वदा ..
लोकपालाश्च ये सर्वे रक्षंतु सकला दिशः ..
भूतप्रेतपिशाचानां प्रवेशं राक्षसोद्भवम् .. 23 ..
5.179.m:
whether it has been done properly or not, being ever vigilant.
And let all the guardians of the world protect every quarter
against the entrance of bhūtas, pretas, piśācas, and rākṣasas.

5.179.s:
yo yaṃ kāmayate kāmaṃ kiṃcidvastraṃ dhanaṃ ca vā ..
vicārya tasya taddeyaṃ sarvayajñādhipena tu .. 24 ..
5.179.d:
यो यं कामयते कामं किंचिद्वस्त्रं धनं च वा ..
विचार्य तस्य तद्देयं सर्वयज्ञाधिपेन तु .. 24 ..
5.179.m:
Whatever desire anyone desires, whether any cloth or wealth,
after considering it, the lord of the sacrifice must grant it to him.

5.179.s:
ādityā vasavo rudrā viśvedevā marudgaṇāḥ ..
bhavaṃtu pariveṣṭāro bhoktukāmajanasya ca .. 25 ..
5.179.d:
आदित्या वसवो रुद्रा विश्वेदेवा मरुद्गणाः ..
भवंतु परिवेष्टारो भोक्तुकामजनस्य च .. 25 ..
5.179.m:
Let the Ādityas, Vasus, Rudras, Viśvedevas, and the hosts of Maruts
become the servers of food for those who wish to eat."

5.179.s:
etasminnaṃtare prāpto viśvakarmā tvarānvitaḥ ..
abravītpaṃkajabhavaṃ saṃsiddho yajñamaṇḍapaḥ .. 26 ..
5.179.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे प्राप्तो विश्वकर्मा त्वरान्वितः ..
अब्रवीत्पंकजभवं संसिद्धो यज्ञमण्डपः .. 26 ..
5.179.m:
In the meantime, Viśvakarman arrived in haste
and said to the lotus-born [Brahmā]: "The sacrificial pavilion is fully prepared;

5.179.s: sarvamanyatsamādiṣṭaṃ yattvayoktaṃ caturmukha .. 27 ..
5.179.d: सर्वमन्यत्समादिष्टं यत्त्वयोक्तं चतुर्मुख .. 27 ..
5.179.m: everything else that was directed by you, O four-faced one, has been done."

5.179.s:
tato bṛhaspatiḥ prāha samabhyetya pitāmaham..
samānītā mayā deva brāhmaṇā yajñakarmaṇi .. 28 ..
5.179.d:
ततो बृहस्पतिः प्राह समभ्येत्य पितामहम्..
समानीता मया देव ब्राह्मणा यज्ञकर्मणि .. 28 ..
5.179.m:
Then Bṛhaspati, having approached the Grandfather, said:
"O god, I have brought the brahmins for the sacrificial rite.

5.179.s:
viprāḥ ṣoḍaśasaṃkhyāśca ṛtvikkarmaṇi yojaya ..
svayaṃ parīkṣya deveśa yajñakarmaprasiddhaye .. 29 ..
5.179.d:
विप्राः षोडशसंख्याश्च ऋत्विक्कर्मणि योजय ..
स्वयं परीक्ष्य देवेश यज्ञकर्मप्रसिद्धये .. 29 ..
5.179.m:
Appoint these brahmins, sixteen in number, to the duties of officiating priests,
having personally examined them, O lord of the gods, for the successful performance of the sacrifice."

5.179.s:
tato brahmā svayaṃ dṛṣṭvā tānparīkṣya prayatnataḥ ..
ṛtviktve ca niyojyātha tataścakre tadarhaṇam .. 6.180.30 ..
5.179.d:
ततो ब्रह्मा स्वयं दृष्ट्वा तान्परीक्ष्य प्रयत्नतः ..
ऋत्विक्त्वे च नियोज्याथ ततश्चक्रे तदर्हणम् .. 6.180.30 ..
5.179.m:
Then Brahmā, having personally looked at them and diligently examined them,
appointed them to the office of priests and then performed their honorific worship.

5.179.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
ṛtvijāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ sūta nāmāni kīrtaya ..
yena yo vihitastatra padārthaḥ sūta taṃ vada .. 31 ..
5.179.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
ऋत्विजां चैव सर्वेषां सूत नामानि कीर्तय ..
येन यो विहितस्तत्र पदार्थः सूत तं वद .. 31 ..

5.179.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
bhṛgurhautre tatastena vṛto brāhmaṇasattamāḥ ..
maitrāvaruṇasaṃjñastu tathaiva cyavano muniḥ .. 32 ..
5.179.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
भृगुर्हौत्रे ततस्तेन वृतो ब्राह्मणसत्तमाः ..
मैत्रावरुणसंज्ञस्तु तथैव च्यवनो मुनिः .. 32 ..

5.179.s:
acchāvāko marīciśca grāvastudgālavo muniḥ ..
pulastyaśca tathā 'dhvaryuḥ prasthātātriśca saṃsthitaḥ .. 33 ..
5.179.d:
अच्छावाको मरीचिश्च ग्रावस्तुद्गालवो मुनिः ..
पुलस्त्यश्च तथा ऽध्वर्युः प्रस्थातात्रिश्च संस्थितः .. 33 ..
5.179.m:
Marīci was the acchāvāka, and the sage Gālava the grāvastut;
Pulastya stood as the adhvaryu, and Atri as the pratiprasthātṛ.

5.179.s:
tatra raibhyo munirneṣṭā tatronnetā sanātanaḥ ..
brahmā ca nārado gargo brāhmaṇācchaṃsireva ca ..34..
5.179.d:
तत्र रैभ्यो मुनिर्नेष्टा तत्रोन्नेता सनातनः ..
ब्रह्मा च नारदो गर्गो ब्राह्मणाच्छंसिरेव च ..34..
5.179.m:
There the sage Raibhya was the neṣṭṛ, and there Sanātana was the unnetṛ;
Brahmā [the supervising priest] was Nārada, and Garga was the brāhmaṇācchaṃsin.

5.179.s:
āgnīdhraśca bharadvājo hotā pārāśarastathā ..
tathaiva tatra kṣetre ca udgātā gobhilo muniḥ .. 35 ..
5.179.d:
आग्नीध्रश्च भरद्वाजो होता पाराशरस्तथा ..
तथैव तत्र क्षेत्रे च उद्गाता गोभिलो मुनिः .. 35 ..
5.179.m:
Bharadvāja was the āgnīdhra, and the hotṛ was Parāśara's son;
likewise in that sacred field the sage Gobhila was the udgātṛ.

5.179.s:
tathaiva kauthumo jajñe prastautā yajñakarmaṇi ..
śāṃḍilyaḥ pratiharttā ca subrahmaṇyastathāṃgirāḥ .. 36 ..
5.179.d:
तथैव कौथुमो जज्ञे प्रस्तौता यज्ञकर्मणि ..
शांडिल्यः प्रतिहर्त्ता च सुब्रह्मण्यस्तथांगिराः .. 36 ..
5.179.m:
Likewise Kauthuma was appointed as the prastotṛ in the sacrificial rite;
Śāṇḍilya was the pratihartṛ, and Aṅgiras was the subrahmaṇya.

5.179.s:
tasya yajñasya siddhyarthamityete ṣoḍaśartvijaḥ ..
vastrābharaṇaśobhāḍhyā vinayena kṛtāśca te ..37..
5.179.d:
तस्य यज्ञस्य सिद्ध्यर्थमित्येते षोडशर्त्विजः ..
वस्त्राभरणशोभाढ्या विनयेन कृताश्च ते ..37..
5.179.m:
These were the sixteen officiating priests for the success of that sacrifice;
they were made radiant with garments and ornaments, and treated with humility.

5.179.s:
tataḥ kṛtvā svayaṃ brahmā sarveṣāmarhaṇakriyām ..
gṛhyoktena vidhānena tataḥ provāca sādaram .. 38 ..
5.179.d:
ततः कृत्वा स्वयं ब्रह्मा सर्वेषामर्हणक्रियाम् ..
गृह्योक्तेन विधानेन ततः प्रोवाच सादरम् .. 38 ..
5.179.m:
Then Brahmā himself, having performed the act of honoring them all
according to the rule stated in the Gṛhyasūtras, said with respect:

5.179.s:
eṣo'ha śaraṇaṃ prāpto yuṣmākaṃ dvijasattamāḥ ..
anugṛhṇīta māṃ sarve dīkṣāyai yajñakarmaṇaḥ .. 39 ..
5.179.d:
एषोऽह शरणं प्राप्तो युष्माकं द्विजसत्तमाः ..
अनुगृह्णीत मां सर्वे दीक्षायै यज्ञकर्मणः .. 39 ..
5.179.m:
"Here I have sought refuge with you, O best of twice-born ones;
bless me, all of you, for the initiation into the sacrificial rite."

5.179.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe brahmayajñopākhyāne yajñamaṇḍa paprāptabrāhmaṇasatkārapūrvakartvigādisthānayojanāpūrvakādhvarakarmāraṃbhonāmāśītyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 180 ..
5.179.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे ब्रह्मयज्ञोपाख्याने यज्ञमण्ड पप्राप्तब्राह्मणसत्कारपूर्वकर्त्विगादिस्थानयोजनापूर्वकाध्वरकर्मारंभोनामाशीत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 180 ..
5.179.m: Thus ends the one hundred and eightieth chapter, called 'The Commencement of the Sacrificial Rite Following the Welcoming of the Brahmins Arrived at the Sacrificial Pavilion and the Appointment to the Posts of Priests and Others' in the Story of the Sacrifice of Brahmā, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [section], in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

5.180.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
etasminnaṃtare sarvernāgarairbrāhmaṇottamaiḥ ..
preṣito madhyagastatra gartātīrthasamudbhavaḥ .. 1 ..
5.180.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एतस्मिन्नंतरे सर्वेर्नागरैर्ब्राह्मणोत्तमैः ..
प्रेषितो मध्यगस्तत्र गर्तातीर्थसमुद्भवः .. 1 ..
5.180.m:
Sūta said:
In the meantime, Madhyaga, who was born at Gartātīrtha,
was sent there by all the foremost Nāgara brahmins:

5.180.s:
rere madhyaga gatvā tvaṃ brūhi taṃ kupitāmaham ..
vipravṛtti prahaṃtāraṃ nītimārgavivarjitam .. 2 ..
5.180.d:
रेरे मध्यग गत्वा त्वं ब्रूहि तं कुपितामहम् ..
विप्रवृत्ति प्रहंतारं नीतिमार्गविवर्जितम् .. 2 ..
5.180.m:
"Go, O Madhyaga, and say to that bad grandfather,
who destroys the livelihood of brahmins and is devoid of the path of rectitude:

5.180.s:
etatkṣetraṃ pradattaṃ naḥ pūrveṣāṃ ca dvijanmanām ..
maheśvareṇa tuṣṭena pūrite sarpaje bile .. 3 ..
5.180.d:
एतत्क्षेत्रं प्रदत्तं नः पूर्वेषां च द्विजन्मनाम् ..
महेश्वरेण तुष्टेन पूरिते सर्पजे बिले .. 3 ..
5.180.m:
'This sacred field was given to our twice-born ancestors
by Maheśvara when he was pleased, after the serpent-hole was filled up.

5.180.s:
tasya dattasya cādyaiva pitāmahaśataṃ gatam ..
paṃcottaramasandigdhaṃ yāvattvaṃ kupitāmaha .. 4 ..
5.180.d:
तस्य दत्तस्य चाद्यैव पितामहशतं गतम् ..
पंचोत्तरमसन्दिग्धं यावत्त्वं कुपितामह .. 4 ..
5.180.m:
And since it was given, one hundred and five Grandfathers have passed away,
undoubtedly, until you, O bad grandfather!

5.180.s:
na kenāpi kṛto'smākaṃ tiraskāro yathā'dhunā ..
tvāṃ muktvā pāpakarmāṇaṃ nyāyamārgavivarjitam .. 5 ..
5.180.d:
न केनापि कृतोऽस्माकं तिरस्कारो यथाऽधुना ..
त्वां मुक्त्वा पापकर्माणं न्यायमार्गविवर्जितम् .. 5 ..
5.180.m:
No one has ever shown such contempt for us as [you do] now,
except you, an evil-doer devoid of the path of justice!

5.180.s:
nāgarairbrāhmaṇairbāhyaṃ yo'tra yajñaṃ samācaret ..
śrāddhaṃ vā sa hi vadhyaḥ syātsarveṣāṃ ca dvijanmanām .. 6 ..
5.180.d:
नागरैर्ब्राह्मणैर्बाह्यं योऽत्र यज्ञं समाचरेत् ..
श्राद्धं वा स हि वध्यः स्यात्सर्वेषां च द्विजन्मनाम् .. 6 ..
5.180.m:
Whoever performs a sacrifice here or a śrāddha outside of the Nāgara brahmins,
he should be slain by all the twice-born!

5.180.s:
na tasya jāyate śreyastatsamutthaṃ kathaṃcana ..
etatproktaṃ tadā tena yadā sthānaṃ dadau hi naḥ .. 7 ..
5.180.d:
न तस्य जायते श्रेयस्तत्समुत्थं कथंचन ..
एतत्प्रोक्तं तदा तेन यदा स्थानं ददौ हि नः .. 7 ..
5.180.m:
No good fortune arising from it can ever accrue to him.'
This was declared by him at that time when he gave us the place.

5.180.s:
tasmādyatkuruṣe yajñaṃ brāhmaṇairnāgaraiḥ kuru ..
nānyathā lapsyase kartuṃ jīvadbhirnāgarairdvijaiḥ .. 8 ..
5.180.d:
तस्माद्यत्कुरुषे यज्ञं ब्राह्मणैर्नागरैः कुरु ..
नान्यथा लप्स्यसे कर्तुं जीवद्भिर्नागरैर्द्विजैः .. 8 ..
5.180.m:
'Therefore, whatever sacrifice you perform, perform it with Nāgara brahmins;
otherwise, while the Nāgara twice-born live, you will not be permitted to perform it.'"

5.180.s:
evamuktastato gatvā madhyago yatra padmajaḥ ..
yajñamaṇḍapadūrastho brāhmaṇaiḥ parivāritaḥ .. 9 ..
5.180.d:
एवमुक्तस्ततो गत्वा मध्यगो यत्र पद्मजः ..
यज्ञमण्डपदूरस्थो ब्राह्मणैः परिवारितः .. 9 ..
5.180.m:
Being addressed thus, Madhyaga went to where the lotus-born [Brahmā] was,
standing far from the sacrificial pavilion, surrounded by brahmins.

5.180.s:
yatproktaṃ nāgaraiḥ sarvaiḥ saviśeṣaṃ tadā hi saḥ ..
tacchrutvā padmajaḥ prāha sāṃtvapūrvamidaṃ vacaḥ .. 6.181.10 ..
5.180.d:
यत्प्रोक्तं नागरैः सर्वैः सविशेषं तदा हि सः ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा पद्मजः प्राह सांत्वपूर्वमिदं वचः .. 6.181.10 ..
5.180.m:
He then related in detail what had been spoken by all the Nāgaras.
Having heard that, the lotus-born spoke these concilatory words,

5.180.s:
mānuṣaṃ bhāvamāpanna ṛtvigbhiḥ parivāritaḥ ..
tvayā satyamidaṃ proktaṃ sarvaṃ madhyagasattama .. 11 ..
5.180.d:
मानुषं भावमापन्न ऋत्विग्भिः परिवारितः ..
त्वया सत्यमिदं प्रोक्तं सर्वं मध्यगसत्तम .. 11 ..
5.180.m:
having assumed human form, surrounded by the officiating priests:
"All that has been said by you is true, O best of Madhyagas.

5.180.s:
kiṃ karomi vṛtāḥ sarve mayā te yajñakarmaṇi ..
ṛtvijo'dhvaryu pūrvā ye pramādena na kāmyayā .. 12 ..
5.180.d:
किं करोमि वृताः सर्वे मया ते यज्ञकर्मणि ..
ऋत्विजोऽध्वर्यु पूर्वा ये प्रमादेन न काम्यया .. 12 ..
5.180.m:
What shall I do? All those priests, beginning with the adhvaryu,
were chosen by me for the sacrificial rite out of negligence, not out of desire.

5.180.s:
tasmādānaya tānsarvānatra sthāne dvijottamān ..
anujñātastu tairyena gacchāmi makhamaṇḍape .. 13 .. ..
5.180.d:
तस्मादानय तान्सर्वानत्र स्थाने द्विजोत्तमान् ..
अनुज्ञातस्तु तैर्येन गच्छामि मखमण्डपे .. 13 .. ..
5.180.m:
Therefore, bring all those foremost twice-born to this place,
so that, permitted by them, I may enter the sacrificial pavilion."

5.180.s:
.. madhyaga uvāca .. ..
tvaṃ devatvaṃ parityajya mānuṣaṃ bhāvamāśritaḥ ..
tatkathaṃ te dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ samāgacchaṃti teṃ'tikam .. 14 ..
5.180.d:
.. मध्यग उवाच .. ..
त्वं देवत्वं परित्यज्य मानुषं भावमाश्रितः ..
तत्कथं ते द्विजश्रेष्ठाः समागच्छंति तेंऽतिकम् .. 14 ..

5.180.s:
śreṣṭhā gāvaḥ paśūnāṃ ca yathā padmasamudbhava ..
viprāṇāmiha sarveṣāṃ tathā śreṣṭhā hi nāgarāḥ .. 15 ..
5.180.d:
श्रेष्ठा गावः पशूनां च यथा पद्मसमुद्भव ..
विप्राणामिह सर्वेषां तथा श्रेष्ठा हि नागराः .. 15 ..
5.180.m:
Just as cows are the foremost among beasts, O lotus-born one,
so indeed are the Nāgaras foremost among all brahmins here.

5.180.s:
tatmāccedvāṃchasi prāptiṃ tvametāṃ yajñasaṃbhavām ..
tadbhaktyānāgarānsarvānprasādaya pitāmaha .. 16 ..
5.180.d:
तत्माच्चेद्वांछसि प्राप्तिं त्वमेतां यज्ञसंभवाम् ..
तद्भक्त्यानागरान्सर्वान्प्रसादय पितामह .. 16 ..
5.180.m:
Therefore, Grandfather, if you desire this attainment arising from the sacrifice,
then appease all the Nāgaras with devotion."

5.180.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tacchrutvā padmajo bhīta ṛtvigbhiḥ parivāritaḥ ..
jagāma tatra yatrasthā nāgarāḥ kupitā dvijāḥ ..17..
5.180.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा पद्मजो भीत ऋत्विग्भिः परिवारितः ..
जगाम तत्र यत्रस्था नागराः कुपिता द्विजाः ..17..
5.180.m:
Sūta said:
Having heard that, the lotus-born, frightened and surrounded by the officiating priests,
went to where the angry Nāgara twice-born were staying.

5.180.s:
praṇipatya tataḥ sarvānvinayena samanvitaḥ ..
provāca vacanaṃ śrutvā kṛtāṃjalipuṭaḥ sthitaḥ..18..
5.180.d:
प्रणिपत्य ततः सर्वान्विनयेन समन्वितः ..
प्रोवाच वचनं श्रुत्वा कृतांजलिपुटः स्थितः..18..
5.180.m:
Then, having bowed down to all of them, endowed with humility,
standing with hands folded in supplication, he spoke these words after hearing [them]:

5.180.s:
jānāmyahaṃ dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ kṣetre'sminhāṭa keśvare ..
yuṣmadbāhyaṃ vṛthā śrāddhaṃ yajñakarma tathaiva ca .. 19 ..
5.180.d:
जानाम्यहं द्विजश्रेष्ठाः क्षेत्रेऽस्मिन्हाट केश्वरे ..
युष्मद्बाह्यं वृथा श्राद्धं यज्ञकर्म तथैव च .. 19 ..
5.180.m:
"I know, O foremost twice-born, that in this sacred field of Hāṭakeśvara,
a śrāddha or a sacrificial rite performed without you is in vain.

5.180.s:
kalibhītyā mayā''nītaṃ sthāne'sminpuṣkaraṃ nijam ..
tīrthaṃ ca yuṣmadīyaṃ ca nikṣepo' yaṃsamarpitaḥ .. 6.181.20 ..
5.180.d:
कलिभीत्या मया'ऽनीतं स्थानेऽस्मिन्पुष्करं निजम् ..
तीर्थं च युष्मदीयं च निक्षेपो' यंसमर्पितः .. 6.181.20 ..
5.180.m:
Out of fear of the Kali [age], my own Puṣkara tīrtha was brought to this place
and your tīrtha was entrusted as a deposit.

5.180.s:
ṛtvijo'mī samānītā guruṇā yajñasiddhaye ..
ajānatā dvijaśreṣṭhā ādhikyaṃ nāgarātmakam .. 21 ..
5.180.d:
ऋत्विजोऽमी समानीता गुरुणा यज्ञसिद्धये ..
अजानता द्विजश्रेष्ठा आधिक्यं नागरात्मकम् .. 21 ..
5.180.m:
These officiating priests were brought by the preceptor for the success of the sacrifice,
he being unaware, O foremost twice-born, of the pre-eminence belonging to the Nāgaras.

5.180.s:
tasmācca kṣamyatāṃ mahyaṃ yataśca varaṇaṃ kṛtam ..
eteṣāmeva viprāṇāmagniṣṭomakṛte mayā .. 22 ..
5.180.d:
तस्माच्च क्षम्यतां मह्यं यतश्च वरणं कृतम् ..
एतेषामेव विप्राणामग्निष्टोमकृते मया .. 22 ..
5.180.m:
Therefore, let me be forgiven, since the appointment of these very brahmins
was already made by me for the sake of the Agniṣṭoma sacrifice."

5.180.s:
etacca māmakaṃ tīrthaṃ yuṣmākaṃ pāpanāśanam ..
bhaviṣyati na sandehaḥ kalikāle'pi saṃsthite .. 23 ..
5.180.d:
एतच्च मामकं तीर्थं युष्माकं पापनाशनम् ..
भविष्यति न सन्देहः कलिकालेऽपि संस्थिते .. 23 ..
5.180.m: And this sacred ford of mine will destroy your sins, / without a doubt, even when the Kali age is established. // 23

5.180.s:
.. brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ .. ..
yadi tvaṃ nāgarairbāhyaṃ yajñaṃ cātra kariṣyasi ..
tadanye'pi surāḥ sarve tava mārgānuyāyi naḥ ..
bhaviṣyanti tathā bhūpāstatkāryo na makhastvayā .. 24 ..
5.180.d:
.. ब्राह्मणा ऊचुः .. ..
यदि त्वं नागरैर्बाह्यं यज्ञं चात्र करिष्यसि ..
तदन्येऽपि सुराः सर्वे तव मार्गानुयायि नः ..
भविष्यन्ति तथा भूपास्तत्कार्यो न मखस्त्वया .. 24 ..
5.180.m: The brahmins said: / If you perform the sacrifice here excluding the Nāgaras, / then all other gods too, and likewise kings, will follow your path; / therefore, you must not perform the sacrifice [in this way]. // 24

5.180.s:
yadyevamapi deveśa yajñakarma kariṣyasi ..
avamanya dvijānsarvākṣipraṃ gacchāsmadaṃtikāt .. 25 ..
5.180.d:
यद्येवमपि देवेश यज्ञकर्म करिष्यसि ..
अवमन्य द्विजान्सर्वाक्षिप्रं गच्छास्मदंतिकात् .. 25 ..
5.180.m: If, O lord of the gods, you still perform the sacrificial rite / while disregarding all the brahmins, leave our presence immediately. // 25

5.180.s:
.. brahmovāca .. ..
adyaprabhṛti yaḥ kaścidyajñamatra kariṣyati ..
śrāddhaṃ vā nāgarairbāhyaṃ vṛthā tatsaṃbhaviṣyati ..26..
5.180.d:
.. ब्रह्मोवाच .. ..
अद्यप्रभृति यः कश्चिद्यज्ञमत्र करिष्यति ..
श्राद्धं वा नागरैर्बाह्यं वृथा तत्संभविष्यति ..26..
5.180.m: Brahmā said: / From this day forward, whoever performs a sacrifice here, / or a śrāddha, excluding the Nāgaras, it shall be in vain. // 26

5.180.s:
nāgaro'pi ca yo nyatra kaścidyajñaṃ kariṣyati ..
etatkṣetraṃ parityajya vṛthā tatsaṃbhaviṣyati .. 27 ..
5.180.d:
नागरोऽपि च यो न्यत्र कश्चिद्यज्ञं करिष्यति ..
एतत्क्षेत्रं परित्यज्य वृथा तत्संभविष्यति .. 27 ..
5.180.m: And whichever Nāgara performs a sacrifice elsewhere, / abandoning this sacred field, that too shall be in vain. // 27

5.180.s:
maryādeyaṃ kṛtā viprā nāgarāṇāṃ mayā'dhunā ..
kṛtvā prasādamasmākaṃ yajñārthaṃ dātumarhatha ..
anujñāṃ vidhivadviprā yena yajñaṃ karomyaham .. 28 ..
5.180.d:
मर्यादेयं कृता विप्रा नागराणां मयाऽधुना ..
कृत्वा प्रसादमस्माकं यज्ञार्थं दातुमर्हथ ..
अनुज्ञां विधिवद्विप्रा येन यज्ञं करोम्यहम् .. 28 ..
5.180.m: This rule has now been established by me, O brahmins, for the Nāgaras. / Bestow your grace upon us, and be pleased to grant / permission according to rule, O brahmins, so that I may perform the sacrifice. // 28

5.180.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tatastairbrāhmaṇaistuṣṭairanujñātaḥ pitāmahaḥ ..
cakāra vidhivadyajñaṃ ye vṛtā brāhmaṇāśca taiḥ .. 29 ..
5.180.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
ततस्तैर्ब्राह्मणैस्तुष्टैरनुज्ञातः पितामहः ..
चकार विधिवद्यज्ञं ये वृता ब्राह्मणाश्च तैः .. 29 ..
5.180.m: Sūta said: / Thereupon, permitted by those gratified brahmins, the grandfather [Brahmā] / performed the sacrifice according to rule, along with those brahmins who had been chosen. // 29

5.180.s:
viśvakarmā samāgatya tato mastakamaṇḍanam ..
cakāra brāhmaṇaśreṣṭhā nāgarāṇāṃ mate sthitaḥ .. 6.181.30 ..
5.180.d:
विश्वकर्मा समागत्य ततो मस्तकमण्डनम् ..
चकार ब्राह्मणश्रेष्ठा नागराणां मते स्थितः .. 6.181.30 ..
5.180.m: Then Viśvakarman arrived and, conforming to the opinion of the Nāgaras, / performed the head-adornment, O best of brahmins. // 30

5.180.s:
brahmāpi paramaṃ toṣaṃ gatvā nāradamabravīt ..
sāvitrīmānaya kṣipraṃ yena gacchāmi maṇḍape .. 31 ..
5.180.d:
ब्रह्मापि परमं तोषं गत्वा नारदमब्रवीत् ..
सावित्रीमानय क्षिप्रं येन गच्छामि मण्डपे .. 31 ..
5.180.m: Brahmā too, having attained supreme satisfaction, said to Nārada: / 'Bring Sāvitrī quickly, so that I may go into the pavilion.' // 31

5.180.s:
vādyamāneṣu vādyeṣu siddhakinnaraguhyakaiḥ ..
gandharvairgītasaṃsaktairvedoccāraparairdvijaiḥ ..
araṇiṃ samupādāya pulastyo vākyamabravīt .. 32 ..
5.180.d:
वाद्यमानेषु वाद्येषु सिद्धकिन्नरगुह्यकैः ..
गन्धर्वैर्गीतसंसक्तैर्वेदोच्चारपरैर्द्विजैः ..
अरणिं समुपादाय पुलस्त्यो वाक्यमब्रवीत् .. 32 ..
5.180.m: While musical instruments were being played by Siddhas, Kinnaras, and Guhyakas, / with Gandharvas engaged in singing, and brahmins devoted to chanting the Vedas, / Pulastya took up the churning-stick and spoke these words: // 32

5.180.s: patnī 3 patnīti viprendrāḥ proccaistatra vyavasthitāḥ .. 33 ..
5.180.d: पत्नी 3 पत्नीति विप्रेन्द्राः प्रोच्चैस्तत्र व्यवस्थिताः .. 33 ..
5.180.m: 'Wife! Wife!' the foremost of brahmins [cried] aloud, stationed there. // 33

5.180.s:
etasminnaṃtare brahmā nāradaṃ munisattamam..
saṃjñayā preṣayāmāsa patnī cānīyatāmiti .. 34 ..
5.180.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे ब्रह्मा नारदं मुनिसत्तमम्..
संज्ञया प्रेषयामास पत्नी चानीयतामिति .. 34 ..
5.180.m: In the meantime, Brahmā dispatched Nārada, the best of sages, / by a sign, [saying], 'Let my wife be brought.' // 34

5.180.s:
so'pi maṃdaṃ samāgatya sāvitrīṃ prāha līlayā ..
yuddhapriyoṃ'taraṃ vāṃchansāvitryā saha vedhasaḥ [. 35 ..
5.180.d:
सोऽपि मंदं समागत्य सावित्रीं प्राह लीलया ..
युद्धप्रियोंऽतरं वांछन्सावित्र्या सह वेधसः [. 35 ..
5.180.m: He went slowly and playfully said to Sāvitrī— / he who loved strife, desiring a rift between Sāvitrī and the Creator: // 35

5.180.s:
ahaṃ saṃpreṣitaḥ pitrā tava pārśve sureśvari ..
āgaccha prasthitaḥ snātaḥ sāṃprataṃ yajñamaṇḍape .. 36 ..
5.180.d:
अहं संप्रेषितः पित्रा तव पार्श्वे सुरेश्वरि ..
आगच्छ प्रस्थितः स्नातः सांप्रतं यज्ञमण्डपे .. 36 ..
5.180.m: 'I have been sent to you by Father, O queen of gods. / Come; having bathed, he has just now departed for the sacrificial pavilion. // 36

5.180.s:
paramekākinī tatra gacchamānā sureśvari ..
kīdṛgrūpā sadasi vai dṛśyase tvamanāthavat .. 37 ..
5.180.d:
परमेकाकिनी तत्र गच्छमाना सुरेश्वरि ..
कीदृग्रूपा सदसि वै दृश्यसे त्वमनाथवत् .. 37 ..
5.180.m: Yet going there entirely alone, O queen of gods, / how would you appear in the assembly, looking like one without a protector? // 37

5.180.s:
tasmādānīyatāṃ sarvā yāḥ kāściddevayoṣitaḥ ..
yābhiḥ parivṛtā devi yāsyasi tvaṃ mahāmakhe .. 38 ..
5.180.d:
तस्मादानीयतां सर्वा याः काश्चिद्देवयोषितः ..
याभिः परिवृता देवि यास्यसि त्वं महामखे .. 38 ..
5.180.m: Therefore, let all the celestial women, whoever they may be, be brought, / surrounded by whom you will go to the great sacrifice, O goddess.' // 38

5.180.s:
evamuktvā muniśreṣṭho nārado munisattamaḥ ..
abravītpitaraṃ gatvā tātāṃbā''kāritā mayā .. 39 ..
paraṃ tasyāḥ sthiro bhāvaḥ kiṃcitsaṃlakṣito mayā ..
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā tato manyusamanvitaḥ..6.181.4...
5.180.d:
एवमुक्त्वा मुनिश्रेष्ठो नारदो मुनिसत्तमः ..
अब्रवीत्पितरं गत्वा तातांबा'ऽकारिता मया .. 39 ..
परं तस्याः स्थिरो भावः किंचित्संलक्षितो मया ..
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा ततो मन्युसमन्वितः..6.181.4...
5.180.m:
Having spoken thus, the best of sages, Nārada, that most excellent sage, / went and said to his father: 'Father, Mother has been summoned by me. // 39
However, a certain stillness of disposition was observed by me in her.' / Having heard those words of his, then filled with anger, // 40

5.180.s:
pulastyaṃ preṣayāmāsa sāvitryā sannidhau tataḥ ..
gaccha vatsa tvamānīhi sthānaṃ sā śithilātmikā ..
somabhārapariśrāṃtaṃ paśya māmūrdhvasaṃsthitam..41..
5.180.d:
पुलस्त्यं प्रेषयामास सावित्र्या सन्निधौ ततः ..
गच्छ वत्स त्वमानीहि स्थानं सा शिथिलात्मिका ..
सोमभारपरिश्रांतं पश्य मामूर्ध्वसंस्थितम्..41..
5.180.m: he sent Pulastya to Sāvitrī's presence: / 'Go, my child, bring her to this place; she is indolent. / Look at me standing upright, exhausted by the burden of the soma. // 41

5.180.s:
eṣa kālātyayo bhāvi yajñakarmaṇi sāṃpratam..
yajñayānamuhūrto'yaṃ sāvaśeṣo vyavasthitaḥ ..42..
5.180.d:
एष कालात्ययो भावि यज्ञकर्मणि सांप्रतम्..
यज्ञयानमुहूर्तोऽयं सावशेषो व्यवस्थितः ..42..
5.180.m: A lapse of the proper time will occur now in this sacrificial rite; / the auspicious hour for proceeding to the sacrifice has only a little remaining.' // 42

5.180.s:
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā pulastyaḥ satvaraṃ yayau ..
sāvitrī tiṣṭhate yatra gītanṛtyasamākulā .. 43 ..
5.180.d:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा पुलस्त्यः सत्वरं ययौ ..
सावित्री तिष्ठते यत्र गीतनृत्यसमाकुला .. 43 ..
5.180.m: Hearing his words, Pulastya went swiftly / to where Sāvitrī remained, surrounded by singing and dancing. // 43

5.180.s:
tataḥ provāca kiṃ devi tvaṃ tiṣṭhasi nirākulā ..
yajñayānocitaḥ kālaḥ so'yaṃ śeṣastu tiṣṭhati ..44..
5.180.d:
ततः प्रोवाच किं देवि त्वं तिष्ठसि निराकुला ..
यज्ञयानोचितः कालः सोऽयं शेषस्तु तिष्ठति ..44..
5.180.m: Then he said: 'Why, O goddess, do you remain untroubled? / That very time suitable for proceeding to the sacrifice has only a fraction left. // 44

5.180.s:
tasmādāgaccha gacchāmastātaḥ kṛcchreṇa tiṣṭhati..
somabhārārdditaścordhvaṃ sarvairdevaiḥ samāvṛtaḥ ..45..
5.180.d:
तस्मादागच्छ गच्छामस्तातः कृच्छ्रेण तिष्ठति..
सोमभारार्द्दितश्चोर्ध्वं सर्वैर्देवैः समावृतः ..45..
5.180.m: Therefore come, let us go; Father waits with difficulty, / distressed by the burden of the soma, standing upright, surrounded by all the gods.' // 45

5.180.s:
.. sāvitryuvāca .. ..
sarvadevavṛtastāta tava tāto vyavasthitaḥ ..
ekākinī kathaṃ tatra gacchāmyahamanāthavat ..46..
5.180.d:
.. सावित्र्युवाच .. ..
सर्वदेववृतस्तात तव तातो व्यवस्थितः ..
एकाकिनी कथं तत्र गच्छाम्यहमनाथवत् ..46..
5.180.m: Sāvitrī said: / 'My child, your father waits surrounded by all the gods; / how can I go there alone, like one without a protector? // 46

5.180.s: tadbrūhi pitaraṃ gatvā muhūrtaṃ paripālyatām ..47..
5.180.d: तद्ब्रूहि पितरं गत्वा मुहूर्तं परिपाल्यताम् ..47..
5.180.m: Therefore go and tell Father: "Let him wait for a muhūrta." // 47

5.180.s:
yāvadabhyeti śakrāṇī gaurī lakṣmīstathā parāḥ..
devakanyāḥ samāje'tra tābhireṣyāmyaha8drutam .. 48 ..
5.180.d:
यावदभ्येति शक्राणी गौरी लक्ष्मीस्तथा पराः..
देवकन्याः समाजेऽत्र ताभिरेष्याम्यह8द्रुतम् .. 48 ..
5.180.m: Until Śakrāṇī, Gaurī, Lakṣmī, and other celestial maidens / arrive in this gathering, with them I will come swiftly. // 48

5.180.s:
sarvāsāṃ preṣito vāyurnimatraṇakṛte mayā ..
āgamiṣyanti tāḥ śīghramevaṃ vācyaḥ pitā tvayā ..49..
5.180.d:
सर्वासां प्रेषितो वायुर्निमत्रणकृते मया ..
आगमिष्यन्ति ताः शीघ्रमेवं वाच्यः पिता त्वया ..49..
5.180.m: Vāyu has been sent by me to invite them all; / they will come quickly—so you must tell Father.' // 49

5.180.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
so'pi gatvā drutaṃ prāha somabhārārditaṃ vidhim..
naiṣābhyeti jagannātha prasaktā gṛhakarmaṇi .. 6.181.50 ..
5.180.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
सोऽपि गत्वा द्रुतं प्राह सोमभारार्दितं विधिम्..
नैषाभ्येति जगन्नाथ प्रसक्ता गृहकर्मणि .. 6.181.50 ..
5.180.m: Sūta said: / He too, having gone swiftly, said to the Creator, who was afflicted by the burden of the soma: / 'She does not come, O Lord of the Universe, being occupied with household duties. // 50

5.180.s:
sā māṃ prāha ca devānāṃ patnībhiḥ sahitā makhe ..
ahaṃ yāsyāmi tāsāṃ ca naikādyāpi pradṛśyate .. 51 ..
5.180.d:
सा मां प्राह च देवानां पत्नीभिः सहिता मखे ..
अहं यास्यामि तासां च नैकाद्यापि प्रदृश्यते .. 51 ..
5.180.m: And she said to me: "I shall go to the sacrifice accompanied by the wives of the gods." / And not one of them is seen yet. // 51

5.180.s:
evaṃ jñātvā suraśreṣṭha kuru yatte surocate ..
atikrāmati kālo'yaṃ yajñayānasamudravaḥ ..
tiṣṭhate ca gṛhavyagrā sāpi strī śithilātmikā .. 52 ..
5.180.d:
एवं ज्ञात्वा सुरश्रेष्ठ कुरु यत्ते सुरोचते ..
अतिक्रामति कालोऽयं यज्ञयानसमुद्रवः ..
तिष्ठते च गृहव्यग्रा सापि स्त्री शिथिलात्मिका .. 52 ..
5.180.m: Knowing this, O best of the gods, do what pleases you best. / This time belonging to proceeding to the sacrifice is passing away, / and she remains occupied with household affairs, that indolent woman.' // 52

5.180.s:
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya pulastyasya pitāmahaḥ ..
samīpasthaṃ tadā śakraṃ provāca vacanaṃ dvijāḥ .. 53 ..
5.180.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य पुलस्त्यस्य पितामहः ..
समीपस्थं तदा शक्रं प्रोवाच वचनं द्विजाः .. 53 ..
5.180.m: Hearing that speech of Pulastya, the Grandfather [Brahmā] / then spoke these words to Śakra standing near, O brahmins: // 53

5.180.s:
.. brahmovāca .. ..
śakra nāyāti sāvitrī sāpi strī śithilātmikā ..
anayā bhāryayā yajño mayā kāryo'yameva tu .. 54 ..
5.180.d:
.. ब्रह्मोवाच .. ..
शक्र नायाति सावित्री सापि स्त्री शिथिलात्मिका ..
अनया भार्यया यज्ञो मया कार्योऽयमेव तु .. 54 ..
5.180.m: Brahmā said: / 'Śakra, Sāvitrī does not come; that woman is indolent. / But this sacrifice must certainly be performed by me with a wife. // 54

5.180.s:
gaccha śakra samānīhi kanyāṃ kāṃcittvarānvitaḥ ..
yāvanna kramate kālo yajñayānasamudbhavaḥ .. 55 ..
5.180.d:
गच्छ शक्र समानीहि कन्यां कांचित्त्वरान्वितः ..
यावन्न क्रमते कालो यज्ञयानसमुद्भवः .. 55 ..
5.180.m: Go, Śakra, and bring some maiden with haste, / before the time for proceeding to the sacrifice has passed.' // 55

5.180.s:
pitāmahavacaḥ śrutvā tadarthaṃ kanyakā dvijāḥ ..
śakreṇāsāditā śīghraṃ bhramamāṇā samīpataḥ .. 56 ..
5.180.d:
पितामहवचः श्रुत्वा तदर्थं कन्यका द्विजाः ..
शक्रेणासादिता शीघ्रं भ्रममाणा समीपतः .. 56 ..
5.180.m: Having heard the Grandfather's words, a maiden for that purpose, O brahmins, / was quickly found by Śakra wandering nearby. // 56

5.180.s:
atha takraghaṭavyagramastakā tena vīkṣitā ..
kanyakā gopajā tanvī caṃdrāsyā padmalocanā .. 57 ..
5.180.d:
अथ तक्रघटव्यग्रमस्तका तेन वीक्षिता ..
कन्यका गोपजा तन्वी चंद्रास्या पद्मलोचना .. 57 ..
5.180.m: Then a girl born of a cowherd was seen by him, her head occupied with a pot of buttermilk, / slender, moon-faced, and lotus-eyed, // 57

5.180.s:
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpūrṇā yauvanāraṃbhamāśritā ..
sā śakreṇātha saṃpṛṣṭā kā tvaṃ kamalalocane .. 58 ..
5.180.d:
सर्वलक्षणसंपूर्णा यौवनारंभमाश्रिता ..
सा शक्रेणाथ संपृष्टा का त्वं कमललोचने .. 58 ..
5.180.m: endowed with all auspicious marks, entering the bloom of youth. / She was then asked by Śakra: 'Who are you, O lotus-eyed one? // 58

5.180.s: kumārī vā sanāthā vā sutā kasya bravīhi naḥ .. 59 ..
5.180.d: कुमारी वा सनाथा वा सुता कस्य ब्रवीहि नः .. 59 ..
5.180.m: Are you an unmarried girl, or do you have a husband? Whose daughter are you? Tell us.' // 59

5.180.s:
.. kanyo vāca .. ..
gopakanyāsmi bhadraṃ te takraṃ vikretumāgatā ..
yadi gṛhṇāsi me mūlyaṃ tacchīghraṃ dehi mā ciram .. 6.181.60 ..
5.180.d:
.. कन्यो वाच .. ..
गोपकन्यास्मि भद्रं ते तक्रं विक्रेतुमागता ..
यदि गृह्णासि मे मूल्यं तच्छीघ्रं देहि मा चिरम् .. 6.181.60 ..
5.180.m: The girl said: / 'I am a cowherd girl, may you be blessed; I have come to sell buttermilk. / If you will take it, give me the price quickly, do not delay.' // 60

5.180.s:
tacchrutvā tridivendro'pi matvā tāṃ gopakanyakām ..
jagṛhe tvarayā yuktastakraṃ cotsṛjya bhūtale .. 61 ..
5.180.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा त्रिदिवेन्द्रोऽपि मत्वा तां गोपकन्यकाम् ..
जगृहे त्वरया युक्तस्तक्रं चोत्सृज्य भूतले .. 61 ..
5.180.m: Hearing that, the lord of heaven [Indra], recognizing that she was a cowherd girl, / seized her with haste, casting the buttermilk down onto the ground. // 61

5.180.s:
atha tāṃ rudatīṃ śakraḥ samādāya tvarānvitaḥ ..
govaktreṇa praveśyātha guhyenākarṣayattataḥ .. 62 ..
5.180.d:
अथ तां रुदतीं शक्रः समादाय त्वरान्वितः ..
गोवक्त्रेण प्रवेश्याथ गुह्येनाकर्षयत्ततः .. 62 ..
5.180.m: Then Śakra, taking that weeping girl in haste, / caused her to enter through the mouth of a cow and pulled her out through its anus. // 62

5.180.s:
evaṃ medhyatamāṃ kṛtvā saṃsnāpya salilaiḥ śubhaiḥ ..
jyeṣṭhakuṇḍasya viprendrāḥ paridhāyya suvāsasī .. 63 ..
5.180.d:
एवं मेध्यतमां कृत्वा संस्नाप्य सलिलैः शुभैः ..
ज्येष्ठकुण्डस्य विप्रेन्द्राः परिधाय्य सुवाससी .. 63 ..
5.180.m: Having thus made her supremely pure, having bathed her in the auspicious waters / of the Jyeṣṭhakuṇḍa, O foremost of brahmins, and dressed her in two fine garments, // 63

5.180.s:
tataśca harṣasaṃyuktaḥ provāca caturānanam ..
drutaṃ gatvā puro dhṛtvā sarvadevasamāgame .. 64 ..
5.180.d:
ततश्च हर्षसंयुक्तः प्रोवाच चतुराननम् ..
द्रुतं गत्वा पुरो धृत्वा सर्वदेवसमागमे .. 64 ..
5.180.m: and then filled with joy, he went quickly and presented her in front of the Four-faced One [Brahmā], / in the assembly of all the gods, and spoke: // 64

5.180.s:
kanyakeyaṃ suraśreṣṭha samānītā mayā'dhunā ..
tavārthāya surūpāṃgī sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitā .. 65 ..
5.180.d:
कन्यकेयं सुरश्रेष्ठ समानीता मयाऽधुना ..
तवार्थाय सुरूपांगी सर्वलक्षणलक्षिता .. 65 ..
5.180.m: "This maiden, O best of the gods, has now been brought by me / for your sake, lovely-limbed and marked with all auspicious marks.

5.180.s:
gopakanyā viditvemāṃ govaktreṇa praveśya ca ..
ākarṣitā ca guhyena pāvanārthaṃ caturmukha .. 66 ..
5.180.d:
गोपकन्या विदित्वेमां गोवक्त्रेण प्रवेश्य च ..
आकर्षिता च गुह्येन पावनार्थं चतुर्मुख .. 66 ..
5.180.m: Knowing her to be a cowherd's daughter, and having made her enter through the mouth of a cow, / she was drawn out through the secret parts for purification, O four-faced one."

5.180.s:
.. śrīvāsudeva uvāca .. ..
gavāṃ ca brāhmaṇānāṃ ca kulamekaṃ dvidhā kṛtam ..
ekatra maṃtrāstiṣṭhaṃti haviranyatra tiṣṭhati .. 67 ..
5.180.d:
.. श्रीवासुदेव उवाच .. ..
गवां च ब्राह्मणानां च कुलमेकं द्विधा कृतम् ..
एकत्र मंत्रास्तिष्ठंति हविरन्यत्र तिष्ठति .. 67 ..
5.180.m: The venerable Vāsudeva said: / "The family of cows and that of brahmins was made one, divided in two: / in one reside the mantras, while in the other resides the oblation.

5.180.s:
dhenūdarādviniṣkrāṃtā tajjāteyaṃ dvijanmanām ..
asyāḥ pāṇigrahaṃ deva tvaṃ kuruṣva makhāptaye .. 68
5.180.d:
धेनूदराद्विनिष्क्रांता तज्जातेयं द्विजन्मनाम् ..
अस्याः पाणिग्रहं देव त्वं कुरुष्व मखाप्तये .. 68
5.180.m: She came forth from the belly of a cow; she is born of that [lineage] of the twice-born. / O god, take her hand in marriage for the attainment of the sacrifice,

5.180.s: yāvanna calate kālo yajñayānasamudbhavaḥ .. 69 ..
5.180.d: यावन्न चलते कालो यज्ञयानसमुद्भवः .. 69 ..
5.180.m: as long as the time appointed for the sacrificial performance does not slip away."

5.180.s:
.. rudra uvāca .. ..
praviṣṭā gomukhe yasmādapānena vinirgatā ..
gāyatrīnāma te patnī tasmādeṣā bhaviṣyati .. 6.181.70 ..
5.180.d:
.. रुद्र उवाच .. ..
प्रविष्टा गोमुखे यस्मादपानेन विनिर्गता ..
गायत्रीनाम ते पत्नी तस्मादेषा भविष्यति .. 6.181.70 ..
5.180.m: Rudra said: / "Because she entered into the mouth of the cow and came forth through the anus, / she shall therefore become your wife, named Gāyatrī."

5.180.s:
.. brahmovāca .. ..
vadantu brāhmaṇāḥ sarve gopakanyāpyasau yadi ..
saṃbhūya brāhmaṇīśreṣṭhā yathā patnī bhavenmama .. 71 ..
5.180.d:
.. ब्रह्मोवाच .. ..
वदन्तु ब्राह्मणाः सर्वे गोपकन्याप्यसौ यदि ..
संभूय ब्राह्मणीश्रेष्ठा यथा पत्नी भवेन्मम .. 71 ..
5.180.m: Brahmā said: / "Let all the brahmins declare whether she, even if a cowherd's daughter, / can become the best of brahmin women and be my wife."

5.180.s:
.. brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ .. ..
eṣā syādbrāhmaṇaśreṣṭhā gopajātivivarjitā ..
asmadvākyāccaturvaktra kuru pāṇigrahaṃ drutam .. 72 ..
5.180.d:
.. ब्राह्मणा ऊचुः .. ..
एषा स्याद्ब्राह्मणश्रेष्ठा गोपजातिविवर्जिता ..
अस्मद्वाक्याच्चतुर्वक्त्र कुरु पाणिग्रहं द्रुतम् .. 72 ..
5.180.m: The brahmins said: / "She is the best of brahmin women, free from the cowherd caste. / Upon our word, O four-faced one, take her hand in marriage quickly."

5.180.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tataḥ pāṇigrahaṃ cakre tasyā devaḥ pitāmahaḥ ..
kṛtvā somaṃ tato mūrdhni gṛhyoktavidhinā dvijāḥ .. 73 ..
5.180.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
ततः पाणिग्रहं चक्रे तस्या देवः पितामहः ..
कृत्वा सोमं ततो मूर्ध्नि गृह्योक्तविधिना द्विजाः .. 73 ..
5.180.m: Sūta said: / Then the god, the grandfather, took her hand in marriage, / having placed soma on her head according to the rule declared in the Gṛhya [texts], O twice-born ones.

5.180.s:
saṃtiṣṭhati ca tatrasthā mahādevī supāvanī ..
adyāpi loke vikhyātā dhanasaubhāgyadāyinī .. .. 74 ..
5.180.d:
संतिष्ठति च तत्रस्था महादेवी सुपावनी ..
अद्यापि लोके विख्याता धनसौभाग्यदायिनी .. .. 74 ..
5.180.m: And dwelling there stands the great goddess, exceedingly purifying, / renowned in the world even today, bestowing wealth and good fortune.

5.180.s:
yastasyāṃ kurute martyaḥ kanyādānaṃ samāhitaḥ ..
samastaṃ phalamāpnoti rājasūyāśvamedhayoḥ .. 79 ..
kanyā hastagrahaṃ tatra yā''pnoti patinā saha ..
sā syātputravatī sādhvī sukhasaubhāgyasaṃyutā .. 76 ..
piṃḍadānaṃ narastasyāṃ yaḥ karoti dvijottamāḥ ..
pitarastasya saṃtuṣṭāstarpitāḥ pitṛtīrthavat .. 77 ..
5.180.d:
यस्तस्यां कुरुते मर्त्यः कन्यादानं समाहितः ..
समस्तं फलमाप्नोति राजसूयाश्वमेधयोः .. 79 ..
कन्या हस्तग्रहं तत्र या'ऽप्नोति पतिना सह ..
सा स्यात्पुत्रवती साध्वी सुखसौभाग्यसंयुता .. 76 ..
पिंडदानं नरस्तस्यां यः करोति द्विजोत्तमाः ..
पितरस्तस्य संतुष्टास्तर्पिताः पितृतीर्थवत् .. 77 ..
5.180.m:
Whatever mortal, attentive in mind, gives a maiden [in marriage] at that [tīrtha] / obtains the entire fruit of the Rājasūya and Aśvamedha sacrifices.
The maiden who undergoes the taking of the hand with her husband there / becomes possessed of sons, virtuous, and endowed with happiness and good fortune.
Whatever man offers a piṇḍa there, O best of the twice-born, / his ancestors are gratified and satisfied, as at a pitṛ-tīrtha."

5.180.s: iti śrīskāde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye gāyatrīvivāhe gāyatrītīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikāśītyuttaraśatatamoadhyāyaḥ .. 181 ..
5.180.d: इति श्रीस्कादे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये गायत्रीविवाहे गायत्रीतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकाशीत्युत्तरशततमोअध्यायः .. 181 ..
5.180.m: Thus ends the one hundred eighty-first chapter, named 'Description of the greatness of Gāyatrītīrtha at the marriage of Gāyatrī', in the Great Purāṇa of Skanda, in the compilation of eighty-one thousand [verses], in the sixth Nāgarakhaṇḍa, in the glorification of Hāṭakeśvarakṣetra. // 181

5.181.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
evaṃ patnīṃ samāsādya gāyatrīṃ caturānanaḥ ..
saṃprahṛṣṭamanā bhūtvā prasthito yajñamaṇḍapam .. 1 ..
5.181.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एवं पत्नीं समासाद्य गायत्रीं चतुराननः ..
संप्रहृष्टमना भूत्वा प्रस्थितो यज्ञमण्डपम् .. 1 ..
5.181.m: Sūta said: / Having thus obtained Gāyatrī as his wife, the four-faced one, / his mind filled with joy, set out for the sacrificial pavilion.

5.181.s:
gāyatryapi samādāya mūrdhni tāmaraṇiṃ mudā ..
pratasthe saṃparityajya gopabhāvaṃ vigarhitam .. 2 ..
5.181.d:
गायत्र्यपि समादाय मूर्ध्नि तामरणिं मुदा ..
प्रतस्थे संपरित्यज्य गोपभावं विगर्हितम् .. 2 ..
5.181.m: Gāyatrī too, taking up that fire-drill on her head with joy, / set out, having completely cast off the censured condition of a cowherd woman.

5.181.s:
vādyamāneṣu vādyeṣu brahmaghoṣe divaṃgate ..
kalaṃ pragāyamāneṣu gandharveṣu samaṃtataḥ .. 3 ..
5.181.d:
वाद्यमानेषु वाद्येषु ब्रह्मघोषे दिवंगते ..
कलं प्रगायमानेषु गन्धर्वेषु समंततः .. 3 ..
5.181.m: As musical instruments were played, the sound of the Vedas rose to heaven, / and the gandharvas sang sweetly all around,

5.181.s:
sarvadevadvijopetaḥ saṃprāpto yajñamaṇḍape ..
gāyatryā sahito brahmā mānuṣaṃ bhāvamāśritaḥ .. 4 ..
5.181.d:
सर्वदेवद्विजोपेतः संप्राप्तो यज्ञमण्डपे ..
गायत्र्या सहितो ब्रह्मा मानुषं भावमाश्रितः .. 4 ..
5.181.m: accompanied by all the gods and twice-born, Brahmā arrived at the sacrificial pavilion / together with Gāyatrī, having assumed a human form.

5.181.s:
etasminnaṃtare cakre keśanirvapaṇaṃ vidheḥ ..
viśvakarmā nakhānāṃ ca gāyatryāstadanaṃtaram .. 5 ..
5.181.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे चक्रे केशनिर्वपणं विधेः ..
विश्वकर्मा नखानां च गायत्र्यास्तदनंतरम् .. 5 ..
5.181.m: At that moment, Viśvakarman shaved the hair / of the creator, and then cut the nails of Gāyatrī.

5.181.s:
audumbaraṃ tato daṇḍaṃ pulastyo'smai samādade ..
eṇaśṛṃgānvitaṃ carma mantravadvijasattamāḥ .. 6 ..
5.181.d:
औदुम्बरं ततो दण्डं पुलस्त्योऽस्मै समाददे ..
एणशृंगान्वितं चर्म मन्त्रवद्विजसत्तमाः .. 6 ..
5.181.m: Then Pulastya handed him a staff of udumbara wood, / and a skin with a black-buck horn, with mantras, O best of the twice-born.

5.181.s:
patnīśālāṃ gṛhītvā ca gāyatrīṃ maunadhāriṇīm ..
mekhalāṃ nidadhe cānyāṃ kaṭyāṃ mauṃjīmayīṃ śubhām .. 7 ..
5.181.d:
पत्नीशालां गृहीत्वा च गायत्रीं मौनधारिणीम् ..
मेखलां निदधे चान्यां कट्यां मौंजीमयीं शुभाम् .. 7 ..
5.181.m: And taking Gāyatrī, who kept silence, to the wife's pavilion, / he placed another auspicious girdle of muñja grass around her waist.

5.181.s:
tataścakre paraṃ karma yaduktaṃ yajñamaṃḍape ..
ṛtvigbhiḥ sahito vedhā vedavākyasamādṛtaḥ .. 8 ..
5.181.d:
ततश्चक्रे परं कर्म यदुक्तं यज्ञमंडपे ..
ऋत्विग्भिः सहितो वेधा वेदवाक्यसमादृतः .. 8 ..
5.181.m: Then the creator, together with the priests, attentive to the words of the Vedas, / performed the further rite that is prescribed in the sacrificial pavilion.

5.181.s:
pravargye jāyamāne ca tatrāścaryamabhūnmahat ..
jālmarūpadharaḥ kaściddigvāsā vikṛtānanaḥ .. 9 ..
5.181.d:
प्रवर्ग्ये जायमाने च तत्राश्चर्यमभून्महत् ..
जाल्मरूपधरः कश्चिद्दिग्वासा विकृताननः .. 9 ..
5.181.m: While the Pravargya rite was taking place, a great wonder occurred there: / someone bearing the form of a vile rogue, sky-clad, with a distorted face,

5.181.s:
kapālapāṇirāyāto bhojanaṃ dīyatāmiti ..
niṣedhyamāno'pi ca taiḥ praviṣṭo yājñikaṃ sadaḥ ..
sa kṛtvā'ṭanamanyāyyaṃ tarjyamāno'pi tāpasaiḥ .. 6.182.10 ..
5.181.d:
कपालपाणिरायातो भोजनं दीयतामिति ..
निषेध्यमानोऽपि च तैः प्रविष्टो याज्ञिकं सदः ..
स कृत्वाऽटनमन्याय्यं तर्ज्यमानोऽपि तापसैः .. 6.182.10 ..
5.181.m: carrying a skull-bowl in his hand, arrived, saying: "Let food be given!" / And though forbidden by them, he entered the assembly of the sacrificers, / wandering inappropriately even while being rebuked by the ascetics.

5.181.s:
.. sadasyā ūcuḥ .. ..
kasmātpāpasametastvaṃ praviṣṭo yajñamaṇḍape ..
kapālī nagnarūpo yo yajñakarmavivarjitaḥ .. 11 ..
5.181.d:
.. सदस्या ऊचुः .. ..
कस्मात्पापसमेतस्त्वं प्रविष्टो यज्ञमण्डपे ..
कपाली नग्नरूपो यो यज्ञकर्मविवर्जितः .. 11 ..
5.181.m: The members of the assembly said: / "Why, being filled with sin, have you entered the sacrificial pavilion, / a skull-bearer of naked form who is excluded from sacrificial rites?

5.181.s:
tasmādgaccha drutaṃ mūḍha yāvadbrahmā na kupyati ..
tathā'nye brāhmaṇaśreṣṭhāstathā devāḥ savāsavāḥ .. 12 ..
5.181.d:
तस्माद्गच्छ द्रुतं मूढ यावद्ब्रह्मा न कुप्यति ..
तथाऽन्ये ब्राह्मणश्रेष्ठास्तथा देवाः सवासवाः .. 12 ..
5.181.m: Therefore go quickly, you fool, before Brahmā grows angry, / as well as the other foremost brahmins, and the gods along with Indra!"

5.181.s:
.. jālma uvāca .. ..
brahmayajñamimaṃ śrutvā dūrādatra samāgataḥ ..
bubhukṣito dvijaśreṣṭhāstatkimarthaṃ vigarhatha .. 13 ..
5.181.d:
.. जाल्म उवाच .. ..
ब्रह्मयज्ञमिमं श्रुत्वा दूरादत्र समागतः ..
बुभुक्षितो द्विजश्रेष्ठास्तत्किमर्थं विगर्हथ .. 13 ..
5.181.m: The rogue said: / "Hearing of this sacrifice of Brahmā, I have come here from afar, / hungry, O best of the twice-born; why then do you rebuke me?

5.181.s:
dīnāṃdhaiḥ kṛpaṇaiḥ savairstarpitaiḥ kraturucyate ..
anyathā'sau vināśāya yaduktaṃ brāhmaṇairvacaḥ ..14..
5.181.d:
दीनांधैः कृपणैः सवैर्स्तर्पितैः क्रतुरुच्यते ..
अन्यथाऽसौ विनाशाय यदुक्तं ब्राह्मणैर्वचः ..14..
5.181.m: A sacrifice is said to be complete when all the wretched, blind, and miserable are satiated; / otherwise, it leads to destruction, as stated by the words of brahmins:

5.181.s:
annahīno dahedrāṣṭaṃ mantrahīnastu ṛtvijaḥ ..
yājñikaṃ dakṣiṇā hīno nāsti yajñasamo ripuḥ .. 15 ..
5.181.d:
अन्नहीनो दहेद्राष्टं मन्त्रहीनस्तु ऋत्विजः ..
याज्ञिकं दक्षिणा हीनो नास्ति यज्ञसमो रिपुः .. 15 ..
5.181.m: 'A sacrifice devoid of food burns the realm; devoid of mantras, it burns the priests; / devoid of sacrificial fee, it burns the sacrificer—there is no enemy equal to [such] a sacrifice.'"

5.181.s:
.. brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ .. ..
yadi tvaṃ bhoktukāmastu samāyāto vraja drutam ..
etasyāṃ satraśālāyāṃ bhuñjate yatra tāpasāḥ ..
dīnāndhāḥ kṛpaṇāścaiva tataḥ kṣutkṣāmakaṃṭhitāḥ .. 16 ..
5.181.d:
.. ब्राह्मणा ऊचुः .. ..
यदि त्वं भोक्तुकामस्तु समायातो व्रज द्रुतम् ..
एतस्यां सत्रशालायां भुञ्जते यत्र तापसाः ..
दीनान्धाः कृपणाश्चैव ततः क्षुत्क्षामकंठिताः .. 16 ..
5.181.m: The brahmins said: / "If you have come wishing to eat, go quickly / to this alms-hall where the ascetics eat, / as well as the wretched, blind, and miserable, their throats emaciated with hunger.

5.181.s:
athavā dhanakāmastvaṃ vastrakāmo'tha tāpasa ..
vraja vittapatiryatra dānaśālāṃ samāśritaḥ .. 17 ..
5.181.d:
अथवा धनकामस्त्वं वस्त्रकामोऽथ तापस ..
व्रज वित्तपतिर्यत्र दानशालां समाश्रितः .. 17 ..
5.181.m: Or if you desire wealth, or desire clothing, O ascetic, / go to where the lord of wealth has taken his seat at the hall of gifts.

5.181.s:
aniṃdyo'yaṃ mahāmūrkha yajñaḥ paitāmaho yataḥ ..
arcitaḥ sarvataḥ puṇyaṃ tatkiṃ nindasi durmate .. 18 ..
5.181.d:
अनिंद्योऽयं महामूर्ख यज्ञः पैतामहो यतः ..
अर्चितः सर्वतः पुण्यं तत्किं निन्दसि दुर्मते .. 18 ..
5.181.m: This sacrifice belonging to the grandfather is irreproachable, O great fool; since / it is revered everywhere, it is meritorious; why then do you revile it, you evil-minded one?"

5.181.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
evamuktaḥ kapālaṃ sa parikṣipya dharātale ..
jagāmādarśanaṃ sadyo dīpavaddvijasattamāḥ .. 19 ..
5.181.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एवमुक्तः कपालं स परिक्षिप्य धरातले ..
जगामादर्शनं सद्यो दीपवद्द्विजसत्तमाः .. 19 ..
5.181.m: Sūta said: / Thus addressed, he threw the skull-bowl onto the earth / and instantly disappeared like a lamp, O best of the twice-born.

5.181.s:
.. ṛtvija ūcuḥ .. ..
kathaṃ yajñakriyā kāryā kapāle sadasi sthite ..
parikṣipatha tasmāttu evamūcurdvijottamāḥ .. 6.182.20 ..
5.181.d:
.. ऋत्विज ऊचुः .. ..
कथं यज्ञक्रिया कार्या कपाले सदसि स्थिते ..
परिक्षिपथ तस्मात्तु एवमूचुर्द्विजोत्तमाः .. 6.182.20 ..
5.181.m: The officiating priests said: / "How can the sacrificial rite be performed with a skull-bowl lying in the assembly? / Therefore, throw it away!" Thus spoke the best of the twice-born.

5.181.s:
athaiko bahudhā proktaḥ sadasyaiśca dvijottamaiḥ ..
daṇḍakāṣṭhaṃ samudyamya pracikṣepa bahistathā .. 21 ..
5.181.d:
अथैको बहुधा प्रोक्तः सदस्यैश्च द्विजोत्तमैः ..
दण्डकाष्ठं समुद्यम्य प्रचिक्षेप बहिस्तथा .. 21 ..
5.181.m: Then one [priest], urged repeatedly by the members of the assembly and the best of the twice-born, / lifted a wooden staff and tossed it outside.

5.181.s:
athānyattatra saṃjātaṃ kapālaṃ tādṛśaṃ punaḥ ..
tasminnapi tathā kṣipte bhūyo'nyatsamapadyata .. 22 ..
5.181.d:
अथान्यत्तत्र संजातं कपालं तादृशं पुनः ..
तस्मिन्नपि तथा क्षिप्ते भूयोऽन्यत्समपद्यत .. 22 ..
5.181.m: Then another such skull-bowl appeared there again; / and when that too was thrown away in the same way, yet another arose.

5.181.s:
evaṃ śatasahasrāṇi hyayutānyarbudāni ca ..
tatra jātāni tairvyāpto yajñavāṭaḥ samaṃtataḥ .. 23 ..
5.181.d:
एवं शतसहस्राणि ह्ययुतान्यर्बुदानि च ..
तत्र जातानि तैर्व्याप्तो यज्ञवाटः समंततः .. 23 ..
5.181.m: In this way, hundreds of thousands, tens of thousands, and hundreds of millions / were produced there, and the sacrificial enclosure was filled with them all around.

5.181.s:
hāhākārastatau jajñe samaste yajñamaṇḍape ..
dṛṣṭvā kapālasaṃghāṃstānyajña karmapradūṣakān.. 24 ..
5.181.d:
हाहाकारस्ततौ जज्ञे समस्ते यज्ञमण्डपे ..
दृष्ट्वा कपालसंघांस्तान्यज्ञ कर्मप्रदूषकान्.. 24 ..
5.181.m: Then an outcry of woe arose throughout the entire sacrificial pavilion, / seeing those multitudes of skull-bowls polluting the sacrificial rite.

5.181.s:
atha saṃciṃtayāmāsa dhyānaṃ kṛtvā pitāmahaḥ ..
harāriṣṭaṃ samājñāya tatsarvaṃ hṛṣṭarūpadhṛk .. 25 ..
5.181.d:
अथ संचिंतयामास ध्यानं कृत्वा पितामहः ..
हरारिष्टं समाज्ञाय तत्सर्वं हृष्टरूपधृक् .. 25 ..
5.181.m: Then the grandfather reflected, having entered meditation; / knowing all that to be the misfortune caused by Hara, assuming a joyful form,

5.181.s:
kṛtāṃjalipuṭo bhūtvā tataḥ provāca sādaram..
maheśvaraṃ samāsādya yajñavāṭasamāśritam.. 26 ..
5.181.d:
कृतांजलिपुटो भूत्वा ततः प्रोवाच सादरम्..
महेश्वरं समासाद्य यज्ञवाटसमाश्रितम्.. 26 ..
5.181.m: having joined his hands in reverence, he then spoke respectfully, / approaching Maheśvara who had taken his station in the sacrificial enclosure:

5.181.s:
kimidaṃ yujyate deva yajñe'sminkarmaṇaḥ kṣatiḥ ..
tasmātsaṃhara sarvāṇi kapālāni sureśvara .. 27 ..
5.181.d:
किमिदं युज्यते देव यज्ञेऽस्मिन्कर्मणः क्षतिः ..
तस्मात्संहर सर्वाणि कपालानि सुरेश्वर .. 27 ..
5.181.m: "Is this proper, O god, that the rite be ruined in this sacrifice? / Therefore, withdraw all the skull-bowls, O lord of the gods!"

5.181.s: yajñakarmavilopo'yaṃ mā bhūttvayi samāgate .. 28 ..
5.181.d: यज्ञकर्मविलोपोऽयं मा भूत्त्वयि समागते .. 28 ..
5.181.m: Let there be no destruction of the sacrificial rite now that you have arrived.”

5.181.s:
tataḥ provāca saṃkruddho bhagavāñchaśiśekharaḥ ..
tanmameṣṭatamaṃ pātraṃ bhojanāya sadā sthitam.. 29 ..
5.181.d:
ततः प्रोवाच संक्रुद्धो भगवाञ्छशिशेखरः ..
तन्ममेष्टतमं पात्रं भोजनाय सदा स्थितम्.. 29 ..
5.181.m: Then the blessed lord who bears the crescent moon on his crest, filled with wrath, said: / “That [skull] is my most beloved bowl, ever used for my food.

5.181.s:
ete dvijādhamāḥ kasmādvidviṣaṃtipitāmaha ..
tathā na māṃ samuddiśya juhuvurjātavedasi .. 6.182.30 ..
5.181.d:
एते द्विजाधमाः कस्माद्विद्विषंतिपितामह ..
तथा न मां समुद्दिश्य जुहुवुर्जातवेदसि .. 6.182.30 ..
5.181.m: Why do these lowest of the twice-born despise it, O grandfather? / Likewise, they have offered no oblation into the fire addressed to me,

5.181.s:
yathānyādevatā stadvanmantrapūtaṃ havirvidhe ..
tasmādyadi vidhe kāryā samāptiryajñakarmaṇi .. 31 ..
5.181.d:
यथान्यादेवता स्तद्वन्मन्त्रपूतं हविर्विधे ..
तस्माद्यदि विधे कार्या समाप्तिर्यज्ञकर्मणि .. 31 ..
5.181.m: as they do for other deities with sacrificial food purified by mantras, O Brahmā. / Therefore, O Brahmā, if the sacrificial rite is to be completed,

5.181.s:
tatkapālāśritaṃ havyaṃ kartavyaṃ sakalaṃ tvidam ..
tathā ca māṃ samu ddiśya viśaṣājjātavedasi .. 32 ..
5.181.d:
तत्कपालाश्रितं हव्यं कर्तव्यं सकलं त्विदम् ..
तथा च मां समु द्दिश्य विशषाज्जातवेदसि .. 32 ..
5.181.m: then all this sacrificial food must be placed within skulls; / and an oblation addressed especially to me must be poured into the fire.

5.181.s:
hotavyaṃ havirevātra samāptiṃ yāsyati kratuḥ ..
nānyathā satyamevoktaṃ tavāgre caturānana .. 33 ..
5.181.d:
होतव्यं हविरेवात्र समाप्तिं यास्यति क्रतुः ..
नान्यथा सत्यमेवोक्तं तवाग्रे चतुरानन .. 33 ..
5.181.m: Only when the oblation is offered here will the sacrifice reach completion; / not otherwise. Truly have I spoken before you, O four-faced one.”

5.181.s:
.. pitāmaha uvāca .. ..
rūpāṇi tava deveśa pṛthagbhūtānyanekaśaḥ ..
saṃkhyayā parihīnāni dhyeyāni sakalāni ca .. 34 ..
5.181.d:
.. पितामह उवाच .. ..
रूपाणि तव देवेश पृथग्भूतान्यनेकशः ..
संख्यया परिहीनानि ध्येयानि सकलानि च .. 34 ..
5.181.m: The grandfather said: / “O lord of the gods, your forms are manifold and diverse; / they are beyond number, and all are worthy of meditation.

5.181.s:
etanmahāvrataṃ rūpamākhyātaṃ te trilocana ..
naivaṃ ca makhakarma syāttatraiva ca na yujyate .. 35 ..
5.181.d:
एतन्महाव्रतं रूपमाख्यातं ते त्रिलोचन ..
नैवं च मखकर्म स्यात्तत्रैव च न युज्यते .. 35 ..
5.181.m: This form of yours, O three-eyed one, is proclaimed to belong to the Mahāvrata observance; / the ritual of a sacrifice cannot be like this, nor is it fitting there.

5.181.s:
adyaitatkarma kartuṃ ca śrutibāhyaṃ kathaṃcana ..
tava vākyamapi tryakṣa nānyathā kartumutsahe .. 36 ..
5.181.d:
अद्यैतत्कर्म कर्तुं च श्रुतिबाह्यं कथंचन ..
तव वाक्यमपि त्र्यक्ष नान्यथा कर्तुमुत्सहे .. 36 ..
5.181.m: To perform today a rite that is in any way outside the Veda [is unfitting], / yet I also dare not disobey your command, O three-eyed one.

5.181.s:
mṛnmayeṣu kapāleṣu haviḥ śrāpyaṃ sureśvara ..
adyaprabhṛti yajñeṣu puroḍāśātmikaṃ dvijaiḥ ..
tavoddeśena deveśa hotavyaṃ śatarudriyam .. 37 ..
5.181.d:
मृन्मयेषु कपालेषु हविः श्राप्यं सुरेश्वर ..
अद्यप्रभृति यज्ञेषु पुरोडाशात्मिकं द्विजैः ..
तवोद्देशेन देवेश होतव्यं शतरुद्रियम् .. 37 ..
5.181.m: The oblation consisting of sacrificial cake should be cooked by the twice-born in earthen pans, O lord of the gods, / in sacrifices from this day forward; / and, O lord of the gods, the Śatarudrīya hymn should be offered as an oblation addressed to you,

5.181.s:
viśeṣātsarvayajñeṣu japyaṃ caiva viśeṣataḥ ..
kapālānāṃ tu dvāreṇa tvayā rūpaṃ nijaṃ kṛtam .. 38 ..
5.181.d:
विशेषात्सर्वयज्ञेषु जप्यं चैव विशेषतः ..
कपालानां तु द्वारेण त्वया रूपं निजं कृतम् .. 38 ..
5.181.m: and recited especially in all sacrifices. / Since you manifested your own form

5.181.s:
prakaṭaṃ ca suraśreṣṭha kapāleśvarasaṃjñitaḥ ..
tasmāttvaṃ bhavitā rudra kṣetre'smindvādaśo'paraḥ .. 39 ..
5.181.d:
प्रकटं च सुरश्रेष्ठ कपालेश्वरसंज्ञितः ..
तस्मात्त्वं भविता रुद्र क्षेत्रेऽस्मिन्द्वादशोऽपरः .. 39 ..
5.181.m: by means of the skulls, O best of the gods, / you will therefore be named Kapāleśvara, the twelfth other Rudra in this sacred field.

5.181.s:
atra yajñaṃ samārabhya yastvāṃ prākpūjayiṣyati ..
avighnena makhastasya samāptiṃ pravrajiṣyati .. 6.182.40 ..
5.181.d:
अत्र यज्ञं समारभ्य यस्त्वां प्राक्पूजयिष्यति ..
अविघ्नेन मखस्तस्य समाप्तिं प्रव्रजिष्यति .. 6.182.40 ..
5.181.m: Whoever commences a sacrifice here and worships you first, / his sacrifice will reach its completion without obstacles.”

5.181.s:
evamukte tatastena kapālāni dvijottamāḥ ..
tāni sarvāṇi naṣṭāni saṃkhyayā rahitāni ca .. 41 ..
5.181.d:
एवमुक्ते ततस्तेन कपालानि द्विजोत्तमाः ..
तानि सर्वाणि नष्टानि संख्यया रहितानि च .. 41 ..
5.181.m: When he had spoken thus, O best of the twice-born, / all those skulls, beyond number, vanished.

5.181.s:
tato hṛṣṭaścaturvaktraḥ sthāpayāmāsa tatkṣaṇāt ..
ligaṃ māheśvaraṃ tatra kapāleśvarasaṃjñitam .. 42 ..
5.181.d:
ततो हृष्टश्चतुर्वक्त्रः स्थापयामास तत्क्षणात् ..
लिगं माहेश्वरं तत्र कपालेश्वरसंज्ञितम् .. 42 ..
5.181.m: Then, delighted, the four-faced one at that very moment consecrated / a liṅga of Maheśvara there named Kapāleśvara.

5.181.s:
abravīcca tato vākyaṃ yaścaitatpūjayiṣyati ..
mama kuṇḍatraye snātvā sa yāsyati parāṃ gatim.. 43 ..
5.181.d:
अब्रवीच्च ततो वाक्यं यश्चैतत्पूजयिष्यति ..
मम कुण्डत्रये स्नात्वा स यास्यति परां गतिम्.. 43 ..
5.181.m: And he uttered these words: “Whoever bathes in my three basins / and worships this [liṅga] shall attain the supreme state.

5.181.s:
śuklapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ kārtike jāgaraṃ tu yaḥ ..
kariṣyati punaścāsya liṃgasya susamāhitaḥ ..
ājanmaprabhavātpāpātsa vimuktimavāpsyati .. 44 ..
5.181.d:
शुक्लपक्षे चतुर्दश्यां कार्तिके जागरं तु यः ..
करिष्यति पुनश्चास्य लिंगस्य सुसमाहितः ..
आजन्मप्रभवात्पापात्स विमुक्तिमवाप्स्यति .. 44 ..
5.181.m: And whoever, with a concentrated mind, / keeps vigil for this liṅga on the fourteenth day of the bright fortnight of Kārtika, / will be liberated from the sin born from his birth.”

5.181.s:
evamukte'tha vidhinā prahṛṣṭastripurāṃtakaḥ ..
yajñamaṇḍapamāsādya prasthito vedisaṃnidhau .. 45 ..
5.181.d:
एवमुक्तेऽथ विधिना प्रहृष्टस्त्रिपुरांतकः ..
यज्ञमण्डपमासाद्य प्रस्थितो वेदिसंनिधौ .. 45 ..
5.181.m: When Brahmā had spoken thus, the destroyer of Tripura was overjoyed; / having reached the sacrificial pavilion, he stood beside the altar.

5.181.s:
brāhmaṇaiśca tataḥ karma prārabdhaṃ yajñasambhavam ..
vismayotphullanayanairnamaskṛtya maheśvaram .. 46 ..
5.181.d:
ब्राह्मणैश्च ततः कर्म प्रारब्धं यज्ञसम्भवम् ..
विस्मयोत्फुल्लनयनैर्नमस्कृत्य महेश्वरम् .. 46 ..
5.181.m: Then, their eyes wide with wonder, the brahmins bowed to Maheśvara / and commenced the rite of the sacrifice.

5.181.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
evaṃ ca yaja tastasya caturvaktrasya tatra ca ..
ṛṣīṇāṃ koṭirāyātā dakṣiṇāpathavāsinām .. 47 ..
5.181.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एवं च यज तस्तस्य चतुर्वक्त्रस्य तत्र च ..
ऋषीणां कोटिरायाता दक्षिणापथवासिनाम् .. 47 ..
5.181.m: Sūta said: / While the four-faced one was thus sacrificing there, / ten million seers residing in the Deccan arrived,

5.181.s:
śrutvā paitāmahaṃ yajñaṃ kautukena samanvitāḥ ..
kīdṛśo bhavitā yajño dīkṣito yatra padmajaḥ .. 488 ..
kīdṛkkṣetraṃ ca tatpuṇyaṃ hāṭakeśvarasaṃjñitam ..
kīdṛśāste ca viprendrā ṛtvijastatra ye sthitāḥ .. 49 ..
atha te supariśrāṃtā madhyaṃdinagate ravau ..
ravivāreṇa saṃprāpte nakṣatre cāśvisaṃsthite .. 6.182.50 ..
vaivasvatyāṃ tithau caiva prāptā gharmapīḍitāḥ ..
kaṃcijjalāśayaṃ prāpya praviṣṭāḥ salilaṃ śubham .. 51 ..
śaṃkukarṇā mahākarṇā vakanāsāstathāpare ..
mahodarā bṛhaddantā dīrghoṣṭhāḥ sthūlamastakāḥ..52..
cipiṭākṣāstathā cānye dīrghagrīvāstathā pare..
kṛṣṇāṃgāḥ sphuṭitaiḥ pādairnakhairdīrghaiḥ samutthitaiḥ..53..
tato yāvadviniṣkrāṃtāḥ prapaśyanti parasparam..
tāvadvairūpasyanirmuktāḥ saṃjātāḥ kāmasannibhāḥ..54..
5.181.d:
श्रुत्वा पैतामहं यज्ञं कौतुकेन समन्विताः ..
कीदृशो भविता यज्ञो दीक्षितो यत्र पद्मजः .. 488 ..
कीदृक्क्षेत्रं च तत्पुण्यं हाटकेश्वरसंज्ञितम् ..
कीदृशास्ते च विप्रेन्द्रा ऋत्विजस्तत्र ये स्थिताः .. 49 ..
अथ ते सुपरिश्रांता मध्यंदिनगते रवौ ..
रविवारेण संप्राप्ते नक्षत्रे चाश्विसंस्थिते .. 6.182.50 ..
वैवस्वत्यां तिथौ चैव प्राप्ता घर्मपीडिताः ..
कंचिज्जलाशयं प्राप्य प्रविष्टाः सलिलं शुभम् .. 51 ..
शंकुकर्णा महाकर्णा वकनासास्तथापरे ..
महोदरा बृहद्दन्ता दीर्घोष्ठाः स्थूलमस्तकाः..52..
चिपिटाक्षास्तथा चान्ये दीर्घग्रीवास्तथा परे..
कृष्णांगाः स्फुटितैः पादैर्नखैर्दीर्घैः समुत्थितैः..53..
ततो यावद्विनिष्क्रांताः प्रपश्यन्ति परस्परम्..
तावद्वैरूपस्यनिर्मुक्ताः संजाताः कामसन्निभाः..54..
5.181.m:
filled with curiosity upon hearing of the grandfather’s sacrifice: / “What kind of sacrifice will this be, wherein the lotus-born one himself is consecrated?
And what is that holy sacred field called Hāṭakeśvara like? / And what are those eminent twice-born officiating priests residing there like?”
Then, utterly exhausted as the sun reached midday / on a Sunday, when the asterism of the Aśvins was present,
and on the Yamī lunar day, afflicted by the heat, / they reached a pool of water and entered the auspicious water.
Some had ears like pegs, some huge ears, others crane-like noses; / some had pot-bellies, large teeth, long lips, or swollen heads;
others had flat eyes, others long necks, / with dark limbs, cracked feet, and long, protruding nails.
Then, as soon as they emerged, they looked at one another; / they were freed from deformity and had become beautiful as the god of love.

5.181.s:
tato vismayamāpannā mithaḥ procuḥ praharṣitāḥ..
rūpavyatyayamālokya jñātvā tīrthaṃ taduttamam..
atra snānādidaṃ rūpamasmābhiḥ prāptamuttamam..55..
yasmāttasmādidaṃ tīrthaṃ rūpatīrthaṃ bhaviṣyati..
trailokye sakale khyātaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam..56..
ye'tra snānaṃ kariṣyanti śraddhayā parayā yutāḥ..
surūpāste bhaviṣyaṃti sadā janmani janmani..57..
pitṝṃśca tarpayiṣyanti ya tra śraddhāsamanvitāḥ..
jalenāpi gayāśrāddhātte lapsyante dhikaṃ phalam..58..
ye'tra ratnapradānaṃ ca prakariṣyanti mānavāḥ..
bhaviṣyaṃti na saṃdeho rājānaste bhavebhave..59..
sthāsyāmo vayamatraiva sāṃprataṃ kṛtaniścayāḥ..
na yāsyāmo vayaṃ tīrthaṃ yadyapi syātsuśobhanam..6.182.60..
evamuktvā'tha vyabhajaṃstatsarvaṃ munayaśca te..
yajñopavītamātrāṇi svāni tīrthāni cakrire..61..
5.181.d:
ततो विस्मयमापन्ना मिथः प्रोचुः प्रहर्षिताः..
रूपव्यत्ययमालोक्य ज्ञात्वा तीर्थं तदुत्तमम्..
अत्र स्नानादिदं रूपमस्माभिः प्राप्तमुत्तमम्..55..
यस्मात्तस्मादिदं तीर्थं रूपतीर्थं भविष्यति..
त्रैलोक्ये सकले ख्यातं सर्वपातकनाशनम्..56..
येऽत्र स्नानं करिष्यन्ति श्रद्धया परया युताः..
सुरूपास्ते भविष्यंति सदा जन्मनि जन्मनि..57..
पितॄंश्च तर्पयिष्यन्ति य त्र श्रद्धासमन्विताः..
जलेनापि गयाश्राद्धात्ते लप्स्यन्ते धिकं फलम्..58..
येऽत्र रत्नप्रदानं च प्रकरिष्यन्ति मानवाः..
भविष्यंति न संदेहो राजानस्ते भवेभवे..59..
स्थास्यामो वयमत्रैव सांप्रतं कृतनिश्चयाः..
न यास्यामो वयं तीर्थं यद्यपि स्यात्सुशोभनम्..6.182.60..
एवमुक्त्वाऽथ व्यभजंस्तत्सर्वं मुनयश्च ते..
यज्ञोपवीतमात्राणि स्वानि तीर्थानि चक्रिरे..61..
5.181.m:
Then, filled with wonder and overjoyed, seeing the transformation of their appearance / and recognizing that excellent sacred ford, they said to one another: / “By bathing here, this excellent form has been obtained by us.
Therefore, this sacred ford shall be called Rūpatīrtha, / renowned in all the three worlds, destroying all sins.
Those who bathe here endowed with supreme faith / will always be beautiful, birth after birth.
And those who, endowed with faith, satisfy their ancestors here / even with water, will obtain a fruit greater than a śrāddha at Gayā.
Those people who give gifts of gems here / will, without doubt, become kings in every rebirth.
We shall stay right here now, having made our resolve; / we will not go to another sacred ford, even if it were most splendid.”
Having spoken thus, those sages partitioned all of it; / they made their own sacred fords each the measure of a sacred thread.

5.181.s:
sūta uvāca..
adyāpi ca dvijaśreṣṭhāstatra tīrthe jagadguruḥ..
prathamaṃ spṛśate toyaṃ nityaṃ syāddayitaṃ śubham..62..
niṣkāmastu punarmartyo yaḥ snānaṃ tatra śraddhayā..
kurute sa paraṃ śreyaḥ prāpnuyātsiddhilakṣaṇam..63..
evaṃ te munayaḥ sarve vibhajya tanmahatsaraḥ..
sāyaṃtanaṃ ca tatraiva kṛtvā karma suvistaram..64...
tato niśāmukhe prāptā yatra devaḥ pitāmahaḥ..
dīkṣitastvatha maunī ca yajñamaṇḍapasaṃśritaḥ..65..
taṃ praṇamya tataḥ sarve gatā yatrartvijaḥ sthitāḥ..
upaviṣṭāḥ pariśrāntā divā yajñiyakarmaṇā..66..
indrādikaiḥ surairbhaktyā mṛdyamānāṅghrayaḥ sthitāḥ..
abhivādyātha tānsarvānupaviṣṭāstato grataḥ..67..
cakruścātha kathāścitrā yajñakarmasamudbhavāḥ..
somapānasya saṃbandho vyatyayaṃ ca samudbhavam..68..
5.181.d:
सूत उवाच..
अद्यापि च द्विजश्रेष्ठास्तत्र तीर्थे जगद्गुरुः..
प्रथमं स्पृशते तोयं नित्यं स्याद्दयितं शुभम्..62..
निष्कामस्तु पुनर्मर्त्यो यः स्नानं तत्र श्रद्धया..
कुरुते स परं श्रेयः प्राप्नुयात्सिद्धिलक्षणम्..63..
एवं ते मुनयः सर्वे विभज्य तन्महत्सरः..
सायंतनं च तत्रैव कृत्वा कर्म सुविस्तरम्..64...
ततो निशामुखे प्राप्ता यत्र देवः पितामहः..
दीक्षितस्त्वथ मौनी च यज्ञमण्डपसंश्रितः..65..
तं प्रणम्य ततः सर्वे गता यत्रर्त्विजः स्थिताः..
उपविष्टाः परिश्रान्ता दिवा यज्ञियकर्मणा..66..
इन्द्रादिकैः सुरैर्भक्त्या मृद्यमानाङ्घ्रयः स्थिताः..
अभिवाद्याथ तान्सर्वानुपविष्टास्ततो ग्रतः..67..
चक्रुश्चाथ कथाश्चित्रा यज्ञकर्मसमुद्भवाः..
सोमपानस्य संबन्धो व्यत्ययं च समुद्भवम्..68..
5.181.m:
Sūta said: / Even today, O best of the twice-born, the teacher of the world / first touches the water in that sacred ford; it is ever his dear, auspicious [water].
And a mortal free from desire who bathes there with faith / attains the supreme good marked by spiritual perfection.
Having thus partitioned that great lake, all those sages / performed their elaborate evening rite right there, / and then, at the beginning of night, arrived where the divine grandfather was, / consecrated, observing silence, and seated in the sacrificial pavilion.
Having bowed to him, they all went where the officiating priests were staying, / who were seated, fatigued by the sacrificial duties of the day,
their feet being massaged with devotion by the gods led by Indra. / Having greeted them all, they sat down before them,
and held various discussions arising from the rites of the sacrifice: / the connection with the drinking of Soma, its variation and origin,

5.181.s:
udgātuḥ prabhavaṃ caiva tathādhvaryoḥ parasparam..
procuste tattvamāśritya tathānye dūṣayanti tat..69..
anye mīmāṃsakāstatra kopasaṃraktalocanāḥ..
hanyusteṣāṃ mataṃ vādamāśritā vāgvicakṣaṇāḥ.. 6.182.70..
pariśiṣṭavidaścānye madhyasthā dvijasattamāḥ..
procurvādaṃ parityajya sābhiprāyaṃ yathoditam..71..
mahāvīrapuroḍāśacayanapramukhāṃstathā..
vivādāṃścakrire cānye svaṃsvaṃ pakṣaṃ samāśritāḥ..72..
evaṃ sā rajanī teṣāmatikrāntā dvijanmanām.73..
iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye rūpatīrthotpattipūrvakaprathamayajñadivasavṛttāntavarṇanaṃnāma dvyaśītyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ..182..
5.181.d:
उद्गातुः प्रभवं चैव तथाध्वर्योः परस्परम्..
प्रोचुस्ते तत्त्वमाश्रित्य तथान्ये दूषयन्ति तत्..69..
अन्ये मीमांसकास्तत्र कोपसंरक्तलोचनाः..
हन्युस्तेषां मतं वादमाश्रिता वाग्विचक्षणाः.. 6.182.70..
परिशिष्टविदश्चान्ये मध्यस्था द्विजसत्तमाः..
प्रोचुर्वादं परित्यज्य साभिप्रायं यथोदितम्..71..
महावीरपुरोडाशचयनप्रमुखांस्तथा..
विवादांश्चक्रिरे चान्ये स्वंस्वं पक्षं समाश्रिताः..72..
एवं सा रजनी तेषामतिक्रान्ता द्विजन्मनाम्.73..
इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये रूपतीर्थोत्पत्तिपूर्वकप्रथमयज्ञदिवसवृत्तान्तवर्णनंनाम द्व्यशीत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः..182..
5.181.m:
and the mutual functions of the Udgātṛ and the Adhvaryu priests; / relying on truth, some stated them, while others refuted them.
Other Mīmāṃsakas there, their eyes red with anger, / eloquent in speech, refuted their doctrines by resorting to debate.
And other best of twice-born, knowers of the supplementary texts and impartial, / abandoning dispute, spoke with intended meaning as prescribed. (71)
Others engaged in debates regarding the Mahāvīra, the sacrificial cake, the piling [of the altar], and the like, / each resorting to their own position. (72)
In this way that night passed for those twice-born. (73)
Thus ends the hundred and eighty-second chapter, titled “Description of the Events of the First Sacrificial Day Preceded by the Origin of Rūpatīrtha,” in the Māhātmya of the Sacred Field of Hāṭakeśvara, in the sixth [section], the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, in the Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses, the glorious Skandapurāṇa. (182)

5.182.s:
sūta uvāca..
dvitīye divase prāpte yajñakarmasamudbhave..
dvādaśyāmabhavattatra śṛṇudhvaṃ taddvijottamāḥ..
vṛttāntaṃ sarvadevānāṃ mahāvismayakārakam .. 1 ..
5.182.d:
सूत उवाच..
द्वितीये दिवसे प्राप्ते यज्ञकर्मसमुद्भवे..
द्वादश्यामभवत्तत्र शृणुध्वं तद्द्विजोत्तमाः..
वृत्तान्तं सर्वदेवानां महाविस्मयकारकम् .. 1 ..
5.182.m: Sūta said: / When the second day arrived for the performance of the sacrificial rites, / on the twelfth day, O best of twice-born, there occurred / an event that caused great wonder to all the gods; listen to it: (1)

5.182.s:
makhakarmaṇi prārabdha ṛtvigbhirvedapāragaiḥ ..
jalasarpaṃ samādāya baṭuḥ kaścitsunarmakṛt .. 2 ..
5.182.d:
मखकर्मणि प्रारब्ध ऋत्विग्भिर्वेदपारगैः ..
जलसर्पं समादाय बटुः कश्चित्सुनर्मकृत् .. 2 ..
5.182.m: When the sacrificial rite had commenced by the officiating priests who were well-versed in the Vedas, / a certain youth who was very mischievous, taking a water-snake, (2)

5.182.s:
praviśyātha sadastatra taṃ sarpaṃ brāhmaṇāntike ..
cikṣepa prahasaṃścaiva sarvaduḥkhabhayaṃkaram .. 3 ..
5.182.d:
प्रविश्याथ सदस्तत्र तं सर्पं ब्राह्मणान्तिके ..
चिक्षेप प्रहसंश्चैव सर्वदुःखभयंकरम् .. 3 ..
5.182.m: entered the assembly hall and, laughing aloud, threw that snake / near a brahmin—a cause of distress and fright to all. (3)

5.182.s:
tatastu ḍuṇḍubhastūrṇaṃ bhramamāṇa itastataḥ ..
viprāṇāṃ sadasisthānāṃ saktānāṃ yajñakarmaṇi .. 4 ..
5.182.d:
ततस्तु डुण्डुभस्तूर्णं भ्रममाण इतस्ततः ..
विप्राणां सदसिस्थानां सक्तानां यज्ञकर्मणि .. 4 ..
5.182.m: Then that water-snake, wandering swiftly here and there / among the brahmins sitting in the assembly engaged in the sacrificial rite, (4)

5.182.s:
aho hotuḥ sthite praiṣe dīrghasatrasamudbhave ..
sa sarpo veṣṭayāmāsa tasya gātraṃ samaṃtataḥ .. 5 ..
5.182.d:
अहो होतुः स्थिते प्रैषे दीर्घसत्रसमुद्भवे ..
स सर्पो वेष्टयामास तस्य गात्रं समंततः .. 5 ..
5.182.m: while the invocation of the Hotṛ was proceeding in that long sacrificial session, / that snake coiled all around his body. (5)

5.182.s:
na cacāla nijasthānātprāyaścittavibhīṣayā ..
novāca vacanaṃ so'tra cayananyastalocanaḥ .. 6 ..
5.182.d:
न चचाल निजस्थानात्प्रायश्चित्तविभीषया ..
नोवाच वचनं सोऽत्र चयनन्यस्तलोचनः .. 6 ..
5.182.m: For fear of [incurring an expiatory] penance, he did not stir from his place; / with his gaze fixed on the altar-piling, he uttered not a word. (6)

5.182.s:
hāhākāro mahāñjajñe etasminnaṃtare dvijāḥ ..
tasminsadasi viprāṇāṃ viṣā ḍhyāhipraśaṃkayā .. 7 ..
5.182.d:
हाहाकारो महाञ्जज्ञे एतस्मिन्नंतरे द्विजाः ..
तस्मिन्सदसि विप्राणां विषा ढ्याहिप्रशंकया .. 7 ..
5.182.m: In the meantime, O twice-born, a great cry of dismay arose / in that assembly of brahmins, out of fear that the snake was venomous. (7)

5.182.s:
hāhākāro mahānāsīttaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarpaveṣṭitam ..
tasya putro vinītātmā maitrāvaruṇakarmaṇi .. 9 ..
saṃsthitastena saṃdṛṣṭaḥ pitā sarpābhiveṣṭitaḥ ..
jñātvā tu ceṣṭitaṃ tasya bhaye sarpasamudbhave ..
śaśāpa krodhasaṃyuktastatastaṃ sa baṭuṃ muniḥ .. 9 ..
5.182.d:
हाहाकारो महानासीत्तं दृष्ट्वा सर्पवेष्टितम् ..
तस्य पुत्रो विनीतात्मा मैत्रावरुणकर्मणि .. 9 ..
संस्थितस्तेन संदृष्टः पिता सर्पाभिवेष्टितः ..
ज्ञात्वा तु चेष्टितं तस्य भये सर्पसमुद्भवे ..
शशाप क्रोधसंयुक्तस्ततस्तं स बटुं मुनिः .. 9 ..
5.182.m:
A great cry of dismay arose upon seeing him coiled around by the snake. / His humble son, engaged in the duties of the Maitrāvaruṇa priest, (8)
standing there, saw his father surrounded by the serpent. / Knowing that [boy’s] act when fear arose from the snake, / that sage, filled with rage, cursed that youth: (9)

5.182.s:
yasmātpāpa tvayā sarpaḥ kṣiptaḥ sadasi durmate ..
tasmādbhava drutaṃ sarpo mama vākyādasaṃśayam .. 6.183.10 ..
5.182.d:
यस्मात्पाप त्वया सर्पः क्षिप्तः सदसि दुर्मते ..
तस्माद्भव द्रुतं सर्पो मम वाक्यादसंशयम् .. 6.183.10 ..
5.182.m: “Since a snake was thrown by you, evil one, into the assembly, O wicked-minded one, / therefore, by my word, quickly become a snake without a doubt!” (10)

5.182.s:
.. baṭuruvāca .. ..
hāsyena jalasarpo'yaṃ mayā mukto'tra līlayā ..
na te tātaṃ samuddiśya tatkiṃ māṃ śapasi dvija .. 11 ..
5.182.d:
.. बटुरुवाच .. ..
हास्येन जलसर्पोऽयं मया मुक्तोऽत्र लीलया ..
न ते तातं समुद्दिश्य तत्किं मां शपसि द्विज .. 11 ..
5.182.m: The youth said: / “In jest and in play this water-snake was released by me here; / it was not aimed at your father. Why then do you curse me, O twice-born?” (11)

5.182.s:
etasminnaṃtare muktvā tasya gātraṃ sa pannagaḥ ..
jagāmānyatra tasyāpi sarpatvaṃ samapadyata .. 12 ..
5.182.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे मुक्त्वा तस्य गात्रं स पन्नगः ..
जगामान्यत्र तस्यापि सर्पत्वं समपद्यत .. 12 ..
5.182.m: At that moment, releasing his body, that serpent / went elsewhere, and the boy too was transformed into a snake. (12)

5.182.s:
so'pi sarpatvamāpannaḥ sanātanasuto baṭuḥ ..
duḥkhaśokasamāpanno brāhmaṇaiḥ pariveṣṭitaḥ .. 13 ..
5.182.d:
सोऽपि सर्पत्वमापन्नः सनातनसुतो बटुः ..
दुःखशोकसमापन्नो ब्राह्मणैः परिवेष्टितः .. 13 ..
5.182.m: Having become a snake, that youth, the son of Sanātana, / overcome with grief and sorrow, was surrounded by brahmins. (13)

5.182.s:
atha gatvā bhṛguṃ so'pi bāṣpavyākulalocanaḥ ..
provāca gadgadaṃ vākyaṃ praṇipatya puraḥsaraḥ .. 14 ..
5.182.d:
अथ गत्वा भृगुं सोऽपि बाष्पव्याकुललोचनः ..
प्रोवाच गद्गदं वाक्यं प्रणिपत्य पुरःसरः .. 14 ..
5.182.m: Then, having gone to Bhṛgu, his eyes clouded with tears, / he bowed before him and spoke in a faltering voice: (14)

5.182.s:
sanātanasutaścāsmi pautrastu parameṣṭhinaḥ ..
śaptastava sutenāsmi cyavanena mahātmanā .. 15 ..
5.182.d:
सनातनसुतश्चास्मि पौत्रस्तु परमेष्ठिनः ..
शप्तस्तव सुतेनास्मि च्यवनेन महात्मना .. 15 ..
5.182.m: “I am the son of Sanātana and grandson of the Supreme Lord [Brahmā]. / I have been cursed by your son, the noble Cyavana. (15)

5.182.s:
nirdoṣo brāhmaṇaśreṣṭha tasmācchāpātprarakṣa mām ..
tacchrutvā cyavanaṃ prāha kṛpāviṣṭo bhṛguḥ svayam ..16..
5.182.d:
निर्दोषो ब्राह्मणश्रेष्ठ तस्माच्छापात्प्ररक्ष माम् ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा च्यवनं प्राह कृपाविष्टो भृगुः स्वयम् ..16..
5.182.m: I am innocent, O best of brahmins! Therefore protect me from the curse.” / Hearing that, Bhṛgu himself, overcome with compassion, said to Cyavana: (16)

5.182.s:
ayuktaṃ vihitaṃ tāta yacchapto'yaṃ baṭustvayā..
na māṃ dharṣayituṃ śakto viṣāḍhyo'pi bhujaṃgamaḥ ..17..
5.182.d:
अयुक्तं विहितं तात यच्छप्तोऽयं बटुस्त्वया..
न मां धर्षयितुं शक्तो विषाढ्योऽपि भुजंगमः ..17..
5.182.m: “An improper thing was done, my son, when this youth was cursed by you. / Even a serpent full of poison is not able to overpower me. (17)

5.182.s:
kiṃ punarjalasarpo'yaṃ nirviṣo rajjusaṃnibhaḥ ..
na māmuddiśya nirmuktaḥ sarpo'nena dvijanmanā ..
śāpamokṣaṃ kuruṣvāsya tasmācchīghraṃ dvijanmanaḥ .. 19 ..
.. cyavana uvāca .. ..
yadi tyajati maryādāmabdhiḥ śaityaṃ vrajedraviḥ ..
uṣṇatvaṃ ca kṣapānāthastanme syādanṛtaṃ vacaḥ .. 19 ..
5.182.d:
किं पुनर्जलसर्पोऽयं निर्विषो रज्जुसंनिभः ..
न मामुद्दिश्य निर्मुक्तः सर्पोऽनेन द्विजन्मना ..
शापमोक्षं कुरुष्वास्य तस्माच्छीघ्रं द्विजन्मनः .. 19 ..
.. च्यवन उवाच .. ..
यदि त्यजति मर्यादामब्धिः शैत्यं व्रजेद्रविः ..
उष्णत्वं च क्षपानाथस्तन्मे स्यादनृतं वचः .. 19 ..
5.182.m:
How much less this water-snake, non-venomous and resembling a rope! / The snake was not directed at me by this twice-born. / Therefore grant this twice-born release from the curse swiftly.” (18)
Cyavana said: / “If the ocean should cross its boundary, the sun become cold, / and the moon turn hot, then my word could be false.” (19)

5.182.s:
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya svayameva pitāmahaḥ ..
tatrāyātaḥ sthito yatra sa pautraḥ sarparūpadhṛk .. 6.183.20 ..
5.182.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य स्वयमेव पितामहः ..
तत्रायातः स्थितो यत्र स पौत्रः सर्परूपधृक् .. 6.183.20 ..
5.182.m: Hearing his word, the Grandfather [Brahmā] himself / came there, where his grandson stood, bearing the form of a serpent. (20)

5.182.s:
provāca na viṣādaste putra kāryaḥ kathaṃcana ..
yatsarpatvamanuprāptaḥ śṛṇuṣvātra vaco mama .. 21 ..
5.182.d:
प्रोवाच न विषादस्ते पुत्र कार्यः कथंचन ..
यत्सर्पत्वमनुप्राप्तः शृणुष्वात्र वचो मम .. 21 ..
5.182.m: He said: “O son, you should by no means grieve / because you have acquired serpenthood; listen to my word in this matter. (21)

5.182.s:
purā saṃsraṣṭukāmo'haṃ nāgānāṃ navamaṃ kulam ..
tadbhaviṣyati tvatpārśvātsamaryādaṃ dharātale .. 22 ..
5.182.d:
पुरा संस्रष्टुकामोऽहं नागानां नवमं कुलम् ..
तद्भविष्यति त्वत्पार्श्वात्समर्यादं धरातले .. 22 ..
5.182.m: Formerly I wished to create the ninth family of serpents; / that will arise from you, observing proper bounds on the surface of the earth. (22)

5.182.s:
mantrauṣadhiyujāṃ puṃsāṃ na pīḍāmācariṣyati ..
saṃprāpsyati parāṃ pūjāṃ samaste jagatītale .. 23 ..
5.182.d:
मन्त्रौषधियुजां पुंसां न पीडामाचरिष्यति ..
संप्राप्स्यति परां पूजां समस्ते जगतीतले .. 23 ..
5.182.m: It will not cause harm to men equipped with mantras and medicinal herbs; / it will receive supreme worship throughout the whole earth. (23)

5.182.s:
atrā'sti suśubhaṃ toyaṃ hāṭakeśvarasaṃjñite ..
kṣetre tatra samāvāsaḥ putra kāryastvayā sadā .. 24 ..
5.182.d:
अत्राऽस्ति सुशुभं तोयं हाटकेश्वरसंज्ञिते ..
क्षेत्रे तत्र समावासः पुत्र कार्यस्त्वया सदा .. 24 ..
5.182.m: Here there is very auspicious water in the sacred field named Hāṭakeśvara; / your constant dwelling, my son, should be made there. (24)

5.182.s:
tatrasthasya tapasthasya nāgaḥ karkoṭako nijam ..
tava dāsyati satkanyāṃ tataḥ sṛṣṭirbhaviṣyati .. 25 ..
5.182.d:
तत्रस्थस्य तपस्थस्य नागः कर्कोटको निजम् ..
तव दास्यति सत्कन्यां ततः सृष्टिर्भविष्यति .. 25 ..
5.182.m: To you staying there and engaged in austerity, the serpent Karkoṭaka / will give his own noble daughter; from that creation will proceed. (25)

5.182.s:
navamasya kulasyātra samaryādasya bhūtale ..
śrāvaṇe kṛṣṇapakṣe tu saṃprāpte paṃcamīdine .. 26 ..
5.182.d:
नवमस्य कुलस्यात्र समर्यादस्य भूतले ..
श्रावणे कृष्णपक्षे तु संप्राप्ते पंचमीदिने .. 26 ..
5.182.m: Of the ninth family here, observing proper bounds on the earth, / when the fifth day arrives in the dark fortnight of Śrāvaṇa, (26)

5.182.s:
saṃprāpsyati parāṃ pūjāṃ pṛthivyāṃ navamaṃ kulam ..
adyaprabhṛti tattoyaṃ nāgatīrthamiti smṛtam ..27..
5.182.d:
संप्राप्स्यति परां पूजां पृथिव्यां नवमं कुलम् ..
अद्यप्रभृति तत्तोयं नागतीर्थमिति स्मृतम् ..27..
5.182.m: that ninth family will receive supreme worship on earth. / From this day forward, that water is known as Nāgatīrtha; (27)

5.182.s:
khyātiṃ yāsyati bhūpṛṣṭhe sarvapātakanāśanam..
ye'tra snānaṃ kariṣyaṃti saṃprāpte paṃcamīdine ..28..
5.182.d:
ख्यातिं यास्यति भूपृष्ठे सर्वपातकनाशनम्..
येऽत्र स्नानं करिष्यंति संप्राप्ते पंचमीदिने ..28..
5.182.m: it will attain renown on the earth's surface, destroying all sins. / Those who take a ritual ablution here when the fifth day arrives, (28)

5.182.s:
na teṣāṃ vatsaraṃyāvadbhaviṣyatyahijaṃ bhayam ..
viṣārdditastu yo martyastatra snānaṃ kariṣyati ..29..
tatkṣaṇānnirviṣo bhūtvā saṃprāpsyati paraṃ sukham ..
putrakāmā tu yā nārī paṃcamyāṃ bhāskarodaye ..6.183.3...
5.182.d:
न तेषां वत्सरंयावद्भविष्यत्यहिजं भयम् ..
विषार्द्दितस्तु यो मर्त्यस्तत्र स्नानं करिष्यति ..29..
तत्क्षणान्निर्विषो भूत्वा संप्राप्स्यति परं सुखम् ..
पुत्रकामा तु या नारी पंचम्यां भास्करोदये ..6.183.3...
5.182.m:
for one year they shall have no fear born of serpents. / And whatever mortal afflicted with poison takes a ritual ablution there, (29)
becoming free of poison at that very moment, he shall attain supreme happiness. / And whatever woman desiring a son, on the fifth day at sunrise, (30)

5.182.s:
kariṣyati tathā snānaṃ phalahastā prabhaktitaḥ ..
bhaviṣyati ca sā śīghraṃ vaṃdhyā'pi ca suputriṇī ..31..
5.182.d:
करिष्यति तथा स्नानं फलहस्ता प्रभक्तितः ..
भविष्यति च सा शीघ्रं वंध्याऽपि च सुपुत्रिणी ..31..
5.182.m: takes a ritual ablution with fruit in hand and filled with devotion, / she, even if barren, shall soon become the mother of a good son.” (31)

5.182.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
evaṃ pravadatastasya brahmaṇo'vyaktajanmanaḥ..
anye nāgāḥ samāyātāstatra yajñe nimaṃtritāḥ .. 32 ..
5.182.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एवं प्रवदतस्तस्य ब्रह्मणोऽव्यक्तजन्मनः..
अन्ये नागाः समायातास्तत्र यज्ञे निमंत्रिताः .. 32 ..
5.182.m: Sūta said: / As Brahmā of unmanifest origin was speaking thus, / other serpents arrived, invited to that sacrifice: (32)

5.182.s:
vāsukistakṣakaścaiva puṇḍarīkaḥ kṛśodaraḥ ..
kambalāśvatarau nāgau śeṣaḥ kāliya eva ca .. 33 ..
5.182.d:
वासुकिस्तक्षकश्चैव पुण्डरीकः कृशोदरः ..
कम्बलाश्वतरौ नागौ शेषः कालिय एव च .. 33 ..
5.182.m: Vāsuki, Takṣaka, Puṇḍarīka, Kṛśodara, / the serpents Kambala and Aśvatara, Śeṣa, and Kāliya. (33)

5.182.s:
te praṇamya vacaḥ procuḥ proccairdevaṃ pitāmaham ..
tavādeśādvayaṃ prāptā yajñe'tra prapitāmaha..34..
5.182.d:
ते प्रणम्य वचः प्रोचुः प्रोच्चैर्देवं पितामहम् ..
तवादेशाद्वयं प्राप्ता यज्ञेऽत्र प्रपितामह..34..
5.182.m: Having bowed, they spoke aloud to the god, the Grandfather: / “At your command we have arrived at this sacrifice, O Great-Grandfather. (34)

5.182.s:
sāhāyyārthaṃ tadādeśo dīyatāṃ prapitāmaha..
yena kurmo vayaṃ śīghraṃ nāgarājye hyadhiṣṭhitāḥ ..35..
5.182.d:
साहाय्यार्थं तदादेशो दीयतां प्रपितामह..
येन कुर्मो वयं शीघ्रं नागराज्ये ह्यधिष्ठिताः ..35..
5.182.m: Command us to give assistance, O Great-Grandfather, / so that we, established in the serpent realm, may do so swiftly.” (35)

5.182.s:
brahmovāca .. sāhāyyametadasmākaṃ bhavadīyaṃ mahoragāḥ ..
gatvānena samaṃ śīghraṃ nāgarājena tiṣṭhata..36..
5.182.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच .. साहाय्यमेतदस्माकं भवदीयं महोरगाः ..
गत्वानेन समं शीघ्रं नागराजेन तिष्ठत..36..
5.182.m: Brahmā said: “This assistance of yours is ours, O great snakes! / Having gone quickly together with this king of serpents, remain [there]. (36)

5.182.s: nāgatīrthe tataḥ stheyaṃ sarvaistatra samāsthitaiḥ ..37..
5.182.d: नागतीर्थे ततः स्थेयं सर्वैस्तत्र समास्थितैः ..37..
5.182.m: All of you, established there, must remain at Nāgatīrtha. (37)

5.182.s:
yaḥ kaścinmama yajñe'tra duṣṭabhāvaṃ samāśritaḥ ..
samāgacchati vighnāya rakṣaṇīyaḥ sa satvaram ..38..
5.182.d:
यः कश्चिन्मम यज्ञेऽत्र दुष्टभावं समाश्रितः ..
समागच्छति विघ्नाय रक्षणीयः स सत्वरम् ..38..
5.182.m: Whoever, having adopted an evil intent, comes / to cause obstacles to this sacrifice of mine, must be repelled swiftly.” (38)

5.182.s:
rākṣaso vā piśāco vā bhūto vā mānuṣo'pi vā ..
etatkṛtyatamaṃ nāgā mama yajñasya rakṣaṇam .. 39 ..
5.182.d:
राक्षसो वा पिशाचो वा भूतो वा मानुषोऽपि वा ..
एतत्कृत्यतमं नागा मम यज्ञस्य रक्षणम् .. 39 ..
5.182.m:
whether a rākṣasa, a piśāca, a bhūta, or even a human being.
O serpents, this protection of my sacrifice is the utmost duty [for you].

5.182.s:
tathā yūyamapi prāpte māsi bhādrapade tathā ..
paṃcamyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣasya tatra pūjāmavāpsyatha .. 6.183.40 ..
5.182.d:
तथा यूयमपि प्राप्ते मासि भाद्रपदे तथा ..
पंचम्यां कृष्णपक्षस्य तत्र पूजामवाप्स्यथ .. 6.183.40 ..
5.182.m:
Likewise, when the month of Bhādrapada arrives,
on the fifth lunar day of the dark fortnight, you shall receive worship there.”

5.182.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
bāḍhamityeva te procya praṇipatya pitāmaham ..
sanātanasutopetā nāgatīrthaṃ samāśritāḥ .. 41
5.182.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
बाढमित्येव ते प्रोच्य प्रणिपत्य पितामहम् ..
सनातनसुतोपेता नागतीर्थं समाश्रिताः .. 41
5.182.m:
Sūta said:
Saying, “So be it,” and bowing down to the Grandfather,
they, together with the sons of Sanātana, resorted to the Nāgatīrtha.

5.182.s:
tataḥprabhṛti tattīrthaṃ nāgatīrtha miti smṛtam ..
kāmapradaṃ ca bhaktānāṃ narāṇāṃ snānakāriṇām .. 42 ..
5.182.d:
ततःप्रभृति तत्तीर्थं नागतीर्थ मिति स्मृतम् ..
कामप्रदं च भक्तानां नराणां स्नानकारिणाम् .. 42 ..
5.182.m:
From then on, that sacred ford was known as Nāgatīrtha,
granting desires to devotees, to men who perform ritual ablution [there].

5.182.s:
yastatra kurute snānaṃ sakṛdbhaktyā samanvitaḥ ..
